about: Hand-written menus by Claude. Source of truth for dish names, scenes and methods. Regenerated on every Claude push; do not edit by hand.

films.title: The Godfather
films.tagline: Family first. Cannoli second.
films.description: A mafia patriarch hands the family business to his reluctant youngest son.
films.serve_cue: Pour the Chianti when the wedding band starts up in the opening scene.

snacks.name: Connie's wedding antipasto
snacks.scene: salami, provolone, olives and roast peppers laid out like the garden party
snacks.method: Roast two red capsicums black over a flame, sweat in a covered bowl, peel and dress with garlic, red wine vinegar and oil. Platter with folded finocchiona and sopressa, wedges of aged provolone, Sicilian green olives and grissini wrapped in prosciutto.

snacks.name: Sicilian orange and fennel salad
snacks.scene: for all those oranges on screen, every one a warning
snacks.method: Segment 4 blood or navel oranges over a bowl to catch the juice. Shave 1 fennel bulb and half a red onion paper thin, toss with the segments, black olives, fennel fronds, the juice, good olive oil, flaky salt and chilli flakes.

snacks.name: Fried calamari
snacks.scene: the kind of starter Clemenza would order without looking at a menu
snacks.method: Cut cleaned squid tubes into rings, soak 30 minutes in buttermilk. Dredge in half fine semolina, half flour with salt and pepper, fry at 190C for 90 seconds in small batches. Lemon wedges and a quick marinara for dipping.

mains.name: Clemenza's Sunday sauce
mains.scene: fry the garlic, tomatoes and paste, brown the sausage and meatballs, a splash of wine, a little sugar
mains.method: Brown fennel sausages and pork and beef meatballs hard in olive oil, set aside. Fry sliced garlic, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook out, then 2 tins of San Marzano and a splash of red. Meat back in, a pinch of sugar, simmer low 2 hours. Rigatoni, pecorino.

mains.name: Louis' veal scaloppine
mains.scene: lemon and capers, the best veal in the city, so Sollozzo says
mains.method: Pound veal escalopes to 4mm, season, dust in flour. Sear 60 seconds a side in butter and oil, rest on a plate. Deglaze with white wine, add lemon juice, capers and stock, reduce, swirl in cold butter, return the veal and parsley.

dessert.name: Leave-the-gun cannoli
dessert.scene: take the cannoli, it's the one thing everyone remembers
dessert.method: Drain 500g fresh ricotta overnight in muslin. Beat with 80g icing sugar, orange zest and vanilla, fold in mini choc chips. Pipe into bought cannoli shells just before serving so they stay crisp, dip the ends in crushed pistachio, dust with icing sugar.

drink.name: Chianti
drink.scene: the straw bottle on the table, refilled without asking
drink.method: Chianti Classico at cellar temperature, around 16C, opened 30 minutes before. Pour into tumblers, the way the family does it.

films.title: The Godfather Part II
films.tagline: The family business goes international.
films.description: Michael tightens his grip on the empire while young Vito's rise plays out in old New York.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the story moves to Havana for New Year's Eve.

snacks.name: Feast day arancini
snacks.scene: young Vito's Little Italy, the festa going on outside
snacks.method: Cook arborio in stock with saffron and parmesan, spread on a tray and chill overnight. Wrap golf balls of rice around a peas and beef ragù filling with a cube of mozzarella, flour, egg, crumb, fry at 175C until deep gold.

snacks.name: Havana Cuban sliders
snacks.scene: ham, roast pork, swiss and pickles, pressed flat for the Havana trip
snacks.method: Split slider rolls, smear with mustard, layer leg ham, sliced mojo pork, Swiss and dill pickle. Brush tops with butter and press in a heavy pan over medium heat, a second pan on top, until the cheese melts and the bread crisps.

snacks.name: Lake Tahoe smoked trout pâté
snacks.scene: for the lakeside compound where it all goes cold
snacks.method: Flake 2 hot-smoked trout fillets, blitz half with 150g cream cheese, crème fraîche, lemon and horseradish, fold the rest through for texture. Dill and cracked pepper, water crackers on the side.

mains.name: Vito's tenement baked ziti
mains.scene: ricotta and a mozzarella crust, the kind of thing a young family stretches over a week
mains.method: Cook ziti 3 minutes short of done. Toss with a slow tomato and Italian sausage sauce, layer with ricotta seasoned with parmesan, nutmeg and parsley, top with torn mozzarella. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until blistered.

mains.name: Havana mojo pork
mains.scene: garlic, citrus, black beans and rice for New Year's Eve in Havana
mains.method: Marinate pork shoulder overnight in sour orange (or orange and lime), a whole head of garlic, cumin and oregano. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until it pulls, then crisp at 220C. Black beans with sofrito and white rice.

dessert.name: Hyman Roth's birthday cake
dessert.scene: the sponge iced like Cuba, cut and shared around the table
dessert.method: Bake a vanilla butter sponge in a slab tin. Cut into a rough island shape, cover with a thin crumb coat then pale green buttercream. Pipe "Happy Birthday" across it and slice at the table while everyone talks business.

drink.name: Havana daiquiri
drink.scene: rum, lime and sugar, shaken hard the Havana way
drink.method: Shake 60ml white rum, 25ml fresh lime and 15ml sugar syrup hard with plenty of ice, double strain into a chilled coupe. No fruit, no blender.

films.title: The Godfather Part III
films.tagline: The past never stays buried.
films.description: An ageing Michael Corleone tries to buy his way into legitimacy through the Vatican.
films.serve_cue: Hold the cannoli until the opera in the final act, and keep an eye on who made them.

snacks.name: Palermo panelle
snacks.scene: chickpea fritters, salt and lemon, for the trip back to Sicily
snacks.method: Whisk 250g chickpea flour into 750ml salted water, cook stirring for 10 minutes until thick. Spread 1cm thick on an oiled tray, set, cut into squares and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Lemon and salt.

snacks.name: Caponata crostini
snacks.scene: sweet and sour Sicilian eggplant on toast
snacks.method: Fry cubed eggplant until golden, then soften celery and onion. Add tomato, capers, green olives, a spoon of sugar and red wine vinegar, simmer 10 minutes, fold in the eggplant. Cool, spoon onto toasted baguette with basil.

snacks.name: Prosciutto and melon
snacks.scene: Don Altobello's opera box nibbles
snacks.method: Rockmelon at room temperature, cut into long wedges and skinned. Drape with prosciutto di Parma, a crack of pepper and a drizzle of good olive oil.

mains.name: Mary and Vincent's gnocchi
mains.scene: hand-rolled in the kitchen while the family looks the other way
mains.method: Bake 1kg floury potatoes, rice while hot, cool slightly, work in 1 yolk, salt and about 250g 00 flour until just smooth. Roll ropes, cut, cook until they float. Burnt butter with sage until nutty, parmesan.

mains.name: Pasta alla Norma
mains.scene: eggplant, tomato and ricotta salata, straight from Sicily
mains.method: Fry thick eggplant slices in olive oil until deep gold. Simmer garlic, San Marzano tomatoes and basil 20 minutes. Toss rigatoni with sauce and eggplant, grate ricotta salata heavily over the top.

dessert.name: Opera night cannoli
dessert.scene: ricotta and candied orange, eaten carefully in the opera box
dessert.method: Beat drained ricotta with icing sugar, cinnamon and chopped candied orange peel. Fill bought shells at the last minute, ends in chopped candied orange and pistachio.

drink.name: Nero d'Avola
drink.scene: a Sicilian red for the trip back to Corleone
drink.method: Nero d'Avola at about 16C, opened 30 minutes ahead so it softens. Big glasses, no ice.

films.title: Goodfellas
films.tagline: As far back as I can remember, I always wanted seconds.
films.description: A Brooklyn kid works his way up the mob ladder, from the cab stand to the Lufthansa heist.
films.serve_cue: Plate up the mains when Paulie starts slicing garlic in the prison kitchen.

snacks.name: Razor-thin garlic bruschetta
snacks.scene: Paulie's razor blade garlic, sliced so fine it melts in the oil
snacks.method: Slice garlic as thin as you can on a mandoline, sweat in olive oil over low heat until soft and barely golden. Spoon over grilled ciabatta rubbed with tomato, salt and torn basil.

snacks.name: Copacabana prawn cocktail
snacks.scene: front row table, walked in through the kitchen
snacks.method: Poach peeled prawns 2 minutes in salted water with lemon and bay, ice bath. Marie Rose with whole-egg mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, hot sauce and brandy. Iceberg, prawns, sauce, paprika, lemon wedge, in coupes.

snacks.name: Bamboo Lounge salami and provolone
snacks.scene: the crew's back booth
snacks.method: Thick-cut Genoa salami and sharp provolone, pepperoncini, marinated mushrooms and a loaf of seeded Italian bread torn by hand.

mains.name: Prison gravy with three-meat meatballs
mains.scene: veal, beef and pork, and go easy on the onions like Vinnie
mains.method: Mix equal veal, beef and pork mince with milk-soaked bread, egg, pecorino, parsley and garlic. Brown, then into a tomato sauce built on razor-thin garlic and a little onion. Simmer 90 minutes, serve with spaghetti.

mains.name: Steak pizzaiola
mains.scene: the 3am dinner at Tommy's mum's, after the boys turn up late and hungry
mains.method: Season thin porterhouse or rump, sear hard and rest. In the same pan, garlic, oregano, chilli and a tin of crushed tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes. Return the steak to warm through, crusty bread for the sauce.

dessert.name: Lemon ice
dessert.scene: a hot Brooklyn summer on the corner
dessert.method: Simmer 200g sugar with 500ml water and lemon zest, cool, add 250ml lemon juice. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy. Serve in paper cups.

drink.name: Scotch and soda
drink.scene: the drink of choice at the Bamboo Lounge
drink.method: 45ml blended Scotch over big ice in a highball, topped with chilled soda water, no garnish.

films.title: A Bronx Tale
films.tagline: The saddest thing in life is a wasted dinner.
films.description: A bus driver's son is torn between his honest father and the neighbourhood boss.
films.serve_cue: Do the car door test before dessert comes out.

snacks.name: Chez Bippy bar snacks
snacks.scene: salted peanuts, olives and provolone cubes from Sonny's bar
snacks.method: Warm salted peanuts in a dry pan, toss with chilli. Cube sharp provolone, mix with marinated olives and lemon zest. Serve in small bar bowls.

snacks.name: Fried eggplant fingers
snacks.scene: Belmont Avenue style
snacks.method: Cut eggplant into fingers, salt 30 minutes, pat dry. Flour, egg, panko mixed with parmesan, fry at 180C until golden. Warm marinara for dipping.

snacks.name: Doo-wop garlic knots
snacks.scene: eaten on the stoop while the street corner singers warm up
snacks.method: Cut pizza dough into strips, tie knots, prove 30 minutes, bake at 230C for 12 minutes. Toss straight from the oven in garlic butter with parsley and parmesan.

mains.name: Sonny's Sunday rigatoni
mains.scene: gravy and meatballs at the neighbourhood boss's table
mains.method: Brown pork and beef meatballs and a few pork ribs, then simmer in tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 2 hours. Toss rigatoni with sauce, meat on a platter.

mains.name: Lorenzo's sausage and peppers hero
mains.scene: wrapped in paper for the bus route
mains.method: Grill Italian sausages, then soften sliced capsicum and onion in the same pan with oregano. Pile into a long roll with provolone, wrap in baking paper to steam 5 minutes.

dessert.name: Arthur Avenue cannoli
dessert.scene: a box from Belmont's bakery for Sonny
dessert.method: Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar, vanilla and mini choc chips, piped into bought shells right before serving, ends in crushed pistachio.

drink.name: Espresso with anisette
drink.method: Short espresso in a demitasse with 15ml anisette or sambuca on the side to pour in, a curl of lemon peel.

films.id: Once Upon a Time in America (1984)
films.title: Once Upon a Time in America
films.tagline: Fifty years of friendship, one very long dinner.
films.description: Four Lower East Side street kids grow into Prohibition gangsters, and one of them betrays the rest.
films.serve_cue: Bring the charlotte russe out when young Patsy sits on the stairs with his.

snacks.name: Delancey Street knishes
snacks.scene: hot mustard, Lower East Side street food
snacks.method: Mash potatoes with onion cooked low in schmaltz or butter, salt and white pepper. Wrap in rolled puff pastry, egg wash, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Hot English mustard.

snacks.name: Speakeasy pickles
snacks.scene: half and full sours from the barrel
snacks.method: Pack small cucumbers with garlic, dill and peppercorns, cover with a 5 percent salt brine. Leave at room temperature 3 days for half sours, a week for full. Or buy both and serve icy.

snacks.name: Bagel crisps with schmear
snacks.scene: Lower East Side breakfast
snacks.method: Slice day-old bagels thin, brush with oil, bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Whip cream cheese with chives and lemon zest, lox on the side.

mains.name: Fat Moe's back room brisket
mains.scene: slow braised with onions and gravy
mains.method: Season brisket, sear hard, then braise at 150C on a bed of sliced onions with stock, tomato paste and paprika for 4 hours, covered. Rest, slice against the grain, reduce the juices to gravy.

mains.name: Prohibition pastrami on rye
mains.scene: eaten in the speakeasy back room
mains.method: Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until soft and glistening. Pile high on seeded rye with yellow mustard. Full sour pickle on the side.

dessert.name: Patsy's charlotte russe
dessert.scene: sponge, whipped cream and a cherry, try not to eat it on the stairs
dessert.method: Line paper cups with a disc of sponge, pipe whipped cream stabilised with a little mascarpone and vanilla high in a swirl, top with a maraschino cherry.

drink.name: Bootleg whisky
drink.scene: served in a coffee cup, Prohibition style
drink.method: Rye whiskey neat in a china coffee cup, a jug of water on the side.

films.title: Carlito's Way
films.tagline: One last score, then paradise.
films.description: A Puerto Rican ex-con swears he's going straight, but his old life won't let him go.
films.serve_cue: Have dessert on the table before the Grand Central finale.

snacks.name: Alcapurrias
snacks.scene: fried green banana fritters with seasoned beef from El Barrio
snacks.method: Grate green bananas and taro, season with annatto oil and salt. Spread on baking paper, fill with beef picadillo, roll into logs and fry at 175C until crisp.

snacks.name: Bacalaitos
snacks.scene: crisp salt cod fritters
snacks.method: Soak salt cod 24 hours, changing the water, flake. Whisk flour, baking powder, water, garlic and coriander into a loose batter, fold in the cod, fry flat spoonfuls at 180C until lacy.

snacks.name: Tostones
snacks.scene: smashed plantain with garlic mojo
snacks.method: Fry green plantain chunks at 160C until soft, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Salt and spoon over garlic, lime and olive oil mojo.

mains.name: Pernil
mains.scene: slow roast pork shoulder with crackling, rice and pigeon peas
mains.method: Stab pork shoulder all over, rub with garlic, oregano, adobo and vinegar, marinate overnight. Roast at 160C for 5 hours skin up, then 230C to crackle. Arroz con gandules alongside.

mains.name: Mofongo with garlic prawns
mains.scene: mashed plantain, pork crackling and garlic
mains.method: Fry green plantain chunks, mash in a mortar with garlic, olive oil and crushed pork crackling. Pack into a bowl and turn out. Prawns sautéed in garlic butter with stock poured around.

dessert.name: Paradise flan
dessert.scene: caramel and coconut, for the beach postcard Carlito keeps
dessert.method: Caramelise 150g sugar into a ring tin. Blend condensed milk, coconut milk, evaporated milk and 5 eggs, pour over, bake in a water bath at 160C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight and turn out.

drink.name: Rum and cola
drink.method: 45ml golden rum over ice, topped with cold cola, a big wedge of lime squeezed in.

films.title: Donnie Brasco
films.tagline: Forget about it.
films.description: An undercover FBI agent gets too close to the tired hitman who vouches for him.
films.serve_cue: Before the mains, explain all the meanings of "forget about it" to the table.

snacks.name: Social club antipasto
snacks.scene: cured meats and giardiniera on the card table
snacks.method: Capicola, soppressata and mortadella with homemade giardiniera: cauliflower, carrot, celery and chilli blanched 1 minute then packed in vinegar, oil and oregano for 2 days.

snacks.name: Miami garlic prawns
snacks.scene: the Florida boat trip
snacks.method: Butterfly green prawns, sauté hot in olive oil with sliced garlic and chilli, white wine and butter to finish, parsley. Bread for the pan.

snacks.name: Fried mozzarella
snacks.scene: marinara on the side
snacks.method: Slice firm mozzarella into fingers, freeze 20 minutes, double crumb with Italian seasoned breadcrumbs, fry at 180C for 90 seconds.

mains.name: Shoes-on teriyaki steak
mains.scene: for the Japanese restaurant scene where nobody takes their shoes off
mains.method: Reduce soy, mirin, sake and sugar to a glaze. Sear sirloin hard, brush with glaze in the last minute, rest and slice. Steamed rice and blanched greens.

mains.name: Lefty's Sunday gravy
mains.scene: meatballs and braciole
mains.method: Braciole: flatten beef topside, layer with garlic, parsley, pecorino and pine nuts, roll and tie. Brown with meatballs, braise 2 hours in tomato sauce. Serve with the pasta.

dessert.name: Ricotta cheesecake
dessert.scene: Lefty's sweet tooth
dessert.method: Beat 750g drained ricotta with 150g sugar, 4 eggs, lemon zest and vanilla. Bake at 160C in a lined tin for 60 minutes, cool in the oven. Dust with icing sugar.

drink.name: Scotch on the rocks
drink.method: Blended Scotch over a single big ice cube in a heavy tumbler.

films.title: Mean Streets
films.tagline: Sins in the street. Penance at the bar.
films.description: A small-time hood in Little Italy tries to keep his reckless friend Johnny Boy out of trouble.
films.serve_cue: Hit play on the jukebox and pour a round when Johnny Boy walks into Tony's bar.

snacks.name: San Gennaro sausage bites
snacks.scene: charred and sliced, straight from the street feast
snacks.method: Grill Italian sausages over high heat until blistered, slice thick, toss with charred onion and capsicum, toothpicks and hot mustard.

snacks.name: Fried calamari
snacks.scene: lemon, eaten at Tony's bar
snacks.method: Squid rings soaked in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds, salt and lemon.

snacks.name: Peppers on garlic bread
snacks.scene: Charlie's uncle's restaurant
snacks.method: Roast capsicums, peel and slice, marinate in garlic, vinegar and oil. Pile onto grilled garlic bread with torn basil.

mains.name: Sausage and peppers hero
mains.scene: San Gennaro feast style
mains.method: Grill sausages, soften capsicum and onion with oregano in the fat, pile into crusty rolls with a spoon of tomato sauce.

mains.name: Penne arrabbiata
mains.scene: as hot as Johnny Boy's temper
mains.method: Fry garlic and plenty of dried chilli in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Toss penne through with pasta water, parsley and pecorino.

dessert.name: Zeppole
dessert.scene: powdered sugar, straight from the street feast
dessert.method: Choux or yeasted dough dropped by the spoon into 175C oil, fried golden, tossed in a paper bag with icing sugar. Eat hot.

drink.name: Red wine
drink.method: A cheap and cheerful Italian red in a jug, slightly chilled, poured into tumblers.

films.title: Casino
films.tagline: Every muffin gets the same number of blueberries.
films.description: A meticulous Vegas casino boss and his volatile enforcer mate lose their grip on the Tangiers.
films.serve_cue: Bring out the muffins and count the blueberries before anyone takes one.

snacks.name: Clams casino
snacks.scene: Ace runs the Tangiers, so it had to be
snacks.method: Baked clams topped with bacon, capsicum, garlic butter and crumbs until crisp and bubbling. Steam 1kg clams until they open and remove the top shells.

snacks.name: Oysters Rockefeller
snacks.scene: the high roller table
snacks.method: Blitz spinach, parsley, spring onion, butter, breadcrumbs and a splash of aniseed liqueur. Top shucked oysters, grill hot for 3 minutes until bubbling.

mains.name: Tangiers rib eye
mains.scene: cooked exactly right, no excuses
mains.method: Dry-brine rib eye on a rack overnight. Sear in a smoking pan, baste with butter, thyme and garlic to 54C inside, rest 8 minutes. Creamed spinach on the side.

mains.name: Lobster tail
mains.scene: comped by the house
mains.method: Split lobster tails, brush with garlic and paprika butter, grill flesh up for 6 to 8 minutes until just opaque. Lemon and drawn butter.

dessert.name: Equal-blueberry muffins
dessert.scene: count them, every one the same
dessert.method: Whisk 300g flour, 150g sugar, 2 tsp baking powder; combine with 2 eggs, 250ml buttermilk and 90g melted butter. Spoon into 12 cases and press exactly 10 blueberries into each. 190C for 20 minutes.

drink.name: Dry martini
drink.method: Stir 60ml gin with 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds, strain into a frozen martini glass, olive or a twist.

films.title: Scarface
films.tagline: The world is yours. So is the last croqueta.
films.description: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of Miami's underworld.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Tony first walks into the Babylon Club.

snacks.name: Little Havana medianoche sliders
snacks.scene: the lunch counter Tony walked out of
snacks.method: Soft sweet egg rolls with mustard, ham, roast pork, Swiss and pickle, buttered and pressed in a hot pan until flat and crisp.

snacks.name: Croquetas de jamón
snacks.scene: Little Havana's counter snack
snacks.method: Thick béchamel with finely chopped serrano ham and nutmeg, chilled overnight. Roll into logs, egg and fine crumb, fry at 180C until golden.

snacks.name: Tostones
snacks.scene: garlic mojo, Little Havana's side order
snacks.method: Fry green plantain at 160C, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Garlic, lime and oil mojo over the top, flaky salt.

mains.name: Ropa vieja
mains.scene: shredded beef with capsicum, rice and black beans
mains.method: Simmer flank steak with bay and onion 2 hours, shred. Sofrito of onion, capsicum and garlic, add cumin, oregano, tomato, olives and the beef with some broth, simmer 20 minutes. Rice and black beans.

mains.name: Babylon Club surf and turf
mains.scene: the nightclub where Tony makes a scene
mains.method: Eye fillet seared to medium rare and rested, king prawns in garlic butter, béarnaise of tarragon reduction, yolks and clarified butter.

dessert.name: Guava pastelitos
dessert.scene: flaky pastry with guava and cream cheese
dessert.method: Cut puff pastry into squares, top with a slice of guava paste and a spoon of cream cheese, cover, seal, egg wash, sugar. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

drink.name: Mojito
drink.method: Muddle mint gently with 20ml sugar syrup and 25ml lime, add 50ml white rum and crushed ice, top with soda.

films.title: The Untouchables
films.tagline: Never bring a knife to a gunfight. Bring a fork.
films.description: Eliot Ness and a hand-picked team take on Al Capone in Prohibition Chicago.
films.serve_cue: Pour Ness his drink at the very end, when he's finally earned one.

snacks.name: Capone's arancini
snacks.scene: the Lexington Hotel kitchen
snacks.method: Crisp fried risotto balls with a melting mozzarella middle, served with warm tomato sauce. Cook 300g arborio rice in 1L stock to a firm risotto, stir in 50g parmesan and cool completely.

snacks.name: Lexington Hotel antipasto
snacks.scene: Capone's banquet table, before the bat comes out
snacks.method: Platter of folded salami, mortadella and prosciutto with marinated artichokes, roast peppers, bocconcini and good bread, laid out banquet style down the middle of the table.

snacks.name: Giardiniera crostini
snacks.scene: Chicago's own pickled peppers piled on toast
snacks.method: Chop hot giardiniera (pickled peppers, celery, carrot and cauliflower in oil) finely, pile onto toasted baguette rounds over a smear of ricotta.

mains.name: Italian beef
mains.scene: shaved, dipped and hot
mains.method: Roast seasoned topside to rare, chill and shave thin. Warm in a jus of beef stock, garlic, oregano and black pepper. Pile into rolls, dip the whole sandwich, hot giardiniera on top.

mains.name: Chicago deep dish
mains.scene: sausage, sauce on top
mains.method: Buttery cornmeal dough pressed up a deep tin. Mozzarella slices first, then a layer of raw Italian sausage, then chunky crushed tomato with oregano and parmesan. Bake at 220C for 35 minutes.

dessert.name: Ricotta zeppole
dessert.scene: the Italian bakeries of 1930s Chicago
dessert.method: Little fried ricotta doughnuts tossed in icing sugar, light and soft in the middle. Mix 250g ricotta, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon, then fold in 150g self-raising flour.

drink.name: Repeal Day old fashioned
drink.method: Stir 60ml rye, 10ml sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds, strain over a big cube, orange twist.

films.title: Prizzi's Honor
films.tagline: Love, honour and a very complicated wedding.
films.description: A Brooklyn mob hitman falls for a woman who turns out to be in the same line of work.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert at the wedding, when Charley first spots Irene.

snacks.name: Prizzi wedding antipasto
snacks.scene: olives, salami and marinated mushrooms for the reception
snacks.method: Marinate button mushrooms (blanched 1 minute) in oil, lemon, garlic and parsley overnight. Platter with salami, olives and marinated artichokes.

snacks.name: Brooklyn arancini
snacks.scene: the family's Sunday table
snacks.method: Chilled saffron risotto rolled around a cube of mozzarella, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold. Marinara for dipping.

snacks.name: Fried zucchini
snacks.scene: church hall wedding style
snacks.method: Zucchini batons tossed in flour then dipped in a light batter of flour and sparkling water, fried at 185C, salt and lemon.

mains.name: Don Corrado's baked ziti
mains.scene: the old man's favourite
mains.method: Ziti in slow sausage sugo layered with seasoned ricotta and mozzarella, baked at 200C until blistered.

mains.name: Veal piccata
mains.scene: Charley's dinner date with Irene
mains.method: Veal escalopes pounded thin, floured and seared 60 seconds a side, pan sauce of white wine, lemon, capers and stock, cold butter whisked in.

dessert.name: Wedding almond cookies
dessert.scene: wrapped in tulle
dessert.method: Amaretti: whisk 2 egg whites stiff, fold in 250g almond meal, 200g sugar and almond extract. Roll in icing sugar, bake at 170C for 15 minutes until crackled.

drink.name: Prosecco
drink.method: Prosecco chilled to 6C in an ice bucket, poured into flutes for the toast.

films.title: Analyze This
films.tagline: Therapy, but make it Italian.
films.description: A mob boss having panic attacks secretly books in with a nervous psychiatrist.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Paul tells Ben "you, you're good".

snacks.name: Couch session crostini
snacks.scene: three toppings, talk about your feelings between bites
snacks.method: Toasted baguette three ways: whipped ricotta and honey, tomato and basil, and chicken liver pâté with fig.

snacks.name: Fried calamari
snacks.scene: the Miami dinner that gets interrupted
snacks.method: Squid rings soaked 30 minutes in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds. Salt and lemon.

snacks.name: Mozzarella in carrozza
snacks.scene: comfort food for a man in crisis
snacks.method: Mozzarella sandwiched in crustless white bread, dipped in egg and milk, then crumbs, shallow-fried golden.

mains.name: Paul Vitti's veal parm
mains.scene: big plate, no talking about the panic attacks
mains.method: Crumbed veal fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan, grilled until bubbling. Spaghetti on the side.

mains.name: Wedding banquet chicken
mains.scene: for Ben's wedding that keeps getting crashed
mains.method: Chicken thighs browned, braised with white wine, rosemary, lemon and green olives for 35 minutes.

dessert.name: Cannoli
dessert.scene: emotional support dessert
dessert.method: Drained ricotta with icing sugar and orange zest piped into shells at the last minute, chocolate ends.

drink.name: Negroni
drink.method: Equal parts gin, bitter red aperitif and sweet vermouth stirred over ice, big cube, orange slice.

films.title: Mickey Blue Eyes
films.tagline: Marry the girl. Marry the family.
films.description: An English auctioneer discovers his fiancée's family runs with the mob.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Michael tries to do the Kansas City accent.

snacks.name: Gina's dad's restaurant antipasto
snacks.scene: the family business
snacks.method: Cured meats fanned out, bocconcini dressed with basil and oil, marinated artichokes, and button mushrooms roasted with garlic and thyme at 200C for 15 minutes.

snacks.name: English tea sandwiches
snacks.scene: Michael's auction house
snacks.method: Crustless white bread with cucumber and butter, egg and cress, smoked salmon and cream cheese, cut in fingers.

snacks.name: Fried ravioli
snacks.scene: Little Italy, where the family restaurant sits
snacks.method: Ricotta ravioli dipped in egg and Italian breadcrumbs, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp, parmesan and warm marinara to dip.

mains.name: Vito's linguine with clams
mains.scene: the family restaurant
mains.method: Purge clams, steam open with garlic, chilli and white wine. Toss linguine through the juices, parsley and good olive oil.

mains.name: Chicken parm
mains.scene: the mob dinner Michael can't get out of
mains.method: Chicken breast pounded thin, floured, egged and crumbed, fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan and grilled until bubbling.

dessert.name: Tiramisu
dessert.scene: the wedding dessert, if the wedding happens
dessert.method: Whisk 4 yolks with 100g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone then 4 whites whipped stiff. Layer with savoiardi dipped in espresso and marsala, cocoa on top, chill overnight.

drink.name: Pinot grigio
drink.method: Crisp pinot grigio chilled to 8C, poured small and often.

films.title: The Pope of Greenwich Village
films.tagline: Big plans. Small cousins. Bad luck.
films.description: Two cousins working in a Village restaurant plan a safe job that goes sideways.
films.serve_cue: Pour the wine when Paulie gets caught skimming and loses them both their jobs.

snacks.name: Waiter's antipasto
snacks.scene: prosciutto, melon and bocconcini, what Charlie plates up every night
snacks.method: Prosciutto draped over ripe rockmelon wedges, bocconcini dressed with basil oil (basil blitzed with oil and salt) and cracked pepper.

snacks.name: Clams oreganata
snacks.scene: the house special
snacks.method: Steam clams open, remove top shells, top with breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, parmesan and olive oil, grill until golden.

snacks.name: Racetrack peanuts
snacks.scene: for Paulie's racehorse
snacks.method: Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed while hot with fine salt, served in paper bags.

mains.name: Linguine vongole
mains.scene: Charlie's restaurant, before the big plan
mains.method: Clams steamed open in garlic, chilli and white wine, linguine finished in the juices, parsley.

mains.name: Veal marsala
mains.scene: the dish Charlie plates while dreaming of his own place
mains.method: Veal floured and seared, set aside. Mushrooms browned in the pan, marsala and stock reduced by half, cold butter whisked in, veal back to warm through.

dessert.name: Zabaglione
dessert.scene: whisked at the table, the way Charlie dreams of running his own place
dessert.method: Whisk 4 yolks, 60g sugar and 80ml marsala over simmering water for 6 to 8 minutes until thick and tripled. Serve warm over berries.

drink.name: Chianti
drink.method: Chianti Classico at 16C, decanted and poured with a flourish.

films.title: Miller's Crossing
films.tagline: What's the rumpus?
films.description: A cool-headed advisor plays rival gang bosses against each other in a Prohibition-era town.
films.serve_cue: Plate up when Tom goes back into the woods looking for his hat.

snacks.name: Speakeasy pickled eggs
snacks.scene: Leo's back bar
snacks.method: Hard-boil eggs 9 minutes, peel, pack into a jar with hot brine of vinegar, sugar, salt, beetroot juice and peppercorns. Pickle 3 days in the fridge.

snacks.name: Rye toast with chicken liver pâté
snacks.scene: old-school Irish club food
snacks.method: Sear chicken livers pink, deglaze with brandy, blitz with butter, thyme and shallot until silky, set under clarified butter. Toasted rye.

snacks.name: Cheese straws
snacks.scene: for the card game Tom keeps losing
snacks.method: Puff pastry with egg, aged cheddar, parmesan and cayenne, folded, cut, twisted, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.

mains.name: Leo's Irish stew
mains.scene: lamb, potato and stout for the Irish boss
mains.method: Brown lamb neck chops, layer with onion, carrot and potato, add stock and a bottle of stout, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Parsley.

mains.name: Johnny Caspar's penne with sausage
mains.scene: talk about ethics while you eat it
mains.method: Crumble Italian sausage into olive oil and brown, add garlic, chilli and a splash of cream and tomato, toss with penne and parmesan.

dessert.name: Whisky bread pudding
dessert.scene: Tom's drink, Leo's dessert
dessert.method: Layer buttered stale brioche with raisins soaked in Irish whiskey, pour over custard of 4 eggs, milk, cream and sugar, rest 30 minutes, bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

drink.name: Irish whiskey
drink.scene: neat, Tom never puts his glass down
drink.method: Irish whiskey neat in a heavy glass, a little water on the side.

films.title: Bugsy
films.tagline: He dreamed up Las Vegas. Then he blew the budget.
films.description: A charismatic gangster builds the Flamingo hotel in the Nevada desert.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when the Flamingo finally opens its doors.

snacks.name: Hollywood party blini and caviar
snacks.scene: Bugsy's LA set
snacks.method: Warm buckwheat blini 5 minutes at 180C, top with a spoon of crème fraîche, salmon roe or caviar and snipped chives.

snacks.name: Prawn cocktail
snacks.scene: the classic forties supper club starter
snacks.method: Prawns poached and iced, hung over coupes of shredded iceberg, Marie Rose with a splash of brandy, paprika and lemon.

snacks.name: Brown Derby Cobb salad cups
snacks.scene: the 1940s Hollywood crowd Ben ran with
snacks.method: Little gem lettuce cups filled with chopped chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, egg, tomato and blue cheese, a spoon of red wine vinaigrette over the top.

mains.name: Flamingo steak Diane
mains.scene: flambéed tableside, like the opening night
mains.method: Flatten scotch fillet, sear hot, set aside. Shallot and garlic in butter, flame with brandy, add Dijon, Worcestershire, stock and cream, reduce, steak back in.

mains.name: Lobster thermidor
mains.scene: over budget, like everything else
mains.method: Halve cooked lobsters, dice the meat. Make a sauce of shallot, white wine, fish stock, cream, Dijon and gruyère, fold in the lobster, pile back into shells, gratinate.

dessert.name: Pink flamingo pavlova
dessert.scene: raspberry cream for the hotel's namesake
dessert.method: 4 whites whipped with 220g caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven. Top with cream folded with crushed raspberries.

drink.name: Virginia Hill's gin rickey
drink.method: Gin, fresh lime and soda water over ice, crisp and sharp, the cocktail of the era.

films.title: Get Shorty
films.tagline: Look at me. Now pass the dip.
films.description: A Miami loan shark goes to Hollywood to collect a debt and ends up producing a movie.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Chili starts pitching his movie idea.

snacks.name: Miami Cuban croquetas
snacks.scene: Chili Palmer starts out in Miami
snacks.method: Crisp crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre, a Little Havana bakery classic. Melt 60g butter, cook 80g flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick.

snacks.name: Hollywood power lunch crudités
snacks.scene: the studio meetings Chili talks his way into
snacks.method: Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and baby cos with green goddess: blitz mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy and lemon.

snacks.name: Cuban pastelitos
snacks.scene: Chili's Miami, before he heads out to LA
snacks.method: Puff pastry squares filled with guava paste and cream cheese, brushed with egg, baked at 200C for 18 minutes and dusted with sugar while hot.

mains.name: Chili Palmer's steak frites
mains.scene: he knows exactly how a scene should go
mains.method: Sirloin seared hard and rested, sliced. Pan sauce: shallot sweated in the fat, red wine reduced, cold butter whisked in. Double-fried frites.

mains.name: Producer's cobb salad
mains.scene: Harry Zimm's lunch
mains.method: Rows of chopped chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese on cos with red wine vinaigrette.

dessert.name: B-movie popcorn sundae
dessert.scene: Harry's schlock horror films
dessert.method: Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge, a handful of caramel popcorn (popcorn tossed in brown sugar and butter caramel, baked to set) and salted peanuts.

drink.name: Bloody Mary
drink.method: 45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper, rolled between tins, celery stick.

films.title: The Freshman
films.tagline: Some lessons aren't taught at film school.
films.description: A film student gets a job with a man who looks a lot like Vito Corleone.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the Gourmet Club menu gets read out.

snacks.name: Little Italy antipasto
snacks.scene: Carmine's social club, where the job offer comes with a handshake
snacks.method: Salami, mortadella and provolone with roasted capsicum, marinated artichokes and a loaf of seeded Italian bread torn at the table.

snacks.name: Fried calamari
snacks.scene: the first meeting in Little Italy
snacks.method: Squid rings soaked 30 minutes in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds, salt and lemon.

snacks.name: Little Italy fried calamari
snacks.scene: Carmine's Little Italy neighbourhood
snacks.method: Tender squid rings in a light crisp coating, with lemon and marinara. Slice 500g squid tubes into rings, soak in 200ml milk for 20 minutes and toss in 120g flour mixed with 2 tbsp semolina and salt.

mains.name: Carmine's veal
mains.scene: the family dinner where Clark gets told how things work
mains.method: Thin veal floured and seared in butter, pan sauce of marsala, mushrooms and stock reduced and finished with cold butter.

mains.name: Gourmet Club alternative
mains.scene: roast chicken, nothing endangered on this menu
mains.method: Dry-brine a chicken overnight, butter and lemon under the skin, roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C until 72C in the thigh. Rest 15 minutes, roast potatoes in the fat.

dessert.name: Cannoli
dessert.scene: a box from Little Italy for the drive back to campus
dessert.method: Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar, vanilla and mini choc chips, piped into shells just before serving, pistachio ends.

drink.name: Chianti
drink.method: Chianti Classico at 16C, opened half an hour ahead and poured into tumblers.

films.title: Moonstruck
films.tagline: Snap out of it and eat.
films.description: A Brooklyn widow falls for her fiancé's angry baker brother under a big full moon.
films.serve_cue: Bring out the bread when Ronny is in the bakery basement.

snacks.name: Ronny's bakery bread
snacks.scene: crusty Italian loaf from the Cammareri Bros. ovens
snacks.method: Warm a crusty Italian loaf at 200C for 8 minutes. Tear at the table, pour a pool of grassy olive oil with flaky salt and cracked pepper.

snacks.name: Eggs in the hole
snacks.scene: Loretta's breakfast: a red capsicum ring and an egg in toast
snacks.method: Cut a hole in thick white bread, fry in butter, drop a thick ring of red capsicum in the pan with an egg inside it, cook until the white sets. Salt and pepper.

snacks.name: Antipasto
snacks.scene: Rose's kitchen table
snacks.method: Salami and provolone sliced thin, mixed olives warmed with orange peel, and roasted capsicum peeled and dressed with garlic, red wine vinegar and good oil.

mains.name: Grand Ticino linguine
mains.scene: the restaurant where the whole family keeps running into each other
mains.method: Linguine with clams steamed open in garlic, chilli and white wine, finished in the juices with parsley and olive oil.

mains.name: Chicken scaloppine
mains.scene: Cosmo's dinner with Mona
mains.method: Thin chicken breast floured and seared, lemon, white wine and butter pan sauce with capers and parsley.

dessert.name: Cannoli
dessert.scene: Brooklyn bakery, Ronny's turf
dessert.method: Drained ricotta with icing sugar and orange zest piped into shells at the last minute, chocolate-dipped ends.

drink.name: Brooklyn amaretto sours
drink.scene: Loretta's family, bottle of wine and a full moon
drink.method: Amaretto shaken with lemon and egg white until frothy, poured over ice with a cherry.

films.title: Big Night
films.tagline: One night to save the restaurant.
films.description: Two Italian brothers bet everything on one huge dinner to save their struggling restaurant.
films.serve_cue: Bring out the timpano when the dinner guests hold their breath.

snacks.name: Arancini
snacks.scene: Primo's kitchen, every grain treated with respect
snacks.method: Chilled saffron risotto rolled around mozzarella and peas, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold.

snacks.name: Risotto three ways
snacks.scene: red, white and green, the tricolore from the big night
snacks.method: One base risotto split three ways: tomato and basil, parmesan and butter, and pea and mint purée. Serve side by side in one shallow bowl.

snacks.name: Antipasto board
snacks.scene: the opening course of the big night
snacks.method: Prosciutto and bresaola laid flat, bresaola dressed with lemon, oil and rocket, marinated eggplant, peeled roast capsicum, olives and warm bread.

mains.name: Timpano
mains.scene: the giant baked pasta drum, sliced at the table
mains.method: Line a buttered dome with thin pasta dough. Layer ziti in ragù with salami, boiled egg, provolone and tiny meatballs, fold the dough over, bake at 180C for 1 hour, rest 30 minutes, turn out and cut like a cake.

mains.name: Roast suckling pig
mains.scene: the main event, or pork belly if your oven is small
mains.method: Score pork belly skin, dry overnight in the fridge, rub with salt and fennel seed. Roast at 160C for 2.5 hours, then blast at 240C until it crackles.

dessert.name: Panna cotta
dessert.scene: Primo's dessert, simple and perfect
dessert.method: Heat 500ml cream, 100ml milk, 80g sugar and a split vanilla pod, bloom 2 gelatine leaves, whisk in, pour into moulds, set 6 hours. Turn out with berries.

drink.name: Grappa
drink.method: Grappa slightly chilled in small glasses, an espresso alongside if anyone is still standing.

films.title: Raging Bull
films.tagline: Fight hard. Eat harder.
films.description: Boxer Jake LaMotta's rise and fall, inside the ring and out.
films.serve_cue: Serve the steak when Jake starts complaining his steak is overcooked.

snacks.name: Bronx arancini
snacks.scene: rice balls from Jake's Italian neighbourhood
snacks.method: Leftover risotto rolled around a cube of mozzarella, crumbed, fried at 180C until golden, served with warm marinara for dipping.

snacks.name: Boiled eggs
snacks.scene: fighter's weigh-in food
snacks.method: Eggs boiled exactly 7 minutes for a jammy yolk, iced, peeled, halved, celery salt and cracked pepper.

snacks.name: Copacabana prawns
snacks.scene: the nightclub where it all falls apart
snacks.method: Prawns poached and iced, with a sharp cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon.

mains.name: Jake's steak
mains.scene: cooked properly this time, nobody gets yelled at
mains.method: Dry-brine porterhouse overnight, sear in a smoking pan, baste with butter and garlic, pull at 52C, rest 8 minutes.

mains.name: Bronx Sunday gravy
mains.scene: Joey's family dinner
mains.method: Brown meatballs, sausage and pork neck bones, simmer in tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 2 hours, rigatoni.

dessert.name: Ricotta cake
dessert.scene: from the Bronx bakery on the corner
dessert.method: Beat 750g drained ricotta, 150g sugar, 4 eggs, lemon zest and vanilla, bake at 160C for 60 minutes, cool in the oven, icing sugar.

drink.name: Ice cold beer
drink.method: American lager in frosted glasses straight from the freezer.

films.title: Saturday Night Fever
films.tagline: Strut in. Fold your slice. Strut out.
films.description: A Brooklyn paint shop worker lives for Saturday nights on the 2001 Odyssey dance floor.
films.serve_cue: Serve the slices during the opening walk down 86th Street.

snacks.name: Bay Ridge sausage and peppers
snacks.scene: the paint store crew's Saturday
snacks.method: Grilled Italian sausage with sweet capsicum and onion, cut into bites and served on sticks.

snacks.name: Disco fries
snacks.scene: gravy and cheese at 2am after the club
snacks.method: Crisp fries smothered in hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella, under the grill for a minute.

mains.name: Two slices stacked
mains.scene: fold them together and keep walking, like Tony
mains.method: New York pie: cold-fermented dough stretched thin, thin tomato sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at the oven's max. Cut big, stack two, fold.

mains.name: Manero family spaghetti and meatballs
mains.scene: the family dinner where someone always gets a slap
mains.method: Pork and beef meatballs with soaked bread, egg and pecorino, browned, simmered in tomato sauce for an hour, spaghetti and more pecorino.

dessert.name: Disco ball cake pops
dessert.scene: silver sprinkles under the lights
dessert.method: Crumble butter cake with cream cheese frosting, roll balls, chill, dip in white chocolate, roll in silver cachous.

drink.name: 7 and 7
drink.method: 45ml blended whiskey topped with lemon-lime soda over ice.

films.title: My Cousin Vinny
films.tagline: Two yutes walk into a diner.
films.description: A Brooklyn mechanic turned lawyer defends his cousin in a small Alabama town.
films.serve_cue: Serve breakfast during the grits cross-examination.

snacks.name: Five-minute grits
snacks.scene: the grits cross-examination, nobody can cook them that fast
snacks.method: Stone-ground grits whisked into boiling salted milk and water, stirred low for 25 minutes until creamy. Finish with butter and sharp cheddar.

snacks.name: Fried green tomatoes
snacks.scene: Alabama's finest, with a remoulade
snacks.method: Slice green tomatoes 1cm, salt 10 minutes, dip in buttermilk then seasoned cornmeal, fry at 180C. Remoulade of mayo, mustard, capers and hot sauce.

snacks.name: Biscuits and sausage gravy
snacks.scene: the diner where Vinny tries to order breakfast
snacks.method: Grated frozen butter into self-raising flour, buttermilk, fold and cut, bake at 220C. Brown sausage meat, add flour, then milk, simmer thick with plenty of pepper.

mains.name: Sac-O-Suds chicken fried steak
mains.scene: the corner store where the whole mess started
mains.method: Pound thin steaks, dredge in seasoned flour, buttermilk, flour again, shallow-fry until crisp. Cream gravy from the pan with flour, milk and black pepper.

mains.name: Venison chilli
mains.scene: Vinny's hunting trip with the DA
mains.method: Brown venison or beef mince with onion, garlic and capsicum, add chilli powder, cumin, tomato and kidney beans, simmer 90 minutes. Cornbread alongside.

dessert.name: Mona Lisa's blackberry cobbler
dessert.scene: Wazoo, Alabama, ticking clock and all
dessert.method: Juicy blackberries baked under a soft biscuit topping, served warm with cream. Toss 750g blackberries with 100g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a dish.

drink.name: Sweet tea
drink.scene: Southern style, so sweet your teeth hurt
drink.method: Steep 6 black tea bags in 1 litre of just-boiled water for 5 minutes, stir in 150g sugar while hot, top with cold water, chill. Over ice with lemon.

films.id: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead (1995)
films.title: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead
films.tagline: Boat drinks.
films.description: A reformed crook pulls together an old crew for one last job that goes wrong.
films.serve_cue: Pour boat drinks every time someone says "boat drinks".

snacks.name: Afterlife Advice deviled eggs
snacks.scene: Jimmy's video business for the dying
snacks.method: Boil eggs 10 minutes, whip yolks with mayo, Dijon and pickle juice, pipe back in, paprika and chives.

snacks.name: Green chile queso
snacks.scene: Colorado green chile, with chips for dunking
snacks.method: Roasted green chiles chopped and stirred into melted white cheese with milk and garlic, served hot with corn chips for dunking.

mains.name: Patty melt
mains.scene: the diner booth where the job gets planned
mains.method: Thin beef patty on rye with Swiss and slow-cooked onions, griddled in butter until crisp outside and melted inside.

mains.name: Denver omelette
mains.scene: ham, capsicum and onion, the city's own breakfast
mains.method: Sauté diced ham, capsicum and onion, add 3 beaten eggs, fold with cheddar when just set.

dessert.name: Mile-high sopapillas
dessert.scene: Colorado dessert for Jimmy's last good night
dessert.method: Puffed little fried pastry pillows, split open and drizzled with honey and a pinch of cinnamon, the Denver diner way.

drink.name: Boat drinks
drink.method: Piña colada: 50ml white rum, 60ml pineapple juice and 40ml coconut cream blended with ice, cocktail umbrella.

films.title: The Departed
films.tagline: Two rats. One city. Plenty of chowder.
films.description: A cop goes undercover with Boston's Irish mob while a mob mole rises in the police.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Costigan and Sullivan figure out who the other one is.

snacks.name: Boston clam chowder cups
snacks.scene: with oyster crackers, the Boston way
snacks.method: Render bacon, sweat onion and celery, add diced potato, clam juice and thyme, simmer, add chopped clams and cream for the last 3 minutes. Oyster crackers.

snacks.name: Irish soda bread and butter
snacks.scene: Costello's South Boston Irish crowd
snacks.method: Wholemeal flour, bicarb, salt and buttermilk mixed into a soft round, cut with a deep cross, baked at 220C for 35 minutes, thick slices with salted butter.

snacks.name: Fried clams
snacks.scene: Boston Harbour clam shack
snacks.method: Clam meat soaked in evaporated milk, dredged in corn flour and plain flour, fried at 185C for 60 seconds. Tartare and lemon.

mains.name: Southie fish and chips
mains.scene: the Irish pub where the crew drinks
mains.method: Flathead or cod dipped in a batter of flour, cornflour and ice-cold lager, fried at 180C. Triple-cooked chips, mushy peas with mint, malt vinegar.

mains.name: Lobster roll
mains.scene: a Boston harbour classic
mains.method: Cooked lobster tossed lightly with mayo, lemon and celery, piled into butter-toasted split-top rolls, chives.

dessert.name: Boston cream pie
dessert.scene: the Boston original
dessert.method: Two genoise layers sandwiched with vanilla crème pâtissière, glossy dark chocolate ganache poured over the top.

drink.name: Cranberry juice
drink.scene: Costigan's bar order, a natural diuretic
drink.method: Cranberry juice over ice in a short glass. Add vodka if you want to keep your cover.

films.title: Road to Perdition
films.tagline: Every father wants better for his son.
films.description: A mob enforcer and his son go on the run across Depression-era Illinois.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert at the diner stop on the road to Perdition.

snacks.name: Diner pickles
snacks.scene: the roadside stops across Illinois
snacks.method: Quick pickles: sliced cucumber and green tomato in hot brine of vinegar, water, sugar, salt, dill seed and garlic, chilled overnight, served cold in a jar.

snacks.name: Farmhouse rye bread
snacks.scene: the old couple who take them in
snacks.method: Rye sourdough warmed at 180C for 8 minutes, salted butter and apple butter (apples cooked down slowly with cider and cinnamon).

snacks.name: Wake table soda bread
snacks.scene: the Rooney wake, 1931
snacks.method: Warm Irish soda bread with a craggy crust, torn and served with salted butter and sharp cheddar.

mains.name: Corned beef and cabbage
mains.scene: the Irish wake supper
mains.method: Slow-simmered corned beef sliced thick with buttery cabbage, carrots and potatoes and hot mustard. Simmer a 1.5kg corned silverside with an onion, 2 bay leaves and 6 peppercorns for 2.5 hours.

mains.name: Chicken pot pie
mains.scene: the diner stops on the run
mains.method: Poach chicken thighs, make a velouté with the stock, butter and flour, add peas, carrot and thyme, top with puff pastry, bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

dessert.name: Apple pie with cheddar
dessert.scene: farmhouse style, like the old couple would serve
dessert.method: Deep-dish apple pie with a slice of sharp cheddar melted on top in the last 5 minutes.

drink.name: Black coffee
drink.method: Drip coffee, strong and black, refilled until the car is ready.

films.title: Ghostbusters
films.tagline: Slime included. Ghosts not.
films.description: Three out-of-work scientists open a ghost removal business in a Manhattan firehouse.
films.serve_cue: Crack the drinks when Ecto-1 rolls out of the firehouse for the first time.

snacks.name: Slimer's slime dip
snacks.scene: green spinach and artichoke dip, corn chips for scooping
snacks.method: Wilt spinach, squeeze dry, chop with marinated artichokes, fold into cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan with garlic. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling.

snacks.name: Toasted marshmallow skewers
snacks.scene: in honour of the big guy
snacks.method: Big marshmallows on skewers, toasted over a flame until the outside blisters. Dip in melted dark chocolate and crushed biscuits.

snacks.name: Dana's fridge devilled eggs
snacks.scene: there's something in the fridge, and it isn't the eggs
snacks.method: Whip yolks with mayo, Dijon and a drop of green colouring, pipe back into whites, chives on top.

mains.name: Firehouse meatball sub
mains.scene: long enough for the whole crew
mains.method: Pork and beef meatballs baked then simmered in marinara, packed into a long roll with provolone and grilled until melted.

mains.name: Chinese takeaway at the firehouse
mains.scene: dumplings and fried rice eaten out of the boxes on the desk
mains.method: Fried rice with day-old rice, egg, lap cheong, spring onion and soy in a smoking wok. Pan-fried pork dumplings alongside.

dessert.name: Stay Puft s'mores
dessert.scene: giant marshmallows, toasted until they melt down
dessert.method: Big marshmallow toasted, sandwiched between digestive biscuits with a square of milk chocolate. Under the grill for 30 seconds if there's no fire.

drink.name: Ectoplasm slushie
drink.method: Blitz ice with lime cordial and lemonade until slushy, a drop of green colouring.

films.title: Ghostbusters II
films.tagline: Bad vibes. Good dip.
films.description: Five years on, the Ghostbusters find a river of pink slime under New York.
films.serve_cue: Bring dessert out when the Statue of Liberty starts walking.

snacks.name: Pink slime dip
snacks.scene: beetroot and feta, flatbread for scooping
snacks.method: Roast beetroot, blitz with feta, Greek yoghurt, garlic, lemon and dill until hot pink. Warm flatbread.

snacks.name: Dancing toaster crumpets
snacks.scene: the slime makes the toaster dance

films.title: Crocodile Dundee

films.title: Crocodile Dundee II

snacks.name: Snags on sticks
