films.tagline: The family gets bigger.
films.description: Riggs and Murtaugh take on a Triad gang smuggling people into LA.
films.serve_cue: Serve the Chinese food when Uncle Benny turns up.

snacks.name: Chinatown dumplings
snacks.scene: Uncle Benny's turf
snacks.method: Pork and prawn siu mai: pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake, ginger and soy in open wonton wrappers, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of carrot on top.

snacks.name: Murtaugh's boat snacks
snacks.scene: the fishing trip that goes wrong in the opening
snacks.method: Smoked fish dip: hot-smoked trout flaked into cream cheese with lemon, dill and horseradish, served with crackers.

snacks.name: Leo's wonton crisps
snacks.scene: Leo's back, and he will not stop talking
snacks.method: Wonton wrappers cut in triangles, fried at 180C until puffed, tossed in salt and five spice, sweet chilli dip.

mains.name: Uncle Benny's roast duck
mains.scene: Chinatown, where Uncle Benny runs things
mains.method: Duck pricked, dried overnight, rubbed with five spice and salt inside, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, glazed with honey and soy for the last 15. Pancakes, cucumber and hoisin.

mains.name: Murtaugh's barbecued fish
mains.scene: caught on his own boat, for once
mains.method: Whole snapper scored, stuffed with lemon and herbs, grilled over medium coals 10 minutes a side.

dessert.name: Fortune cookies
dessert.scene: Leo talks too much, his fortune says so
dessert.method: Thin vanilla batter in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while hot.

drink.name: Beer on the boat
drink.method: Cold lager in an esky on the deck.

films.title: Beverly Hills Cop
films.tagline: Detroit attitude. Beverly Hills prices.
films.description: A wisecracking Detroit cop goes to Beverly Hills to solve his best friend's murder.
films.serve_cue: Serve the bananas when Axel stuffs them up the cop car's exhaust.

snacks.name: Banana in the tailpipe bread
snacks.scene: banana bread bites for the stakeout car
snacks.method: Mash 3 overripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, an egg and vanilla, fold in 200g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt, bake at 170C for 55 minutes. Slice thick and toast in butter.

snacks.name: Harrow Club canapés
snacks.scene: the private club Axel talks his way into
snacks.method: Tiny croutes of toasted brioche with crème fraîche, smoked trout and chives, and grapes rolled in goat's cheese and crushed pistachios.

snacks.name: Detroit coney sliders
snacks.scene: home turf, a long way from Beverly Hills
snacks.method: Cocktail franks in mini buns topped with a loose beef chilli (fine mince, onion, chilli powder, cumin, a little water simmered 45 minutes), mustard and raw onion.

mains.name: Detroit coney dog
mains.scene: chilli, onion and mustard, the Motor City way
mains.method: Natural casing franks griddled, steamed buns, a spoon of loose coney chilli, yellow mustard and plenty of diced white onion.

mains.name: Beverly Palm room service
mains.scene: the steak sandwich Axel puts on someone else's tab
mains.method: Sirloin seared hard and sliced thin, caramelised onion, Swiss and horseradish mayo on a toasted brioche roll, fries on the side.

dessert.name: Banana split
dessert.scene: with the banana that didn't go in the tailpipe
dessert.method: Split banana, three scoops (vanilla, chocolate, strawberry), hot fudge, crushed pineapple, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.

drink.name: Detroit lager
drink.scene: Axel's home town in a bottle
drink.method: American lager ice cold in the bottle, a squeeze of lime for the Beverly Hills crowd.

films.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
films.tagline: Back in Beverly Hills.
films.description: Axel returns to LA to hunt the gang that shot Captain Bogomil.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Axel bluffs his way into the Playboy Mansion party.

snacks.name: Rodeo Drive mini quiches
snacks.scene: Axel crashing the Beverly Hills party circuit
snacks.method: Mini shortcrust cases filled with egg, cream, gruyère and bacon, baked at 180C for 15 minutes until just set.

snacks.name: Beverly Hills crudités
snacks.scene: the fancy end of town
snacks.method: Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and sugar snaps on ice with green goddess dressing (mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy, lemon).

snacks.name: Pierogi
snacks.scene: a taste of Detroit's Hamtramck, a long way from Beverly Hills
snacks.method: Potato and cheese dumplings boiled then pan-fried in butter with onions, sour cream on the side.

mains.name: Borrowed mansion barbecue
mains.scene: Axel moves into a house that isn't his
mains.method: Rib eye steaks and corn on the cob over hot coals, chimichurri (parsley, oregano, garlic, chilli, vinegar, oil) and a big potato salad.

mains.name: Hotel club sandwich
mains.scene: room service on someone else's account
mains.method: Three slices of toast: roast chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.

dessert.name: Banana split
dessert.scene: a nod to the first film
dessert.method: Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.

drink.name: Taggart and Rosewood beer
drink.scene: the two Beverly Hills cops along for the ride
drink.method: American lager ice cold, poured into a glass for Rosewood and drunk from the can by Taggart.

films.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
films.tagline: The theme park ride from hell.
films.description: Axel tracks a counterfeiting ring to a Southern California theme park.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the Spider ride gets stuck.

snacks.name: Wonder World popcorn
snacks.scene: the theme park
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.

snacks.name: Theme park churros
snacks.scene: waiting in line for the Spider
snacks.method: Choux dough piped in long ridged lengths into oil at 180C, fried until crisp and golden, then rolled in cinnamon sugar while hot.

snacks.name: Midway corn dogs
snacks.scene: the theme park midway
snacks.method: Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Mustard.

mains.name: Theme park turkey legs
mains.scene: the classic walk-and-eat
mains.method: Turkey drumsticks brined overnight in salt, brown sugar and smoked paprika, smoked or roasted at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls from the bone.

mains.name: Detroit-style square pizza
mains.scene: Axel's home town, crispy cheese edges and all
mains.method: Pizza dough pressed into an oiled rectangular tin, cheese right to the edges, sauce striped on top, baked at 250C until the edges go crisp and lacy.

dessert.name: Fairy floss and toffee apples
dessert.scene: the midway at closing time
dessert.method: Toffee apples: sugar, water and a splash of vinegar boiled to 150C, red colouring, apples dipped and set. Bought fairy floss alongside.

drink.name: Blue slushie
drink.scene: the queue on a hot day
drink.method: Blue raspberry cordial blitzed with lots of ice until slushy.

films.title: 48 Hrs.
films.tagline: Forty-eight hours. Eat fast.
films.description: A rough cop gets a convict out of prison for 48 hours to help catch a killer.
films.serve_cue: Pour drinks when Reggie walks into Torchy's redneck bar.

snacks.name: Torchy's bar peanuts
snacks.scene: there's a new sheriff in town
snacks.method: Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and cayenne, served in a tin bucket.

snacks.name: Prison canteen sandwiches
snacks.scene: Reggie's last lunch on the inside
snacks.method: Bologna and American cheese on white bread with yellow mustard, griddled in butter under a weight until crisp and melted.

snacks.name: San Francisco sourdough
snacks.scene: the city where it all goes down
snacks.method: Warm a sourdough round at 200C, tear and serve with salted butter whipped with roasted garlic.

mains.name: Jack's 3am diner breakfast
mains.scene: bacon and eggs between leads
mains.method: Thick bacon rendered crisp, eggs fried in the fat, hash browns (grated potato squeezed dry, fried in butter) and toast.

mains.name: San Francisco cioppino
mains.scene: the city's seafood stew
mains.method: Fennel, onion and garlic in olive oil, tomato, white wine and fish stock, then crab, clams, mussels, prawns and firm fish in order of cooking time. Sourdough.

dessert.name: Jailhouse chocolate cake
dessert.scene: Reggie's release, with a pay cheque waiting
dessert.method: One-bowl chocolate cake (flour, sugar, cocoa, oil, buttermilk, hot coffee) baked at 170C for 35 minutes, fudge icing.

drink.name: Cold beer at Torchy's
drink.method: American lager in a long neck, ice cold.

films.title: Another 48 Hrs.
films.tagline: Same pair. More hours.
films.description: Jack Cates needs Reggie again to catch a dealer called the Iceman.
films.serve_cue: Serve dinner when the prison bus crashes.

snacks.name: Biker bar pickled eggs
snacks.scene: the biker bar shootout
snacks.method: Boiled eggs pickled pink in spiced vinegar with beetroot, straight from the jar on the bar.

snacks.name: Glovebox jerky
snacks.scene: the snacks in Jack's beat-up car
snacks.method: Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and pepper overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.

mains.name: Stakeout diner burger
mains.scene: eaten on the stakeout in the car
mains.method: Thick chuck patty seasoned at the last moment, griddled to medium, cheddar melted under a lid, onion and pickles on a toasted bun.

mains.name: Sourdough bread bowl chowder
mains.scene: San Francisco, where the case plays out
mains.method: Bacon, onion, celery and potato, clams and their juice, cream and thyme, ladled into hollowed toasted sourdough rounds.

dessert.name: Chinatown egg tarts
dessert.scene: San Francisco after the case
dessert.method: Flaky little tarts filled with a wobbly, just-set sweet egg custard. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 12 rounds and press into a muffin tin.

drink.name: Jack's beer
drink.method: American lager in the bottle, cold enough to fog up the glass.

films.title: Tango & Cash
films.tagline: Two cops. One shower. Zero patience.
films.description: Two rival LA cops are framed and have to break out of prison together.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the armoured RV rolls out.

snacks.name: Prison canteen sandwiches
snacks.scene: the inside, after the frame-up
snacks.method: Bologna, yellow mustard and American cheese on white bread, griddled in butter under a weight until crisp.

snacks.name: LA street tacos
snacks.scene: the chase across East LA
snacks.method: Marinated beef grilled hot and chopped small, in warm corn tortillas with onion, coriander, salsa verde and lime.

snacks.name: Kiki's club canapés
snacks.scene: Tango's sister's club
snacks.method: Poached prawns on cucumber rounds with a dot of chilli mayo, and mini tomato bruschetta on toasted baguette.

mains.name: Tango's tailored rib eye
mains.scene: the sharp dresser
mains.method: Rib eye dry-brined, seared hard, basted with butter and thyme, pulled at 54C, rested, sliced.

mains.name: Prison mess hall meatloaf
mains.scene: the slop they break out to get away from
mains.method: Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour, thick slices with mashed potato and peas.

dessert.name: Kiki's cupcakes
dessert.scene: the club where Tango's sister dances
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, piped with pink buttercream and covered in sprinkles.

drink.name: Breakout beer
drink.scene: the first beer after the breakout
drink.method: Cold lager straight from the bottle, clinked hard.

films.title: Red Heat
films.tagline: Moscow toughness. Chicago appetite.
films.description: A stone-faced Soviet cop teams up with a smart-mouthed Chicago detective.
films.serve_cue: Pour the vodka when Danko orders his first drink in Chicago.

snacks.name: Pickled herring on rye
snacks.scene: a taste of Danko's Moscow
snacks.method: Herring fillets in a sour cream, dill and red onion sauce on buttered dark rye.

snacks.name: Danko's Georgian cheese bread
snacks.scene: a taste of home for a Moscow cop
snacks.method: Boat-shaped khachapuri filled with molten cheese, a runny egg and butter stirred through at the table.

snacks.name: Russian piroshki
snacks.scene: beef and onion pastries
snacks.method: Yeasted dough wrapped around beef, onion, rice and dill filling, fried at 175C until golden.

mains.name: Beef stroganoff
mains.scene: mushrooms, sour cream and buttered noodles
mains.method: Strips of eye fillet seared fast and set aside, mushrooms and onion browned, paprika, mustard and stock reduced, sour cream stirred in off the heat, beef back in.

mains.name: Chicago deep dish
mains.scene: Ridzik's turf in Chicago
mains.method: Buttery cornmeal crust up a deep tin, mozzarella, raw sausage layer, chunky tomato on top, parmesan, baked at 220C for 35 minutes.

dessert.name: Medovik honey cake
dessert.scene: Russian layers for the Soviet cop
dessert.method: Honey dough (honey, butter, sugar, eggs, bicarb, flour) rolled into thin discs, baked 6 minutes each, layered with sour cream and condensed milk cream, crumbs on the outside, rested overnight.

drink.name: Vodka, ice cold
drink.method: Vodka from the freezer in small chilled glasses, rye bread and a pickle to follow.

films.title: Turner & Hooch
films.tagline: Neat freak meets slobbery dog.
films.description: A fussy small-town detective inherits a slobbering dog who witnessed a murder.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Hooch wrecks the car.

snacks.name: Monterey Jack cheese crisps
snacks.scene: Cypress Beach on the California coast
snacks.method: Grated Monterey Jack baked in small piles at 200C for 7 minutes until lacy and golden, cooled into crisps, with salsa.

snacks.name: Seafood plant prawns
snacks.scene: the seafood plant at the centre of the case
snacks.method: Garlic prawns: prawns sautéed in oil with sliced garlic, chilli and butter, white wine, parsley, bread for the pan.

snacks.name: Dog bone crackers
snacks.scene: for Hooch, who eats everything anyway
snacks.method: Parmesan crackers cut into bone shapes: flour, butter, parmesan and an egg, rolled 4mm, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.

mains.name: Steak, and the bone for Hooch
mains.scene: Turner's tidy dinner, interrupted
mains.method: T-bone seared and finished at 200C, rested, with garlic butter, roast potatoes and green beans.

mains.name: Fish and chips
mains.scene: the seafood plant down the road
mains.method: Flathead dipped in a beer batter (flour, cornflour, cold lager), fried at 180C, double-fried chips, tartare and lemon.

dessert.name: Puppuccino sundaes
dessert.scene: for the humans this time
dessert.method: Vanilla ice cream with whipped cream, crushed shortbread and a drizzle of salted caramel (sugar cooked amber, cream and salt).

drink.name: Fresh orange juice
drink.scene: Turner's neat-freak breakfast, before Hooch moves in
drink.method: Oranges squeezed fresh into a jug, served cold over ice in tidy glasses.

films.title: Stakeout
films.tagline: Watch the girl. Eat the doughnuts.
films.description: Two Seattle cops on surveillance duty, and one falls for the woman they're watching.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Bill and Chris start their movie trivia game.

snacks.name: Stakeout doughnuts
snacks.scene: the rations in the surveillance van
snacks.method: Cake doughnuts warmed for 2 minutes, then shaken in a paper bag with cinnamon sugar until coated.

snacks.name: Surveillance snack mix
snacks.scene: eaten in the dark across the road
snacks.method: Pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and sunflower seeds tossed in butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder, baked at 130C for 45 minutes.

snacks.name: Seattle smoked salmon
snacks.scene: the Seattle waterfront
snacks.method: Hot-smoked salmon flaked onto crackers with a spoon of crème fraîche, dill and a squeeze of lemon.

mains.name: Maria's home cooking
mains.scene: the dinner Chris shouldn't be eating
mains.method: Chicken enchiladas: shredded chicken in corn tortillas, red chilli sauce, cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.

mains.name: Seattle fish and chips
mains.scene: the waterfront between shifts
mains.method: Cod dipped in a batter of flour, cornflour and ice-cold lager, fried at 180C. Double-fried chips, tartare and lemon.

dessert.name: Doughnut holes
dessert.scene: surveillance treats for the night shift
dessert.method: Yeasted dough proved an hour, rolled into balls, fried at 175C for 2 minutes, rolled in cinnamon sugar while warm.

drink.name: Thermos coffee
drink.method: Strong coffee in a thermos with milk and sugar.

films.title: Kindergarten Cop
films.tagline: It's not a tumour. It's lunch.
films.description: A tough cop goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher in Astoria, Oregon.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Kimble blows the whistle in class.

snacks.name: Lunch box crackers and cheese
snacks.scene: snack time for the whole class
snacks.method: Cheddar cut into little squares with crackers, apple slices tossed in lemon so they don't brown, and cherry tomatoes, packed into lunch boxes.

snacks.name: Ferret-free fruit cups
snacks.scene: for the class pet, who stays in his cage
snacks.method: Diced mango, pineapple, strawberries and grapes in cups with a squeeze of orange and a mint leaf.

snacks.name: Astoria smoked fish
snacks.scene: the Oregon coast town where he hides out
snacks.method: Flake hot-smoked salmon into cream cheese with lemon juice, dill and chopped capers, keep it chunky, serve with rye crackers and cucumber.

mains.name: Homemade fish fingers and chips
mains.scene: the school lunch special, done properly
mains.method: Firm white fish cut into fingers, flour, egg and panko, shallow-fried until golden. Oven chips, tartare and frozen peas.

mains.name: Kimble's protein steak
mains.scene: the cop part of the job
mains.method: Rump steak dry-brined, seared hard, rested, with a big green salad and a baked potato with sour cream.

dessert.name: Kindergarten cupcakes
dessert.scene: for the class party at the end
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, iced with bright buttercream in primary colours and topped with sprinkles.

drink.name: Chocolate milk
drink.scene: class snack time in little cartons
drink.method: Cocoa and sugar whisked into a little hot milk, then topped up with cold milk and chilled.

films.title: Police Academy
films.tagline: Cadets, report to dinner.
films.description: A bunch of misfits sign up for the police academy.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the cadets end up at the Blue Oyster bar.

snacks.name: Mess hall cornbread
snacks.scene: academy breakfast at dawn
snacks.method: Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, pour into a hot buttered cast iron pan, bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

snacks.name: Blue Oyster bar oysters
snacks.scene: the bar the cadets accidentally wander into
snacks.method: Oysters on ice with a shallot mignonette and lemon, or grilled with garlic butter for the nervous.

mains.name: Mess hall meatloaf
mains.scene: Tackleberry would eat it standing up
mains.method: Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash.

dessert.name: Graduation cake
dessert.scene: the class of eighty-four makes it
dessert.method: Vanilla slab cake with buttercream, piped with a police badge and "Graduates" in blue icing.

drink.name: Academy lemonade
drink.method: Fresh lemonade: lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water over ice with mint.

films.title: Bad Boys
films.tagline: Whatcha gonna eat?
films.description: Two Miami narcotics detectives swap identities to protect a witness.
films.serve_cue: Serve dinner when Marcus has to pretend to be Mike.

snacks.name: Miami croquetas
snacks.scene: the city's Cuban counter snack
snacks.method: Thick béchamel with finely chopped ham and nutmeg, chilled overnight, rolled into logs, egg and crumb, fried at 180C until golden.

snacks.name: Conch fritters
snacks.scene: South Beach seafood shack
snacks.method: Chopped prawn or calamari (conch is hard to find) in a batter of flour, egg, milk, capsicum, onion and celery, fried in spoonfuls at 180C, lime mayo.

snacks.name: Fried sweet plantains
snacks.scene: Little Havana side order
snacks.method: Very ripe plantains sliced on the bias, fried in oil at medium heat until caramelised and soft, flaky salt.

mains.name: Miami Cuban sandwich
mains.scene: the stakeout outside the club
mains.method: Cuban bread (or a soft long roll) with mustard, mojo pork, leg ham, Swiss and pickles, buttered and pressed until crisp and flat.

mains.name: Jerk chicken
mains.scene: the family barbecue at Marcus's house
mains.method: Thighs marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, spring onion, garlic, soy and lime, grilled slowly over coals until charred. Rice and peas.

dessert.name: Key lime pie
dessert.scene: Florida's own pie
dessert.method: Biscuit crust baked 10 minutes. Whisk 400g condensed milk, 4 yolks and 120ml lime juice with zest, bake at 160C for 15 minutes, chill, whipped cream.

drink.name: Mojito
drink.scene: Mike's apartment with the ocean view
drink.method: Mint muddled gently with sugar syrup and lime, white rum and crushed ice, topped with soda.

films.title: Rush Hour
films.tagline: Two cops. One case. Several misunderstandings.
films.description: A Hong Kong inspector and a loudmouth LA cop team up to find a kidnapped girl.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Lee walks into the Foo Chow restaurant.

snacks.name: Chinatown dumplings
snacks.scene: the Foo Chow kitchen
snacks.method: Har gow style prawn dumplings: chopped prawn, bamboo shoot and sesame in wonton wrappers, steamed 7 minutes, chilli oil and soy.

snacks.name: Consulate spring rolls
snacks.scene: the consulate party
snacks.method: Cabbage, carrot, shiitake and glass noodles stir-fried, cooled, rolled in spring roll pastry, fried at 180C. Sweet chilli.

snacks.name: Carter's hot wings
snacks.scene: Carter's order, extra hot
snacks.method: Wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce and butter, ranch dip.

mains.name: Foo Chow noodles
mains.scene: the Chinatown restaurant where it all kicks off
mains.method: Beef chow fun: wide rice noodles wok-fried hot with marinated beef, bean sprouts, spring onion, dark and light soy.

mains.name: LA soul food plate
mains.scene: fried chicken and collard greens, Carter's order
mains.method: Buttermilk fried chicken fried at 165C, greens braised 90 minutes with smoked ham hock and vinegar, baked mac and cheese.

dessert.name: Fortune cookies
dessert.scene: crack them open over the case
dessert.method: Thin vanilla batter in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around paper fortunes while hot.

drink.name: Chinese lager
drink.method: Chinese pale lager, ice cold, or jasmine tea for Lee.

films.title: Rush Hour 2
films.tagline: Hong Kong. Vegas. Repeat.
films.description: Carter and Lee chase a counterfeiting ring from Hong Kong to Las Vegas.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when they hit the Red Dragon casino.

snacks.name: Hong Kong egg tarts
snacks.scene: street snacks in Hong Kong
snacks.method: Shortcrust or puff pastry cases filled with egg custard (eggs, milk, sugar syrup, evaporated milk), baked at 200C for 15 minutes until just set.

snacks.name: Siu mai
snacks.scene: dim sum in Hong Kong
snacks.method: Pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake, ginger and soy in open wonton wrappers, steamed 8 minutes, carrot on top.

snacks.name: Red Dragon casino prawns
snacks.scene: the Las Vegas casino
snacks.method: Salt and pepper prawns: shell-on prawns dusted in potato starch, fried at 190C, tossed with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion.

mains.name: Hong Kong roast goose
mains.scene: Lee's home town
mains.method: Roast duck (goose is hard to find): five spice and salt inside, skin dried overnight, glazed with maltose or honey, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes. Plum sauce, rice.

mains.name: Vegas buffet plate
mains.scene: Carter's dream night
mains.method: Carved roast beef with gravy, crab legs, mac and cheese and a bread roll, all on one plate.

dessert.name: Mango sago
dessert.scene: Hong Kong dessert
dessert.method: Cook sago pearls until clear, rinse, chill. Blend mango with coconut milk and evaporated milk, fold in sago, top with diced mango and pomelo.

drink.name: Hong Kong milk tea
drink.scene: strong and sweet, pulled through a cloth
drink.method: Brew strong black tea for 5 minutes, strain through a fine cloth twice, add evaporated milk and sugar. Hot or over ice.

films.title: Point Break
films.tagline: Surf, rob, eat, repeat.
films.description: An FBI agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfing bank robbers.
films.serve_cue: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny Utah orders two.

snacks.name: Bodhi's surf shack fish tacos
snacks.scene: after a dawn surf with Bodhi
snacks.method: Crispy battered fish in small tortillas with slaw, lime and chipotle mayo. Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 180ml cold beer and fry at 180C until golden.

snacks.name: Beach bonfire prawns
snacks.scene: Bodhi's crew around the fire
snacks.method: King prawns skewered with garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals 90 seconds a side.

mains.name: Utah's two meatball subs
mains.scene: get me two, extra sauce
mains.method: Pork and beef meatballs simmered an hour in marinara, packed into long rolls with provolone, grilled until melted. Two each.

mains.name: Bodhi's beach fish tacos
mains.scene: before the ultimate ride
mains.method: Flathead strips in a beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and chipotle crema (sour cream, chipotle, lime).

dessert.name: Banana split
dessert.scene: Pappas would approve, probably
dessert.method: Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.

drink.name: Beer by the bonfire
drink.method: Mexican lager with a wedge of lime, ice cold from a cooler in the sand.

films.title: Speed
films.tagline: Keep it above 50.
films.description: A bomb on a city bus will explode if it drops below 50 miles per hour.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the bus jumps the freeway gap.

snacks.name: Bus stop coffee and pretzels
snacks.scene: Jack's morning coffee before the bus blows up
snacks.method: Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, mustard, with drip coffee in paper cups.

snacks.name: LAX runway nachos
snacks.scene: the loops around the airport runway
snacks.method: Corn chips layered with cheddar, jalapeños and black beans, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, then sour cream and salsa.

snacks.name: Subway train snacks
snacks.scene: the final chase underground
snacks.method: Hard pretzels and roasted peanuts tossed with butter and smoked paprika, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.

mains.name: LA street tacos
mains.scene: the streets of LA at full speed
mains.method: Carne asada: skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, grilled hot, chopped, in doubled corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.

dessert.name: Ice cream sandwiches
dessert.scene: it's a hot day on the freeway
dessert.method: Soft choc chip cookies sandwiched with a thick slab of vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in sprinkles, frozen hard for an hour.

drink.name: Annie's coffee
drink.scene: her first day driving the bus
drink.method: Iced coffee: cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

films.title: Last Action Hero
films.tagline: Jack Slater. Pass the popcorn.
films.description: A kid with a magic movie ticket gets pulled into the world of his favourite action hero.

dessert.name: Cinnamon buns
dessert.scene: for the cold Blackeberg winter
dessert.method: Cardamom-scented yeasted dough rolled with butter, sugar and cinnamon, cut, knotted, proved, baked at 220C for 10 minutes, pearl sugar on top.

drink.name: Hot blackcurrant
drink.method: Blackcurrant cordial topped with hot water and a squeeze of lemon.

films.title: The Babadook
films.tagline: If it's in a word or in a look, you can't get rid of dessert.
films.description: A grieving mother and her son are haunted by a sinister storybook creature.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Amelia reads the pop-up book.

snacks.name: Pop-up book crackers
snacks.scene: fold them up like the pages
snacks.method: Lavash cut into rectangles, scored down the middle, brushed with oil and salt, baked folded open at 180C until crisp.

snacks.name: Black pepper popcorn
snacks.scene: for the top hat and the dark
snacks.method: Pop kernels in a lidded pot with a little oil, then toss straight away in melted butter, heaps of cracked black pepper, finely grated parmesan and fine salt so it sticks while the corn is hot.

snacks.name: Samuel's lunch box fairy bread
snacks.scene: Samuel's party with his cousin Ruby
snacks.method: Fresh white bread spread right to the edges with soft butter, pressed face down into a plate of hundreds and thousands, crusts trimmed and cut into triangles. Make it close to serving so it stays soft.

mains.name: Amelia's slow-cooked stew
mains.scene: the long sleepless nights
mains.method: Lamb shanks browned, braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, red wine, tomato and rosemary. Mash.

mains.name: Midnight cheese toasties
mains.scene: Amelia up all night with the TV and no sleep
mains.method: Sourdough buttered on the outside, filled with vintage cheddar, a smear of Dijon and thin ham, cooked slowly in a heavy pan over medium-low heat with a lid on until the cheese runs and the bread is deep golden.

dessert.name: Samuel's birthday jelly slice
dessert.scene: Samuel's party at his cousin's
dessert.method: An Aussie classic: biscuit base, condensed milk lemon filling and raspberry jelly on top. Press 250g crushed biscuits and 125g melted butter into a tin.

drink.name: Warm milk with honey
drink.scene: Amelia, desperate for one night's sleep
drink.method: Milk warmed gently with a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon, served in mugs before bed.

films.title: It Follows
films.tagline: Walk, don't run, to the buffet.
films.description: A young woman in Detroit is followed by something that only ever walks towards her.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the gang heads to the public pool for the last stand.

snacks.name: Coney dog bites
snacks.scene: a nod to the film's Detroit setting
snacks.method: Cocktail franks simmered 5 minutes, tucked into split mini rolls, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin and paprika, a stripe of yellow mustard and finely diced raw onion.

snacks.name: Backyard pool chips and dip
snacks.scene: Jay floating in her above-ground pool in the opening
snacks.method: Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives, served with thick ridged potato chips.

snacks.name: Yara's clamshell crackers
snacks.scene: Yara reading out loud from her shell-shaped e-reader
snacks.method: Lavash cut into squares, folded in half over a ball of foil, brushed with oil and sesame, baked at 180C for 8 minutes until set open like a shell. Filled with whipped feta.

mains.name: Coney dogs with the works
mains.scene: Detroit's own hot dog, made the long way
mains.method: Fine beef mince simmered 45 minutes with onion, chilli powder, cumin, paprika and a little beef stock until loose and saucy, spooned over griddled franks in steamed buns, raw onion and mustard.

mains.name: Late-night Greek diner gyros
mains.scene: driving the Detroit suburbs all night
mains.method: Pork marinated with garlic, oregano and lemon, griddled and sliced, wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and chips.

dessert.name: Ice cream sandwiches
dessert.scene: a slow summer with nowhere to go
dessert.method: Soft chocolate cookies baked at 175C for 9 minutes, cooled, sandwiched with a thick slice of vanilla ice cream, rolled in mini choc chips and frozen an hour before serving.

drink.name: Poolside lemonade
drink.method: Lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water in a big jug, sliced lemon and plenty of ice.

films.title: The Witch
films.tagline: Wouldst thou like to eat deliciously?
films.description: A Puritan family in 1630s New England falls apart after their baby vanishes at the edge of the woods.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Black Phillip shows up in the yard.

snacks.name: Skillet cornbread
snacks.scene: the corn crop William can't save
snacks.method: Cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, poured into a smoking hot buttered cast iron pan and baked at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter alongside.

snacks.name: Woodland apples and cheese
snacks.scene: Caleb's red apple, the one from the woods
snacks.method: Crisp red apples sliced thin and tossed in lemon, fanned out with sharp aged cheddar, walnuts toasted at 170C for 8 minutes and a drizzle of honey.

snacks.name: Farmhouse baked eggs
snacks.scene: the hens in the yard
snacks.method: Eggs cracked into buttered ramekins over a spoon of cream and wilted spinach, baked in a water bath at 180C for 12 minutes until the whites set and yolks stay soft. Toast fingers.

mains.name: Black Phillip's goat stew
mains.scene: the goat in the yard, or lamb if goat's a step too far
mains.method: Goat or lamb shoulder in big pieces browned hard, onion, carrot and garlic softened, stock, thyme and bay, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until it falls apart. Barley bread.

mains.name: Colonial pottage
mains.scene: what a farm family lives on through winter
mains.method: Pearl barley, split peas, leek, turnip and parsnip simmered slowly in ham hock stock for 2 hours, the meat picked back in, finished with parsley and a spoon of butter.

dessert.name: Baked apples
dessert.scene: from the orchard, honey and spice
dessert.method: Apples cored, filled with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped dates, a splash of cider in the dish, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, basted twice. Pouring cream.

drink.name: Mulled cider
drink.method: Cloudy apple juice simmered gently with cinnamon sticks, cloves, star anise and strips of orange peel for 15 minutes, strained and ladled into mugs.

films.title: Train to Busan
films.tagline: Next stop: dinner.
films.description: Passengers fight to survive a zombie outbreak on a high-speed train from Seoul to Busan.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks as the train pulls out of Seoul station.

snacks.name: Station gimbap
snacks.scene: the snack you grab before the train leaves
snacks.method: Short grain rice seasoned with sesame oil and salt, rolled in nori with pickled radish, egg omelette strips, blanched spinach, carrot and ham, sliced thick.

snacks.name: Korean fried chicken
snacks.scene: for the long ride, if you're lucky
snacks.method: Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C, tossed in gochujang, soy, honey and garlic glaze with sesame seeds.

snacks.name: Spicy rice cakes
snacks.scene: Busan street stall tteokbokki
snacks.method: Cylinder rice cakes soaked 20 minutes, simmered in anchovy stock with gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and fish cake until glossy and thick, spring onion over the top.

mains.name: Busan pork soup
mains.scene: dwaeji gukbap, the dish Busan is known for
mains.method: Pork bones blanched, then simmered 4 hours with onion, garlic and ginger until milky, sliced pork belly added, served over rice with salted shrimp, chives and gochugaru.

mains.name: Kimchi fried rice
mains.scene: quick, hot and from the dining car
mains.method: Cold rice fried in a smoking pan with chopped aged kimchi and its juice, bacon, gochujang and butter, pressed to crisp on the bottom, topped with a fried egg and nori.

dessert.name: Hotteok
dessert.scene: Busan street pancakes
dessert.method: Sweet yeasted dough rested an hour, filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped peanuts, pressed flat in an oiled pan and fried until the sugar melts inside.

drink.name: Banana milk
drink.method: Ripe banana blended with cold full cream milk, a little honey and a pinch of salt, strained and served very cold.

films.title: Get Out
films.tagline: Sink into dessert.
films.description: A young Black man visits his girlfriend's family for the weekend and uncovers something horrifying.
films.serve_cue: Serve the cereal when Rose eats her coloured cereal with the milk in a separate glass.

snacks.name: Coloured cereal, milk on the side
snacks.scene: Rose's late-night snack, kept apart
snacks.method: Bright coloured cereal tipped into white bowls, cold milk poured into tall glasses with a straw, never mixed. Add a few fresh berries if you want.

snacks.name: Garden party canapés
snacks.scene: the Armitages' guests on the lawn
snacks.method: Blinis topped with crème fraîche, cold-smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest, and cucumber rounds with whipped goat's cheese and chives, laid on silver trays.

mains.name: Lawn party lamb
mains.scene: grilled on the Armitages' lawn
mains.method: Butterflied lamb leg marinated overnight in garlic, rosemary, lemon and olive oil, grilled over high heat to 55C, rested 15 minutes, sliced with salsa verde.

mains.name: Rod's hot dogs
mains.scene: Rod from the TSA, the friend who works it out
mains.method: Franks split and griddled until charred, onions cooked slowly in butter and a splash of beer, piled in toasted buns with mustard and sweet relish.

dessert.name: Teacup panna cotta
dessert.scene: Missy stirring her tea with a silver spoon
dessert.method: Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm cream with sugar and a split vanilla bean, set in teacups for 4 hours, a spoon of berry compote on top. Serve with a silver spoon.

drink.name: Missy's tea
drink.scene: stirred slowly with a silver spoon
drink.method: Black tea brewed in a china pot, poured into teacups with milk and sugar, stirred slowly with a silver spoon.

films.title: Hereditary
films.tagline: Family dinner is mandatory.
films.description: After their grandmother dies, a grieving family uncovers what she left behind.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains at the family dinner where nobody holds back.

snacks.name: Miniature sandwiches
snacks.scene: Annie's tiny dollhouse rooms
snacks.method: Crustless finger sandwiches of egg and cress, cucumber and cream cheese, and ham and mustard, cut into exact little squares and stood up like a model.

snacks.name: Model house cheese board
snacks.scene: built to scale like Annie's work
snacks.method: Small squares of aged cheddar, brie and blue arranged like rooms on a board, with lavash, grapes and quince paste for the furniture.

snacks.name: Charlie's nut-free seed crackers
snacks.scene: nothing with nuts in this house
snacks.method: Crisp baked crackers made from sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, with a beetroot dip. Mix 80g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 2 tbsp chia, 250ml water and salt and stand 15 minutes.

mains.name: The family dinner
mains.scene: roast chicken nobody says much over
mains.method: Chicken dry-brined overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C until the thigh hits 75C, rested, with roast potatoes, carrots and pan gravy.

mains.name: Grief group casserole
mains.scene: what Joan brings round
mains.method: Chicken thighs, mushrooms and leeks in a white wine and cream sauce, topped with puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until puffed.

dessert.name: Nut-free chocolate cake
dessert.scene: Charlie can't have nuts, so this one has none
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 35 minutes, glazed with ganache. Check every label for nuts.

drink.name: Red wine
drink.scene: Annie pours a glass at the end of the night
drink.method: A medium-bodied Shiraz opened half an hour early, served just under room temperature.

films.title: A Quiet Place
films.tagline: Don't make a sound. Not even when you chew.
films.description: A family lives in silence on a farm to avoid blind creatures that hunt by sound.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the family eats dinner off leaves instead of plates.

snacks.name: Leaf plate dinner
snacks.scene: the Abbotts serve dinner on leaves, no clattering plates
snacks.method: Butter lettuce cups filled with soft rice, shredded poached chicken, cucumber and herbs, dressed with lime and fish sauce. No crunch anywhere.

snacks.name: Silent soft pretzels
snacks.scene: quieter than chips
snacks.method: Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, with a soft cheese dip of cheddar melted into evaporated milk.

snacks.name: Corn silo cornbread bites
snacks.scene: the corn silo, minus the danger
snacks.method: Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, poured into a buttered mini muffin tin and baked at 200C for 12 minutes. Soft, not crunchy.

mains.name: Lee's river trout
mains.scene: caught at the river by the waterfall where they can talk
mains.method: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, wrapped in foil with butter, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, opened at the table. New potatoes on the side.

mains.name: Slow-cooked farmhouse beef
mains.scene: a pot that cooks without a sound
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, onion, carrot and celery, stock and thyme, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until it falls apart. Soft polenta underneath.

dessert.name: Soft vanilla custard
dessert.scene: no crunching allowed
dessert.method: Yolks whisked with sugar and cornflour, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat until thick, vanilla added, chilled in cups with poached pears.

drink.name: Waterfall water
drink.scene: the only loud place in the film
drink.method: Chilled sparkling water poured slowly over cucumber and mint, so nothing clinks.

films.title: Sinners
films.tagline: Open the juke joint. Close the doors.
films.description: Twin brothers come home to 1930s Mississippi to open a juke joint, and something comes knocking.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the juke joint opens for the night.

snacks.name: Juke joint hush puppies
snacks.scene: opening night snacks at the bar
snacks.method: Fine cornmeal and flour mixed with buttermilk, egg, grated onion and a pinch of sugar, rested 10 minutes, spooned into 175C oil and fried golden. Hot sauce butter to dip.

snacks.name: Delta catfish bites
snacks.scene: a taste of the Mississippi Delta
snacks.method: Catfish or flathead strips soaked in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged in seasoned cornmeal, fried at 180C for 3 minutes, with a lemon and dill remoulade.

snacks.name: Garlic toast
snacks.scene: Annie keeps garlic close, and she knows why
snacks.method: Thick slices of white bread spread with butter mashed with a whole head of roasted garlic, parsley and salt, toasted at 200C until crisp at the edges.

mains.name: Catfish fry
mains.scene: Friday night food for a Delta juke joint
mains.method: Fish fillets seasoned with salt, cayenne and paprika, dredged in cornmeal, fried at 180C until crisp, served with coleslaw, sliced white bread, pickles and hot sauce.

mains.name: Smothered pork chops
mains.scene: a plate to keep the band going all night
mains.method: Thick pork chops seasoned, floured and browned, then simmered 40 minutes in an onion gravy made from a dark roux, chicken stock and thyme. White rice.

dessert.name: Sweet potato pie
dessert.scene: something sweet to close out the night
dessert.method: Roasted sweet potato mashed smooth with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.

drink.name: Juke joint Irish stout
drink.scene: the twins bought the beer from an Irishman
drink.method: Dark Irish stout poured in two stages for a thick creamy head. Tilt each glass and pour the stout three-quarters full, let it settle for a minute, then top up slowly for a tight head.

films.title: Shutter Island
films.tagline: Eat like a marshal. Sleep like a patient.
films.description: A US marshal hunts for a missing patient at an island hospital and starts to doubt his own mind.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the hurricane hits the island.

snacks.name: Ferry crossing chowder cups
snacks.scene: Teddy seasick on the ferry out of Boston
snacks.method: Small cups of thick clam chowder (method below), topped with crumbled crisp bacon, chives and oyster crackers, served hot.

snacks.name: Lighthouse cheese straws
snacks.scene: the lighthouse Teddy is warned away from
snacks.method: Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in grated parmesan, paprika and cayenne, folded, cut into strips, twisted and baked at 200C for 12 minutes.

snacks.name: Boston baked beans on toast
snacks.scene: 1950s Boston pantry food
snacks.method: Navy beans slow cooked with molasses, mustard, onion and bacon at 150C for three hours, piled onto hot buttered toast.

mains.name: New England clam chowder
mains.scene: something to warm the marshals during the storm
mains.method: Clams steamed open in white wine, liquor strained. Bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk added, simmered, cream and clams in at the end, thyme.

mains.name: Ashecliffe staff roast
mains.scene: a proper dinner for the staff, cut off by the storm
mains.method: Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved thin, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and a red wine gravy.

dessert.name: Boston cream pie
dessert.scene: back home in Boston
dessert.method: Two layers of vanilla sponge baked at 175C, filled with thick vanilla pastry cream, topped with a dark chocolate ganache poured over and set.

drink.name: Dr Cawley's brandy
drink.scene: the drink in the doctor's study
drink.method: 45ml brandy in a warmed snifter, swirled. Coffee alongside for anyone who'd rather not.

films.title: Beetlejuice
films.tagline: Say it three times. Then eat.
films.description: A recently dead couple hire an obnoxious ghost to scare the new owners out of their house.
films.serve_cue: Serve the prawns when the dinner party breaks into the Banana Boat song.

snacks.name: Banana Boat prawn cocktail
snacks.scene: the dinner party prawns grab the guests' faces
snacks.method: Prawns poached in salted water for 2 minutes, iced, piled into glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and a dash of hot sauce.

snacks.name: Model town cheese bites
snacks.scene: Adam's model of Winter River in the attic
snacks.method: Cubes of cheddar, gouda and pepper jack stacked like tiny houses on a board, with cherry tomato and gherkin for the trees.

snacks.name: Waiting room crackers
snacks.scene: take a number in the afterlife
snacks.method: Seeded crackers with whipped ricotta, lemon zest and black pepper, numbered with a dot of balsamic glaze.

mains.name: Dinner party lobster
mains.scene: the Deetzes' very fancy dinner
mains.method: Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic, lemon and parsley butter, grilled flesh side up under a hot grill for 6 minutes. Shoestring fries and a green salad.

mains.name: Beetle-free tacos
mains.scene: he eats the bugs, you don't
mains.method: Pork shoulder braised with chipotle, orange and cumin at 160C for 3 hours, shredded and crisped in a hot pan, in warm corn tortillas with pickled red onion and coriander.

dessert.name: Striped suit cake
dessert.scene: black and white stripes, like the suit
dessert.method: Vanilla and chocolate sponge batters piped in alternating stripes into a loaf tin, baked at 170C for 50 minutes, covered in white chocolate ganache with dark chocolate stripes.

drink.name: Banana daiquiri
drink.method: Blend 45ml white rum, 20ml lime juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half a ripe banana with a cup of ice until smooth.

films.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
films.tagline: Whatever you do, don't fall asleep before dessert.
films.description: A burned killer hunts teenagers in their dreams.
films.serve_cue: Serve the coffee when Nancy tries to stay awake.

snacks.name: Elm Street chips and dip
snacks.scene: a sleepover that doesn't go to plan
snacks.method: Kettle chips with a dip of sour cream, cream cheese, garlic, lemon and lots of fresh herbs blitzed until green and smooth.

snacks.name: Five finger pretzels
snacks.scene: five blades, five pretzel sticks
snacks.method: Pretzel rods with the tips dipped in melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper in groups of five, a pinch of flaky salt on each.

mains.name: Stay-awake chilli
mains.scene: a big pot for a long night
mains.method: Beef chuck diced and browned, onion, garlic, chipotle, cumin and cocoa, tomato and beans, braised 3 hours at 160C until thick. Sour cream and cheddar.

mains.name: Cafeteria sloppy joes
mains.scene: Nancy dozes off in English class
mains.method: Beef mince cooked down with onion, tomato sauce, mustard and brown sugar until thick, spooned into soft buns.

dessert.name: Red and green swirl cupcakes
dessert.scene: the jumper again, for dessert
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with buttercream striped red and green in the piping bag so it swirls.

drink.name: Strong black coffee
drink.scene: Nancy keeps the pot going all night
drink.method: Coffee made in a plunger, 60g ground coffee to a litre, steeped 4 minutes, served black in big mugs.

films.title: Poltergeist
films.tagline: They're here. So is dinner.
films.description: A suburban family's house is invaded by spirits who take their youngest daughter.
films.serve_cue: Serve the steak when one crawls across the kitchen bench.

snacks.name: TV static popcorn
snacks.scene: Carol Anne talking to the snowy TV
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in melted butter with fine salt, cracked black pepper and black sesame so it looks like static.

snacks.name: Stacked chair cheese tower
snacks.scene: Diane turns around and the chairs are stacked
snacks.method: Thick slices of cheddar, gouda and Swiss stacked in a crooked tower with crackers between each layer, skewered through the middle.

snacks.name: Clown doll crackers
snacks.scene: the clown on the chair, don't leave him there
snacks.method: Round crackers with cream cheese, a cherry tomato nose and olive slice eyes. Make them before dark.

mains.name: Steak that stays put
mains.scene: the one that crawls across the kitchen bench
mains.method: Rump steaks seasoned, seared hard in a smoking pan, butter, garlic and thyme basted in, pulled at 54C, rested 5 minutes. Jacket potatoes and creamed spinach.

mains.name: Cuesta Verde tuna bake
mains.scene: a suburban weeknight dinner
mains.method: Pasta shells mixed with tuna, peas and a cheddar white sauce, topped with breadcrumbs and more cheese, baked at 190C for 25 minutes.

dessert.name: Ghost-white meringues
dessert.scene: Carol Anne's voice from the TV, they're here
dessert.method: Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff peaks, piped into tall ghostly drops, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven.

drink.name: Cuesta Verde orange spider
drink.scene: a hot afternoon in the new estate
drink.method: Orange soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up creamy and orange. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each of 4 glasses and pour over 300ml cold orange soda slowly so it foams.

films.title: Fright Night
films.tagline: Welcome to Fright Night. Bring garlic.
films.description: A teenager is convinced the new neighbour is a vampire, and nobody believes him.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Peter Vincent's late night TV show starts.

snacks.name: Late night TV popcorn
snacks.scene: Peter Vincent's horror show on the telly
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in melted butter, fine salt and a little smoked paprika, served in a big bowl in front of the TV.

snacks.name: Charley's garlic bread
snacks.scene: the first line of defence
snacks.method: Baguette split, spread with butter mashed with lots of raw garlic, parsley and salt, wrapped in foil, baked at 200C for 12 minutes, then opened for 3 to crisp.

snacks.name: Jerry's apples
snacks.scene: the neighbour is always eating an apple
snacks.method: Crisp red apples sliced and tossed in lemon, with a dip of peanut butter whipped with honey and a pinch of salt, or salted caramel.

mains.name: Forty-clove garlic chicken
mains.scene: enough garlic to keep Jerry out
mains.method: Chicken thighs browned skin side down, forty unpeeled garlic cloves, thyme and white wine added, covered and baked at 180C for an hour. Squeeze the garlic onto crusty bread.

mains.name: Nightclub sliders
mains.scene: the club where Jerry dances with Amy
mains.method: Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on top, caramelised onion and pickles on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper.

dessert.name: Blood orange posset
dessert.scene: blood red, but Jerry won't touch it
dessert.method: Silky set cream sharpened with blood orange juice, served cold in little glasses with a sliver of candied peel.

drink.name: Holy water
drink.scene: fill the little bottles before the neighbour visits
drink.method: Lemonade with fresh lime over ice, served in small glass bottles.

films.title: An American Werewolf in London
films.tagline: Stay on the road. Keep clear of the moors. Order the pie.
films.description: Two American backpackers are attacked by a werewolf on the Yorkshire moors.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when they walk into the Slaughtered Lamb.

snacks.name: Slaughtered Lamb pork crackling
snacks.scene: the pub where everyone goes quiet
snacks.method: Pork rind scored, salted and dried in the fridge overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp, broken into pieces.

snacks.name: Scotch eggs
snacks.scene: a Yorkshire pub classic on the bar
snacks.method: Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Hot English mustard.

snacks.name: Zoo enclosure nut mix
snacks.scene: David wakes up in the wolf enclosure at the zoo
snacks.method: Almonds, cashews and peanuts tossed in egg white, brown sugar, cayenne and rosemary, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes, stirred twice.

mains.name: Ploughman's lunch
mains.scene: a pub table on the moors
mains.method: Thick slices of vintage cheddar and leg ham, crusty bread, salted butter, pickled onions, apple and a jar of chutney on a board.

mains.name: Shepherd's pie
mains.scene: dinner at Alex's London flat
mains.method: Lamb mince browned with onion, carrot, tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden.

dessert.name: Piccadilly jam roly-poly
dessert.scene: London, before the full moon
dessert.method: Suet pastry rolled with raspberry jam and baked, served hot with custard. Mix 250g self-raising flour, 125g shredded suet or cold grated butter, 30g sugar and 150ml water into a dough.

drink.name: Pint of bitter
drink.method: English ale poured into pint glasses at cellar temperature, not ice cold.

films.title: The Fly
films.tagline: Be afraid. Be very hungry.
films.description: A scientist's teleportation experiment goes wrong and fuses him with a fly.
films.serve_cue: Serve the steak when Seth teleports one and it tastes wrong.

snacks.name: Teleported steak bites
snacks.scene: the first steak through the pods tastes synthetic
snacks.method: Sirloin in cubes seared hard in a smoking pan, butter, garlic and thyme basted in, rested, served on toothpicks with horseradish cream.

snacks.name: Sugar dusted doughnuts
snacks.scene: Seth's sugar cravings kick in
snacks.method: Yeasted dough rested an hour, cut into rounds, proved, fried at 175C for 90 seconds a side, tossed in caster sugar while warm.

snacks.name: Science party canapés
snacks.scene: where Seth meets Veronica
snacks.method: Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, and goat's cheese with fig jam, laid on silver trays.

mains.name: Steak, done properly
mains.scene: Veronica tells him what the real thing tastes like
mains.method: Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped often, pulled at 54C, rested 8 minutes. Shoestring fries and a béarnaise.

mains.name: Sticky glazed pork belly
mains.scene: everything Seth eats now needs sugar
mains.method: Pork belly roasted at 150C for 2 hours, then glazed with soy, honey, brown sugar and ginger under a hot grill until sticky. Steamed rice and greens.

dessert.name: Brundle's caramel baked pears
dessert.scene: Seth starts craving sugar
dessert.method: Pears baked in butter, brown sugar and vanilla until soft and sticky, with cream. Halve 4 pears and core.

drink.name: Very sweet coffee
drink.scene: Seth spoons in sugar until it's syrup
drink.method: Strong drip coffee with as many sugars as you dare, milk optional.

films.title: Hocus Pocus

snacks.name: Lost Boys coloured dip
snacks.scene: the bright goo Peter flicks at Rufio
snacks.method: Three dips in bright colours: beetroot hummus, pea and mint, and carrot with cumin, each blitzed with tahini and lemon, with flatbread.

snacks.name: Tinkerbell fairy bread
snacks.scene: a bit of fairy dust
snacks.method: White bread spread right to the edges with soft butter, pressed into hundreds and thousands, a dusting of edible glitter, cut into triangles.

mains.name: Lost Boys feast
mains.scene: the feast Peter finally sees
mains.method: Whole chickens spatchcocked, rubbed with garlic, lemon and paprika, roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, with corn on the cob and roast potatoes, eaten with your hands.

mains.name: Captain Hook's pirate stew
mains.scene: aboard the Jolly Roger
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, onion, carrot and dark rum, stock and thyme, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Ship's biscuits on the side.

dessert.name: Tick-tock crocodile cake
dessert.scene: the clock the crocodile swallowed
dessert.method: Pandan sponge tinted green, baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in green buttercream with a chocolate clock face on top.

drink.name: Pixie dust lemonade
drink.method: Lemonade with a squeeze of lime, a pinch of edible glitter swirled in so it shimmers.

films.title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit
films.tagline: P-p-p-please pass the snacks.
films.description: A down-on-his-luck detective helps a cartoon rabbit framed for murder in 1947 Los Angeles.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Jessica takes the stage at the Ink and Paint Club.

snacks.name: Ink and Paint Club canapés
snacks.scene: the nightclub where toons wait tables
snacks.method: Devilled eggs, smoked salmon on rye and cocktail franks in a sticky glaze, served on silver trays like a 1940s supper club.

snacks.name: Toontown carrot sticks
snacks.scene: Roger's favourite, obviously
snacks.method: Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey, cumin and thyme until caramelised, with a whipped feta dip.

snacks.name: Dip-free dip
snacks.scene: no toons harmed in this dip
snacks.method: French onion dip of onions cooked slowly for 40 minutes, folded into sour cream and cream cheese, with potato chips.

mains.name: Eddie's office sandwich
mains.scene: lunch at his desk in the office
mains.method: A hot pastrami sandwich: pastrami steamed, piled on rye with mustard and Swiss, grilled until the cheese melts. Dill pickle on the side.

mains.name: Red Car diner meatloaf
mains.scene: 1947 LA, before the freeway
mains.method: Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, mash and green beans.

dessert.name: Jessica's red velvet cake
dessert.scene: the red dress on stage
dessert.method: Red velvet cake baked at 175C, layered with cream cheese frosting, a glossy red glaze on top.

drink.name: Eddie's whisky
drink.scene: the bottle in his desk drawer
drink.method: 45ml rye whisky neat or on the rocks in a heavy glass. Just don't give one to Roger.

films.title: The Little Mermaid
films.tagline: Kiss the cook. Spare the crab.
films.description: A young mermaid trades her voice for legs to win a prince.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Chef Louis starts chasing Sebastian around the kitchen.

snacks.name: Dinglehopper garlic bread
snacks.scene: Scuttle swears a fork is for combing hair
snacks.method: Baguette split, spread with garlic and herb butter, baked at 200C for 12 minutes, served with forks stuck in for combing, or eating.

snacks.name: Under the sea prawn cocktail
snacks.scene: a seafood party, no crabs invited
snacks.method: Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, piled into glasses over shredded iceberg with a pink sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and horseradish.

snacks.name: Seashell pasta salad
snacks.scene: Ariel's grotto full of treasures
snacks.method: Small pasta shells cooked al dente, tossed with peas, cherry tomatoes, basil and lemon dressing.

mains.name: Eric's castle dinner
mains.scene: the dinner where she uses a fork to comb her hair
mains.method: Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a white wine and tarragon cream sauce, buttered new potatoes and green beans. Crab left firmly off the menu.

mains.name: Les poissons fish
mains.scene: Chef Louis's song, fish only
mains.method: Snapper fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, finished with lemon, capers and brown butter, served with crushed potatoes.

dessert.name: Sea-glass jelly cups
dessert.scene: Sebastian's big number on the sea floor
dessert.method: Blue jelly set in clear glasses with gummy fish suspended halfway, topped with whipped cream and crushed shortbread for sand, a white chocolate shell on the side.

drink.name: Lagoon punch
drink.scene: the boat ride across the lagoon
drink.method: Pineapple juice, coconut water and lemonade with a splash of blue curaçao syrup, over ice.

films.title: Beauty and the Beast
films.tagline: Be our guest. Try the grey stuff.
films.description: A young woman held in an enchanted castle sees past the Beast to the man inside.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks during Be Our Guest.

snacks.name: The grey stuff
snacks.scene: Lumière says it's delicious, and it is
snacks.method: Chocolate sandwich biscuits crushed and folded through whipped cream and mascarpone with vanilla, piped onto more biscuits, chilled.

snacks.name: Gaston's eggs
snacks.scene: he eats five dozen eggs every morning
snacks.method: Devilled eggs: boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a little butter, piped back, finished with paprika and chives. A dozen will do.

snacks.name: Village bakery baguette
snacks.scene: the baker in Belle's village song
snacks.method: Fresh baguette sliced, toasted with olive oil, topped with brie, sliced pear and a drizzle of honey.

mains.name: Be Our Guest beef bourguignon
mains.scene: the castle kitchen's dinner for Belle
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, bacon, onion and garlic, red wine, stock, thyme and bay, braised at 160C for 3 hours, mushrooms and pearl onions added. Buttered potato purée.

mains.name: Gaston's tavern roast chicken
mains.scene: the tavern in the village
mains.method: Chicken roasted at 220C then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes and a rich pan gravy, eaten with your hands.

dessert.name: Enchanted rose panna cotta
dessert.scene: the rose under the glass bell, losing its petals
dessert.method: Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm cream with sugar and a few drops of rosewater, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with raspberries crushed with a little sugar and a single sugared rose petal.

drink.name: LeFou's apple slush
drink.scene: the tavern where everyone sings about Gaston
drink.method: Cloudy apple juice with a little lemon frozen in a tray, scraped into slush, topped with a toasted marshmallow foam of whipped cream folded with marshmallow creme. Mrs Potts's tea for the grown-ups.

films.title: Aladdin
films.tagline: One jump ahead of the bread line.
films.description: A street kid finds a magic lamp and a genie who grants him three wishes.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Aladdin steals the bread in the market.

snacks.name: Agrabah market flatbread
snacks.scene: the loaf Aladdin swipes and gives away
snacks.method: Yeasted dough rested an hour, rolled into rounds, cooked on a smoking hot pan until puffed and blistered, brushed with butter and za'atar.

snacks.name: Street stall dips
snacks.scene: the busy market stalls
snacks.method: Hummus of chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic blitzed with ice water until silky, baba ganoush of eggplant charred over a flame, and labneh with olive oil and mint.

snacks.name: Abu's dates
snacks.scene: the monkey with sticky fingers
snacks.method: Medjool dates split, stuffed with a blend of cream cheese, orange zest and chopped pistachio, dusted with cinnamon.

mains.name: Sultan's palace chicken
mains.scene: a feast for the Sultan's table
mains.method: Chicken thighs marinated overnight in yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric and lemon, skewered, grilled over high heat until charred. Saffron rice, garlic sauce and pickles.

mains.name: Lamb kofta
mains.scene: grilled in the market square
mains.method: Lamb mince with grated onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and parsley shaped on skewers, grilled hot, with flatbread, tomato and cucumber salad and tahini sauce.

dessert.name: Magic carpet baklava
dessert.scene: a whole new world of layers
dessert.method: Filo layered with melted butter and a mix of walnuts, pistachios, cinnamon and sugar, cut into diamonds, baked at 170C for 45 minutes, hot honey and orange blossom syrup poured over.

drink.name: Genie's mint lemonade
drink.scene: a blue genie, a green drink
drink.method: Lemon juice blended with a big handful of mint, sugar syrup and ice until frothy, strained into glasses.

films.title: The Lion King
films.tagline: Hakuna matata. Second helpings.
films.description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to claim it.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba about grubs.

snacks.name: Slimy yet satisfying grubs
snacks.scene: Timon and Pumbaa's favourite
snacks.method: Gummy worms buried in cups of dark chocolate mousse with crushed chocolate biscuit dirt, a mint leaf on top.

snacks.name: Pride Rock sosaties
snacks.scene: a nod to East African street food
snacks.method: Lamb cubes marinated overnight with apricot jam, curry powder, onion and vinegar, skewered with dried apricots and onion, grilled over hot coals.

snacks.name: Rafiki's fruit
snacks.scene: the fruit he breaks open on Simba's head
snacks.method: Wedges of mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit on ice, with lime, a pinch of chilli salt and fresh mint.

mains.name: Peri peri chicken
mains.scene: for the pride, after the hunt
mains.method: Chicken spatchcocked, marinated overnight in blitzed red chillies, garlic, lemon, paprika and oil, roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, basted with more sauce. Yellow rice and slaw.

mains.name: Bobotie
mains.scene: a spiced savanna supper
mains.method: Beef mince cooked with onion, curry powder, turmeric, chutney and soaked bread, topped with egg and milk custard and bay leaves, baked at 180C for 35 minutes.

dessert.name: Mandazi
dessert.scene: the circle of life, in a doughnut
dessert.method: Coconut and cardamom dough rested an hour, cut into triangles, fried at 170C until puffed and golden, dusted with icing sugar.

drink.name: Pride Rock punch
drink.method: Mango, passionfruit and pineapple juice with lemonade and lime, poured over crushed ice.

films.title: Toy Story
films.tagline: You've got a friend in the kitchen.
films.description: A cowboy doll is threatened when a flashy space ranger toy arrives on his kid's birthday.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pizza when Woody and Buzz end up at the pizza place.

snacks.name: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites
snacks.scene: Andy's birthday, the new toy panic
snacks.method: Crispy baby potatoes smashed and loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheese and chives. Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes.

snacks.name: Woody's lunch box tater tots
snacks.scene: a nod to the Toy Story land snack stand
snacks.method: Tater tots baked at 220C until crisp, tossed with grated parmesan, garlic and parsley, with a smoky barbecue mayo.

snacks.name: Green army men peas
snacks.scene: the scouts on the stairs
snacks.method: Fresh peas and edamame blanched, tossed with mint, lemon, olive oil and flaky salt, served in little toy buckets.

mains.name: Space-themed pizza
mains.scene: the claw machine at the pizza place
mains.method: Pizza dough stretched round, crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni rounds arranged like planets, olive slice craters, baked on a hot steel.

mains.name: Grilled cheese and tomato soup
mains.scene: lunch box classic
mains.method: Sourdough with cheddar and mozzarella, buttered outside, grilled slowly until golden, with a tomato soup of roasted tomatoes, onion and garlic blended with cream.

dessert.name: Andy's birthday cake
dessert.scene: with a cowboy hat on top
dessert.method: Chocolate cake baked at 175C, chocolate buttercream, a fondant cowboy hat on top, candles in.

drink.name: Pizza Planet alien punch
drink.scene: the little green aliens in the claw machine
drink.method: Pineapple juice and lemonade tinted green, with grapes on sticks for little aliens.

films.title: Toy Story 2
films.tagline: When somebody loved me, they fed me.
films.description: Woody is stolen by a toy collector and the gang sets out to rescue him.
films.serve_cue: Serve the cheese puffs when Al starts eating them in his apartment.

snacks.name: Al's cheese puffs
snacks.scene: the orange dust on his fingers
snacks.method: Homemade cheese puffs: choux pastry with grated cheddar and gruyère, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.

snacks.name: Woody's Roundup cowboy beans
snacks.scene: Woody's old TV show
snacks.method: Beans simmered with smoked bacon, onion, molasses, mustard and tomato for 2 hours until thick and sticky. Cornbread squares.

snacks.name: Bullseye's caramel apple wedges
snacks.scene: Jessie's horse with the big goofy grin
snacks.method: Caramels melted with a splash of cream until smooth, crisp apple wedges patted dry and dipped halfway, rolled in crushed roasted peanuts and set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.

mains.name: Chicken suit fried chicken
mains.scene: Al in his chicken suit on the TV ad
mains.method: Drumsticks brined in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 75C inside. Coleslaw and corn.

mains.name: Prospector's chilli
mains.scene: Stinky Pete, still in his box
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic, chipotle and cumin, tomatoes and beans, braised 3 hours. Sour cream and cornbread.

dessert.name: Jessie's yodelling cookies
dessert.scene: Jessie's cowgirl yodel on the old TV show
dessert.method: Butter sugar cookie dough chilled, rolled, cut into cowboy hats and boots, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red and white royal icing in Jessie's cowgirl colours.

drink.name: Sarsaparilla float
drink.method: Sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream until it foams.

films.title: Monsters, Inc.
films.tagline: We scare because we care. We cook because we're hungry.
films.description: Two monsters accidentally let a little girl into their world.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sushi when Mike takes Celia to the sushi place.

snacks.name: Sushi rolls
snacks.scene: Mike and Celia's date at the sushi restaurant
snacks.method: Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, rolled in nori with salmon and avocado, cucumber and crab stick, sliced with a wet knife. Soy and pickled ginger.

snacks.name: Yeti's lemon snow cones
snacks.scene: the abominable snowman offers them in the Himalayas
snacks.method: Shaved ice packed into cups and drenched in a lemon syrup of fresh lemon, sugar and water reduced together.

mains.name: Teriyaki chicken
mains.scene: for the scarers after a shift
mains.method: Chicken thighs marinated in soy, mirin, sake and sugar, grilled until charred, the marinade reduced to a glaze. Steamed rice and greens.

mains.name: Monstropolis noodle bowl
mains.scene: the city canteen
mains.method: Ramen in a rich chicken broth with soy and mirin, soft-boiled eggs, pork belly and greens.

dessert.name: Boo's door jam drops
dessert.scene: all those doors on the scare floor
dessert.method: Buttery thumbprint biscuits each holding a little pool of raspberry jam. Beat 125g butter and 80g sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 180g plain flour.

drink.name: Scream canister slushie
drink.method: Pineapple and lemon slushie blended with ice, in clear glasses.

films.title: Shrek
films.tagline: Ogres are like onions. So is this menu.
films.description: An ogre sets out to rescue a princess so he can get his swamp back.
films.serve_cue: Serve the waffles when Donkey promises to make them in the morning.

snacks.name: Layered onion rings
snacks.scene: ogres have layers, like onions
snacks.method: Brown onions cut thick, separated, soaked in buttermilk for 30 minutes, dredged in flour, dipped in beaten egg and pressed into panko, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Smoky barbecue mayo.

snacks.name: Gingerbread men
snacks.scene: not the gumdrop buttons
snacks.method: Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger, cinnamon and bicarb mixed in, chilled an hour, rolled and cut into little men, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced with gumdrop buttons.

snacks.name: Swamp dip
snacks.scene: green, murky and very good
snacks.method: Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with chopped artichoke hearts, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic, topped with mozzarella and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Corn chips.
