mains.scene: Shrek's pot bubbling in the swamp
mains.method: Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, garlic and celery softened, red wine and stock, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, peas and spinach stirred in at the end so it turns green. Crusty bread.

mains.name: Duloc banquet chicken
mains.scene: Lord Farquaad's perfect, tidy kingdom
mains.method: Chicken marylands rubbed with garlic, rosemary, lemon zest and salt, roasted at 200C for 50 minutes on a bed of halved potatoes and lemon wedges until the skin crackles.

dessert.name: Donkey's waffles
dessert.scene: in the morning, he's making waffles
dessert.method: Buttermilk batter with melted butter and separated eggs, the whites whipped and folded in, cooked in a hot waffle iron until crisp, served with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrup.

drink.name: Swamp juice
drink.scene: green and murky, like the swamp
drink.method: Green apple, cucumber, lime juice and a handful of mint blitzed with ice and a little honey until slushy.

films.title: Finding Nemo
films.tagline: Fish are friends, not food. So there's no fish.
films.description: A clownfish dad crosses the ocean to find his son, who ends up in a Sydney dentist's fish tank.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Bruce leads the sharks' meeting.

snacks.name: Bruce's shark bite veggie platter
snacks.scene: fish are friends, not food
snacks.method: Cucumber, carrot, capsicum and sugar snap peas cut into sharp triangles like teeth, with a green goddess dip of sour cream, herbs, lemon and garlic blitzed smooth.

snacks.name: 42 Wallaby Way sausage rolls
snacks.scene: the address in Sydney Dory can't forget
snacks.method: Sausage mince with grated zucchini, onion and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.

snacks.name: Coral reef fairy bread
snacks.scene: the colours of the Great Barrier Reef
snacks.method: White bread buttered right to the edges, pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into little fish shapes with a cutter.

mains.name: Sydney pub chicken schnitzel
mains.scene: a Sydney lunch, no fish allowed
mains.method: Thin chicken fillets crumbed in panko and fried golden, with lemon, chips and salad, pub style.

mains.name: Crush's surfer tacos
mains.scene: riding the East Australian Current, dude
mains.method: Pulled pork shoulder braised with chipotle and orange for 3 hours, in corn tortillas with pineapple salsa, lime and coriander.

dessert.name: Clownfish ice blocks
dessert.scene: orange and white stripes, like Nemo
dessert.method: Fresh orange juice sweetened with a little honey frozen in layers with vanilla yoghurt, 40 minutes per layer, so each ice block has orange and white stripes. Sticks in after the second layer.

drink.name: Sea breeze mocktail
drink.method: Pineapple juice, coconut water and a splash of blue raspberry cordial over crushed ice, a pineapple wedge on the side.

films.title: Ratatouille
films.tagline: Anyone can cook.
films.description: A rat with a gift for cooking teams up with a kitchen hand at a famous Paris restaurant.
films.serve_cue: Serve the main when Anton Ego takes his first bite.

snacks.name: Remy's lightning mushroom and cheese
snacks.scene: roasted on the chimney by a bolt of lightning
snacks.method: Swiss brown mushrooms stuffed with gruyère, thyme and garlic, drizzled with oil, roasted at 220C for 12 minutes until bubbling. Lightning optional.

snacks.name: Gusteau's soup
snacks.scene: the soup Linguini ruins and Remy fixes
snacks.method: Leek and potato soup: leeks sweated in butter, potatoes and stock simmered 20 minutes, blended silky with cream, finished with chives and a little white pepper.

snacks.name: Paris market baguette
snacks.scene: the markets Remy sees from the rooftops
snacks.method: Warm baguette with cultured butter, a wedge of brie and saucisson sliced thin, cornichons alongside.

mains.name: Ratatouille
mains.scene: the dish that takes Ego back to his mum's kitchen
mains.method: Piperade of capsicum, onion, garlic and tomato spread in a dish, zucchini, eggplant, squash and tomato sliced thin and layered in a spiral, thyme oil, covered and baked at 140C for 2 hours.

mains.name: Linguini's roast chicken
mains.scene: a bistro classic for the kitchen crew
mains.method: Chicken roasted at 220C with butter, garlic and tarragon under the skin, rested, with pommes purée and a pan jus.

dessert.name: Colette's crème brûlée
dessert.scene: Colette teaches Linguini the kitchen
dessert.method: Cream warmed with vanilla bean, whisked into yolks and sugar, baked in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes, chilled, sugar torched to a crack.

drink.name: Ego's red wine
drink.method: A Bordeaux red blend, opened and decanted an hour before dinner. Red grape juice for the kids.

films.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
films.tagline: Helloooo. Dinner is served.
films.description: A divorced dad disguises himself as an elderly British nanny to spend time with his kids.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Daniel's face ends up in the frosting.

snacks.name: Restaurant garlic prawns
snacks.scene: the dinner where he runs between two tables all night
snacks.method: Green prawns sautéed fast in foaming butter with plenty of garlic and chilli flakes, a splash of white wine and lemon, parsley thrown in. Crusty bread to mop it up. Go easy on the cayenne.

snacks.name: Euphegenia's tea sandwiches
snacks.scene: a very proper British nanny
snacks.method: Crustless sandwiches of cucumber with cream cheese and dill, and egg mashed with mayo and cress, cut into neat fingers and arranged on a tiered stand.

snacks.name: San Francisco sourdough bites
snacks.scene: the family home in San Francisco
snacks.method: Sourdough sliced and toasted with garlic butter, topped with torn burrata, ripe tomato tossed in salt and olive oil, and fresh basil.

mains.name: The takeaway she passes off as home cooking
mains.scene: the first dinner she has to cook for the kids
mains.method: Shepherd's pie that tastes homemade because it is: lamb mince browned, onion, carrot, tomato paste and Worcestershire simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden.

mains.name: Stu's birthday steak
mains.scene: the birthday dinner at the fancy restaurant
mains.method: Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seared hard in a smoking pan, butter and thyme basted in, pulled at 54C and rested, with shoestring fries and a béarnaise.

dessert.name: Frosting face cake
dessert.scene: when her face falls in the cake frosting
dessert.method: Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, filled and covered in a thick cloud of mascarpone whipped cream, piled with strawberries. Faces stay out of it.

drink.name: A proper cuppa
drink.method: English breakfast tea brewed 4 minutes in a warmed pot, milk in first or after, sugar on the side.

films.title: Matilda
films.tagline: Eat the whole cake, Bruce.
films.description: A gifted girl with neglectful parents discovers she has powers and takes on her terrifying headmistress.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Bruce Bogtrotter faces the cake.

snacks.name: Wormwood TV dinner trays
snacks.scene: the family eats in front of the TV every night
snacks.method: Chicken tenders crumbed in panko and baked at 220C until crisp, with a spoon of buttery mash and peas, served on little sectioned trays.

snacks.name: Library book cheese stacks
snacks.scene: Matilda reads every book in the library
snacks.method: Lavash cut into neat rectangles, brushed with oil and rosemary, baked at 180C until crisp, then stacked with slices of cheddar and apple like a pile of books.

snacks.name: Miss Honey's cottage scones
snacks.scene: tea at Miss Honey's tiny cottage
snacks.method: Self-raising flour with cold butter rubbed in, milk mixed in lightly with a knife, cut into rounds, packed close on the tray, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Jam and cream.

mains.name: Matilda's pancakes
mains.scene: she makes her own breakfast
mains.method: Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in butter until bubbles set and the edges go lacy, stacked high with butter, maple syrup and blueberries warmed in a pan.

mains.name: Car yard hot dogs
mains.scene: Harry Wormwood's dodgy used car lot
mains.method: Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, onions cooked slowly in butter until jammy, in toasted buns with mustard and a sharp mustard pickle.

dessert.name: Bruce Bogtrotter's chocolate cake
dessert.scene: the whole thing, in front of the school
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs, sugar and buttermilk, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 45 minutes, covered in a thick fudge frosting. Slices, not the whole cake.

drink.name: Newt-free water jug
drink.scene: the newt in Miss Trunchbull's water jug
drink.method: Cold water in a big jug with sliced lemon, cucumber and mint, plenty of ice, and absolutely nothing alive in it.

films.title: Casper
films.tagline: Can I keep you. Can I feed you.
films.description: A friendly ghost befriends the daughter of a ghost therapist who moves into his haunted manor.
films.serve_cue: Serve the breakfast feast when Casper cooks for Kat.

snacks.name: Ghost meringues
snacks.scene: the friendly ghost in sugar form
snacks.method: Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff, glossy peaks, piped into tall teardrop ghosts, two mini choc chip eyes pressed in, baked at 100C for 90 minutes and left to cool in the oven.

snacks.name: Friendship, Maine lobster rolls
snacks.scene: the little seaside town Whipstaff sits in
snacks.method: Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted split rolls.

snacks.name: Halloween party popcorn
snacks.scene: the party at Whipstaff Manor
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in white chocolate and a pinch of salt, mixed with candy corn and pretzels, spread on a tray to set.

mains.name: Casper's big breakfast
mains.scene: he cooks Kat a feast she can't finish
mains.method: Buttermilk pancakes, crisp bacon, scrambled eggs cooked slowly in butter, hash browns and toast, all piled on the table at once with maple syrup and orange juice.

mains.name: Fatso's feast
mains.scene: the uncle who eats everything in sight
mains.method: New England clam chowder: bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk, clams and cream at the end, served in bread bowls.

dessert.name: Maine blueberry pie
dessert.scene: a Maine summer, even in a haunted house
dessert.method: Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon zest and cornflour, in a double crust with a lattice top, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours to set. Vanilla ice cream.

drink.name: Whipstaff cream soda floats
drink.scene: a friendly ghost of a drink
drink.method: Cold cream soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up white and ghostly.

films.title: The Princess Bride
films.tagline: As you wish.
films.description: A farmhand turned pirate fights his way back to the princess he loves.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Vizzini and the man in black do the battle of wits.

snacks.name: The MLT
snacks.scene: a mutton, lettuce and tomato sandwich, the lean mutton kind
snacks.method: Lamb backstrap seared to pink, rested and sliced thin, on toasted bread with crisp cos, ripe tomato, mint mayo and salt.

snacks.name: Miracle pills

snacks.method: Dark chocolate truffles: chocolate melted into hot cream with a pinch of salt, chilled, rolled into small balls and coated in cocoa.

snacks.name: Fire Swamp chorizo
snacks.scene: the flame spurts in the Fire Swamp
snacks.method: Chorizo sliced and fried in a hot pan until crisp, deglazed with a splash of sherry and honey, served on toothpicks with crusty bread.

mains.name: Florin castle roast
mains.scene: the royal wedding feast
mains.method: Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and horseradish cream.

mains.name: Fezzik's giant pie
mains.scene: for the giant with the big appetite
mains.method: Steak and ale pie: beef chuck braised in ale with onion and thyme for 2.5 hours, thickened, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.

dessert.name: Cliffs of Insanity cake
dessert.scene: the climb up the cliffs
dessert.method: Chocolate layer cake stacked tall, filled with salted caramel and chocolate ganache, the sides left rough like a cliff face.

drink.name: Battle of wits wine
drink.method: A medium-bodied red poured into two goblets, swapped around the table. Grape juice for anyone who can't decide.

films.title: Cool Runnings
films.tagline: Feel the rhythm. Feel the rhyme. Get on up, it's dinner time.
films.description: A team of Jamaican sprinters take up bobsledding for the 1988 Winter Olympics.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the team first sees snow in Calgary.

snacks.name: Beef patties
snacks.scene: a Jamaican street snack
snacks.method: Beef mince cooked with onion, thyme, scotch bonnet, allspice and curry powder, wrapped in turmeric shortcrust, crimped, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.

snacks.name: Sanka's lucky eggs
snacks.scene: Sanka kisses his lucky egg before every run
snacks.method: Devilled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, a touch of jerk paste and lime, finished with spring onion. Kiss before eating.

snacks.name: Plantain chips
snacks.scene: a taste of home in the snow
snacks.method: Green plantains sliced thin, fried at 175C until crisp, salted, with a lime and chilli dip.

mains.name: Jerk chicken
mains.scene: home in Jamaica
mains.method: Chicken marylands marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, spring onion, garlic and lime, grilled slowly over coals until charred. Rice and peas.

mains.name: Calgary curry goat
mains.scene: warm food for a Jamaican team in a Canadian winter
mains.method: Goat or lamb shoulder marinated in curry powder, garlic and thyme, browned, braised with potatoes and scotch bonnet for 3 hours.

dessert.name: Rum cake
dessert.scene: the team celebrates, Jamaican style
dessert.method: Butter cake with brown sugar and a little molasses baked at 170C for 45 minutes in a ring tin, pricked all over while hot and soaked with a dark rum, butter and brown sugar syrup. Whipped cream.

drink.name: Rum punch
drink.scene: one sour, two sweet, three strong, four weak
drink.method: Lime juice, sugar syrup, Jamaican rum and pineapple and orange juice, over ice with nutmeg.

films.title: The Sandlot
films.tagline: You're killing me, Smalls. Have a s'more.
films.description: A new kid in town joins a neighbourhood baseball team for one unforgettable summer.
films.serve_cue: Serve the s'mores when Ham explains them to Smalls in the treehouse.

snacks.name: Treehouse s'mores
snacks.scene: Ham can't believe Smalls has never had one
snacks.method: Big marshmallows toasted over a flame until blistered and molten, sandwiched with a square of milk chocolate between two digestive biscuits, pressed so the chocolate melts.

snacks.name: Ballpark peanuts
snacks.scene: a sandlot game in the summer heat
snacks.method: Raw peanuts in the shell boiled in heavily salted water for 2 hours, drained, or roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, served in paper bags.

snacks.name: Pool day ice blocks
snacks.scene: the day at the pool with the lifeguard
snacks.method: Watermelon blended with lime and a little sugar, frozen in moulds with whole raspberries for 6 hours, sticks in after an hour.

mains.name: Fourth of July hot dogs
mains.scene: the night game under the fireworks
mains.method: Franks scored and grilled over coals until blistered, in toasted buns with mustard, sweet relish and onions cooked slowly in butter.

mains.name: Sandlot burgers
mains.scene: a summer of baseball and backyard grills
mains.method: Chuck patties seasoned at the last minute, grilled to medium over coals, cheddar melted on, lettuce, tomato and pickles on a soft bun. Corn on the cob with butter.

dessert.name: Carnival fairy floss and toffee apples
dessert.scene: the carnival where the rides go badly
dessert.method: Sugar, water and golden syrup boiled to 150C, red colouring, apples on sticks dipped and twirled, set on oiled paper. Bought fairy floss alongside.

drink.name: Homemade lemonade
drink.scene: a hot summer on the sandlot
drink.method: Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water in a big jug with lemon slices and ice, stirred well before pouring.

films.title: Labyrinth
films.tagline: Thirteen hours to solve it. Plenty of time for dessert.
films.description: A teenager has thirteen hours to solve a goblin king's labyrinth and rescue her baby brother.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Sarah bites the peach.

snacks.name: The worm's tea and cake
snacks.scene: the little worm invites Sarah in to meet the missus
snacks.method: Fingers of buttered fruit loaf toasted, served with a pot of English breakfast tea, the way you'd host a guest in a tiny burrow.

snacks.name: Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dip
snacks.scene: the bog, but this one smells good
snacks.method: Whole heads of garlic roasted at 180C for 45 minutes, squeezed and whipped into cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, with crusty bread.

mains.name: Ballroom roast chicken
mains.scene: the masked ball in the bubble
mains.method: Chicken roasted with butter, thyme and lemon at 220C then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes and a white wine pan gravy.

mains.name: Hoggle's stew
mains.scene: Hoggle the dwarf and his little garden
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, onion, carrot and mushroom, red wine and stock, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Mash on the side.

dessert.name: Poached peaches
dessert.scene: the peach that sends Sarah to the masked ball
dessert.method: Peaches halved and poached in a syrup of white wine, sugar and vanilla for 10 minutes, skins slipped off, chilled in the syrup, served with mascarpone and a crumble of almond biscuits.

drink.name: Goblin King's punch
drink.method: Apple and pear juice simmered with cinnamon and star anise, served warm, or cold over ice.

films.title: Chicken Run
films.tagline: No chickens were harmed in the making of this menu.
films.description: A coop of chickens plan a great escape from a farm before they end up in pies.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pies when Mrs Tweedy fires up the pie machine.

snacks.name: Egg sandwiches
snacks.scene: the eggs the chickens have to lay to stay alive
snacks.method: Eggs boiled 10 minutes, mashed with mayo, chives and white pepper, on soft white bread with cress, cut into triangles.

snacks.name: Nick and Fetcher's trading crackers
snacks.scene: the rats who trade smuggled goods for eggs
snacks.method: Cheddar and crackers with pickled onions and apple chutney, the kind of thing a pair of rats might carry in.

snacks.name: Babs's knitted cheese straws
snacks.scene: Babs never stops knitting
snacks.method: Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in parmesan and paprika, cut into strips and twisted like yarn, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.

mains.name: Pie machine pies
mains.scene: Mrs Tweedy's pie machine, beef only
mains.method: Beef chuck braised in ale with onion and thyme for 2.5 hours, thickened, cooled, in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. No chicken, ever.

mains.name: Yorkshire farm vegetable pie
mains.scene: for the vegetarians in the coop
mains.method: Leek, mushroom, potato and cheddar in a creamy sauce, under puff pastry, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until golden.

dessert.name: Escape plane jam roly-poly
dessert.scene: a proper British pudding for the flight
dessert.method: Suet or butter pastry spread with raspberry jam, rolled up, wrapped loosely in paper and foil, baked at 180C for 40 minutes. Custard.

drink.name: Tea for the coop
drink.method: English breakfast tea brewed strong in a big pot, milk and sugar on the side.

films.title: Weekend at Bernie's
films.tagline: Bernie's throwing a party. He just doesn't know it.
films.description: Two junior employees pretend their dead boss is alive at his beach house for the weekend.
films.serve_cue: Serve the cocktails when the guests turn up at Bernie's beach house.

snacks.name: Beach house prawn cocktail
snacks.scene: the party on the deck
snacks.method: Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, served in glasses over iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and horseradish.

snacks.name: Hamptons clam dip
snacks.scene: a weekend in the Hamptons
snacks.method: Chopped clams folded through cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and chives, with potato chips.

snacks.name: Rumaki
snacks.scene: a tiki party classic
snacks.method: Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, brushed with soy, brown sugar and ginger, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.

mains.name: Lobster clambake
mains.scene: Bernie's beach house dinner
mains.method: Lobster tails, clams, corn and small potatoes steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic and butter, tipped onto the table.

mains.name: Grilled steak and pineapple
mains.scene: the deck barbecue
mains.method: Sirloin marinated in soy, garlic and pineapple juice, grilled to medium-rare, with grilled pineapple and coconut rice.

dessert.name: Pineapple upside-down cake
dessert.scene: the retro party dessert
dessert.method: Brown sugar and butter in the tin, pineapple rings and cherries on top, butter cake batter poured over, baked at 175C for 45 minutes, flipped.

drink.name: Mai tai
drink.method: 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime, shaken with ice, mint on top.

films.title: Jaws
films.tagline: You're gonna need a bigger platter.
films.description: A police chief, a marine scientist and a fisherman hunt a great white shark off a summer resort island.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Quint and Hooper compare scars.

snacks.name: Amity Island clam strips
snacks.scene: the beach town on the Fourth of July
snacks.method: Clam meat or calamari strips soaked in buttermilk, dredged in fine cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, tartare and lemon.

snacks.name: Chum bucket dip
snacks.scene: Brody's least favourite job
snacks.method: A smoked trout dip: hot-smoked trout flaked into cream cheese, sour cream, lemon, dill and horseradish, served in a little bucket with crackers.

snacks.name: Shark fin corn chips
snacks.scene: the fin on the horizon
snacks.method: Tortillas cut into fin shapes, brushed with oil, baked at 180C until crisp, with blue corn chips and a fresh tomato salsa.

mains.name: Lobster rolls
mains.scene: an Amity Island summer
mains.method: Cooked lobster chopped, folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted rolls. Chips.

mains.name: New England clam chowder
mains.scene: the Orca's galley
mains.method: Clams steamed in white wine, bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk, cream and clams in at the end, oyster crackers.

dessert.name: Bigger boat sundae
dessert.scene: you're gonna need a bigger bowl
dessert.method: Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a shark fin cut from a dark chocolate disc.

drink.name: Quint's beer
drink.method: American lager, ice cold, drunk from the can.

films.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
films.tagline: Alrighty then. Dinner is served.
films.description: A pet detective hunts for the Miami football team's kidnapped dolphin mascot before the big game.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Ace finds the dolphin in the rich guy's private tank.

snacks.name: Miami croquetas
snacks.scene: a Miami café counter snack
snacks.method: Ham and béchamel thickened with plenty of flour, chilled overnight, shaped into logs, rolled in egg and breadcrumbs, fried at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Lime alongside.

snacks.name: Ace's apartment animal crackers
snacks.scene: the dozens of animals hiding in his flat
snacks.method: Shortbread dough with a little honey and cinnamon, rolled thin, cut into animal shapes, baked at 170C for 10 minutes, half dipped in white chocolate with sprinkles.

snacks.name: Tropical fruit skewers
snacks.scene: the Florida heat
snacks.method: Pineapple, mango and papaya chunks threaded on skewers, grilled hot for a minute a side, brushed with lime juice, honey and a pinch of chilli salt.

mains.name: Cuban sandwich
mains.scene: a Miami lunch on the run
mains.method: Pork shoulder marinated in orange, lime, garlic and oregano, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, sliced, layered in Cuban bread with ham, Swiss, pickles and mustard, pressed flat and toasted in butter.

mains.name: Football game day wings
mains.scene: the big game in Miami
mains.method: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, blue cheese dip and celery sticks.

dessert.name: Key lime pie
dessert.scene: a Florida classic
dessert.method: Biscuit crumb and butter pressed into a tin, condensed milk whisked with egg yolks, lime zest and juice, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, chilled overnight, whipped cream on top.

drink.name: Mojito
drink.method: Mint and lime muddled gently with sugar, 45ml white rum, crushed ice, topped with soda water and stirred.

films.title: Caddyshack
films.tagline: Be the ball. Be the buffet.
films.description: Caddies, golfers and a groundskeeper at war with a gopher all clash at a snobby country club.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Al Czervik starts making noise in the club dining room.

snacks.name: Bushwood club sandwiches
snacks.scene: the country club lunch room
snacks.method: Three slices of toast layered with roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned with toothpicks and cut into quarters.

snacks.name: Gopher hole dip
snacks.scene: Carl's endless war on the gopher
snacks.method: A hollowed cob loaf filled with a hot spinach and cheese dip, baked at 180C for 25 minutes, the scooped bread toasted for dipping.

snacks.name: Caddy shack hot dogs
snacks.scene: the caddies' lunch break
snacks.method: Cocktail franks simmered, tucked into mini rolls with mustard and sweet relish, served in a paper boat.

mains.name: Judge Smails's prime rib
mains.scene: the members' dinner at the club
mains.method: Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved thick, with horseradish cream and a baked potato.

mains.name: Al Czervik's surf and turf
mains.scene: the loud new money at the club
mains.method: Eye fillet seared and finished at 54C, topped with garlic prawns cooked in butter and lemon, served with fries.

dessert.name: Country club sundae
dessert.scene: the snack bar by the pool
dessert.method: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry in a tall glass. Floating in a pool, never.

drink.name: Half and half iced tea
drink.method: Half iced tea brewed strong and cooled, half fresh lemonade, poured over plenty of ice with a lemon wheel.

films.title: Animal House
films.tagline: Toga. Toga. Toga.
films.description: The misfit Delta fraternity takes on the dean of Faber College.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Bluto yells food fight.

snacks.name: Cafeteria tray snacks
snacks.scene: Bluto loading his tray in the cafeteria
snacks.method: Little bowls of mashed potato with gravy, jelly cubes and buttered dinner rolls, served on a cafeteria tray. Eat it, don't throw it.

snacks.name: Toga party grapes
snacks.scene: the toga party
snacks.method: Grapes frozen for 2 hours, piled on a big platter with olives, feta and pita, so everyone can eat like Romans.

snacks.name: Dexter Lake Club wings
snacks.scene: the road trip to the roadhouse
snacks.method: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in a barbecue and honey glaze.

mains.name: Delta house sloppy joes
mains.scene: cheap food for a broke fraternity
mains.method: Beef mince browned with onion and capsicum, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, brown sugar and mustard, simmered 20 minutes until thick, piled onto toasted soft buns.

mains.name: Homecoming parade hot dogs
mains.scene: the homecoming parade they wreck
mains.method: Franks simmered 5 minutes then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, onions cooked slowly in butter and warm sauerkraut with caraway.

dessert.name: Food fight cupcakes
dessert.scene: the cafeteria, before it goes up
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with buttercream in bright colours, safe to throw. Please don't.

drink.name: Toga party punch
drink.method: Fruit punch of pineapple and orange juice, lemonade and vodka for the adults, in a big bowl with sliced fruit.

films.title: Happy Gilmore
films.tagline: The price is wrong. The food is right.
films.description: A failed hockey player discovers he can hit a golf ball a mile and joins the pro tour to save his grandma's house.
films.serve_cue: Serve the beer when Happy goes to his happy place.

snacks.name: Hockey puck sliders
snacks.scene: Happy's first love, ice hockey
snacks.method: Beef sliders pressed into thick round pucks, seared hard, cheddar melted on, pickles and onion on soft slider buns.

snacks.name: Golf ball cheese balls
snacks.scene: the ball he hits a mile
snacks.method: Cream cheese, cheddar, Worcestershire and spring onion rolled into golf ball sizes, coated in toasted crushed pecans, on toothpicks.

snacks.name: Grandma's biscuits
snacks.scene: the grandma he's saving the house for
snacks.method: Buttermilk biscuits: flour, cold butter and buttermilk folded and cut, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with butter and honey.

mains.name: Clubhouse steak sandwich
mains.scene: lunch at the pro tour clubhouse
mains.method: Rump steak seasoned and seared hard in a smoking pan, rested, sliced thin, piled onto toasted ciabatta with onions cooked slowly in butter, melted Swiss and a horseradish mayo.

mains.name: Grandma's meatloaf
mains.scene: Sunday tea at Grandma's before the house is taken
mains.method: Beef and pork mince mixed lightly with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, grated onion and egg, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.

dessert.name: Happy place lemon bars
dessert.scene: go to your happy place
dessert.method: Buttery shortbread base under a sharp lemon custard, baked until just set and showered with icing sugar.

drink.name: Two pitchers of beer
drink.method: American lager poured into two big chilled jugs, glasses on the side, everyone helps themselves.

films.title: Office Space
films.tagline: Looks like someone has a case of the Mondays. Have a snack.
films.description: A fed-up software engineer stops caring about his job and plots against the company with his mates.
films.serve_cue: Serve the cake when the office birthday cake goes round and skips Milton.

snacks.name: Chain restaurant loaded potato skins
snacks.scene: the flair-heavy restaurant across the road
snacks.method: Small potatoes baked, halved and scooped, brushed with butter and crisped at 220C, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked again, sour cream and chives.

snacks.name: TPS report crackers
snacks.scene: did you get the memo
snacks.method: Lavash cut into neat rectangles like sheets of paper, brushed with oil and salt, baked at 180C until crisp, stacked with a whipped feta dip in the middle.

snacks.name: Red stapler capsicum strips
snacks.scene: Milton's red stapler
snacks.method: Red capsicums roasted whole at 220C until blackened, peeled, cut into strips, dressed with olive oil, garlic, sherry vinegar and basil, on toasted bread.

mains.name: Peter's fish
mains.scene: Peter gutting a fish on his desk
mains.method: Snapper fillets dusted in seasoned flour, pan-fried skin down in butter until crisp, with lemon, capers and parsley. Chips and a green salad.

mains.name: Restaurant ribs
mains.scene: the place where flair is mandatory
mains.method: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with barbecue sauce under a hot grill. Coleslaw.

dessert.name: Office birthday cake
dessert.scene: Milton never gets a slice, you all do
dessert.method: Vanilla sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fluffy buttercream, cut into enough squares for everyone, Milton first.

drink.name: Office coffee
drink.method: Filter coffee made fresh in a big pot, milk and sugar on the side, mugs from the cupboard.

films.title: Forrest Gump
films.tagline: Life is like a box of chocolates. So is this menu.
films.description: A kind man from Alabama ends up at the centre of decades of American history.
films.serve_cue: Serve the prawns when Bubba starts listing all the ways to cook shrimp.

snacks.name: Box of chocolates
snacks.scene: you never know what you're gonna get
snacks.method: Dark chocolate tempered and poured into moulds, filled with salted caramel, raspberry ganache and peanut butter, set and mixed in a box.

snacks.name: Bubba's barbecue prawns
snacks.scene: the first on Bubba's long list
snacks.method: Green prawns skewered, brushed with butter, garlic, paprika and cayenne, grilled 2 minutes a side, lemon squeezed over.

snacks.name: Bus stop bench biscuits
snacks.scene: Forrest's spot on the bench
snacks.method: Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and filled with ham and honey mustard.

mains.name: Bubba's prawn gumbo
mains.scene: shrimp gumbo, one of the many
mains.method: Dark roux of oil and flour stirred 30 minutes, onion, celery and capsicum, garlic, stock and smoked sausage, simmered an hour, prawns in for 3 minutes. Rice.

mains.name: Alabama fried chicken
mains.scene: home cooking in Greenbow
mains.method: Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk overnight, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Collard greens and mash.

dessert.name: Peach cobbler
dessert.scene: an Alabama dessert
dessert.method: Sliced peaches with sugar and cinnamon, buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.

drink.name: Cherry cola
drink.scene: the soft drinks at the White House
drink.method: Cola over ice with a splash of cherry syrup and a maraschino cherry.

films.title: Pretty Woman
films.tagline: Big mistake. Huge. Order the strawberries.
films.description: A businessman hires a woman for a week in Beverly Hills and they fall for each other.
films.serve_cue: Serve the strawberries and bubbles when Edward orders them up to the penthouse.

snacks.name: Strawberries and champagne
snacks.scene: they bring out the flavour of the champagne
snacks.method: The ripest strawberries you can find, washed, dried properly and chilled, piled in a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. A very cold bottle of bubbles alongside.

snacks.name: Slippery little snails
snacks.scene: the snail that flies across the restaurant
snacks.method: Escargot or button mushrooms tucked into a dish, each covered with butter mashed with garlic, parsley, shallot and a splash of brandy, baked at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Bread for the butter.

snacks.name: Polo match canapés
snacks.scene: the afternoon at the polo
snacks.method: Blinis warmed, topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, and cucumber cups filled with goat's cheese whipped with lemon zest and chives.

mains.name: The business dinner
mains.scene: the dinner where she learns which fork to use
mains.method: Eye fillet seasoned and seared hard, roasted at 200C to 54C, rested, with a red wine jus reduced from shallots, wine and stock, a potato gratin baked slowly in cream, and green beans.

mains.name: Penthouse room service
mains.scene: ordering everything off the room service menu
mains.method: Club sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo on three slices of toast, pinned and cut into triangles, a silver bowl of shoestring fries.

dessert.name: Chocolate-dipped strawberries
dessert.scene: dessert after the night at the opera
dessert.method: Strawberries dried completely, dipped in tempered dark chocolate, set on baking paper, then drizzled with thin lines of melted white chocolate.

drink.name: Champagne
drink.method: Champagne chilled in an ice bucket for 30 minutes, poured into flutes.

films.title: The Karate Kid
films.tagline: Wax on. Wax off. Eat up.
films.description: A new kid in town learns karate from an apartment handyman to stand up to bullies.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Mr Miyagi catches the fly with chopsticks.

snacks.name: Chopstick snacks
snacks.scene: catching a fly with chopsticks
snacks.method: Edamame steamed 4 minutes and tossed with flaky salt and sesame oil, plus cucumber batons quick-pickled for 20 minutes in rice vinegar, sugar and sesame. Chopsticks only.

snacks.name: Okinawan sweet potato chips
snacks.scene: Mr Miyagi grew up in Okinawa
snacks.method: Purple sweet potato sliced paper thin on a mandoline, soaked 20 minutes, dried, fried at 170C until crisp, salted, with a wasabi mayo for dipping.

snacks.name: Bonsai broccolini
snacks.scene: Miyagi trimming his little trees
snacks.method: Broccolini blanched 1 minute, charred in a smoking pan with garlic, tossed in oyster sauce and sesame oil, stood up in a little dish like a row of trees.

mains.name: Country club spaghetti
mains.scene: the plate of spaghetti Daniel ends up wearing
mains.method: Big plate of spaghetti in a rich tomato and beef sauce with parmesan. Best eaten, not worn.

mains.name: Okinawan pork noodles
mains.scene: a bowl from Miyagi's home island
mains.method: Pork belly simmered in soy, mirin, sugar and ginger for 2 hours until soft, served on thick wheat noodles in a broth of chicken stock and bonito, pickled ginger on top.

dessert.name: Wax on wax off mochi
dessert.scene: wax on, wax off
dessert.method: Glutinous rice flour, sugar and water stirred into a dough, steamed 20 minutes, kneaded smooth, wrapped around balls of red bean paste and dusted with cornflour.

drink.name: Green tea
drink.method: Sencha steeped in water just off the boil (about 80C) for 1 minute, poured into small cups.

films.title: Kung Fu Hustle
films.tagline: The Axe Gang is coming. Dinner's not.
films.description: A small-time crook in 1940s Shanghai tangles with a gang and the hidden kung fu masters of a run-down tenement.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the Landlady comes out in her curlers.

snacks.name: Pigsty Alley pork buns
snacks.scene: the poor tenement where everyone lives
snacks.method: Yeasted dough proved an hour, wrapped around char siu pork chopped with oyster sauce, hoisin and sugar, proved again 20 minutes, steamed 12 minutes.

snacks.name: The baker's doughnuts
snacks.scene: one of the masters hiding as a baker
snacks.method: Youtiao: dough of flour, baking powder and a little salt rested overnight, two strips pressed together, stretched and fried at 190C until puffed and golden. Warm soy milk to dip.

snacks.name: Lollipop girl's lollies
snacks.scene: the ice cream seller from Sing's childhood
snacks.method: Hard candy lollipops: sugar, glucose and water boiled to 150C, a drop of lemon and colour, poured into rounds on baking paper with sticks pressed in.

mains.name: Landlady's wonton noodle soup
mains.scene: the Landlady in curlers, yelling at everyone
mains.method: Pork and prawn wontons folded and boiled 3 minutes, in a clear broth of chicken stock, ginger and a little soy, on thin egg noodles with choy sum and spring onion.

mains.name: Axe Gang salt and pepper pork
mains.scene: the gang that dances into every scene
mains.method: Pork belly in strips coated in potato starch, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in a wok with garlic, chilli, spring onion and Sichuan salt and pepper. Steamed rice.

dessert.name: Mango sago
dessert.scene: a sweet for Pigsty Alley
dessert.method: Sago boiled 15 minutes until clear, rinsed, chilled in coconut milk, topped with blitzed ripe mango and fresh mango cubes.

drink.name: Chrysanthemum tea
drink.method: Dried chrysanthemum flowers steeped 5 minutes in hot water with a little rock sugar, served warm or iced.

films.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
films.tagline: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Sushi too.
films.description: A former assassin wakes from a coma and goes after the people who tried to kill her.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sushi when the Bride walks into Hattori Hanzo's sushi bar.

snacks.name: Hattori Hanzo's sushi
snacks.scene: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
snacks.method: Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri with sliced salmon and tuna, a dab of wasabi, served on a board with pickled ginger.

snacks.name: House of Blue Leaves gyoza
snacks.scene: the Tokyo restaurant before the fight
snacks.method: Pork, cabbage, garlic, ginger and spring onion folded into wrappers, fried until the bottoms brown, steamed under a lid, with a soy and black vinegar dip.

snacks.name: Yellow tracksuit corn
snacks.scene: the yellow suit
snacks.method: Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with miso butter, sprinkled with shichimi and spring onion.

mains.name: Tokyo yakitori
mains.scene: the restaurant's grill
mains.method: Chicken thigh skewers and chicken and spring onion skewers grilled over high heat, brushed with a tare of soy, mirin, sake and sugar reduced. Rice.

mains.name: O-Ren's ramen
mains.scene: the Tokyo underworld boss
mains.method: Tonkotsu-style broth of pork bones simmered 8 hours, ramen noodles, chashu pork belly, soft egg and nori.

dessert.name: Matcha ice cream
dessert.scene: cold, like revenge
dessert.method: Matcha sifted and whisked into warm milk and cream, poured onto yolks beaten with sugar, cooked to 82C, strained, chilled overnight and churned.

drink.name: Hanzo's sake
drink.scene: Hanzo and the Bride share a drink
drink.method: Junmai sake warmed to 45C in a flask, poured into small cups.

films.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
films.tagline: The Bride is back. She's hungry.
films.description: The Bride works through the rest of her list and finally faces Bill.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the Bride finally reaches Bill's place in Mexico.

snacks.name: Pai Mei's rice bowl
snacks.scene: the bowl of rice Pai Mei knocks away
snacks.method: Short grain rice washed until the water runs clear, cooked with a splash of sake, served in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a soft egg boiled 6 and a half minutes. Chopsticks only.

snacks.name: El Paso chapel tacos
snacks.scene: the wedding rehearsal at the little chapel in Texas
snacks.method: Beef cheeks braised 4 hours with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until they shred, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander, lime and a fierce salsa roja.

snacks.name: Budd's trailer snacks
snacks.scene: Budd's run-down trailer in the desert
snacks.method: Corn chips with a hot cheese sauce of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with pickled jalapeño juice, beef jerky on the side, all in plastic bowls.

mains.name: Hacienda carnitas
mains.scene: Bill's villa in Mexico
mains.method: Pork shoulder in big chunks simmered slowly in lard with orange, garlic, bay and salt for 3 hours, then crisped hard in a hot pan, in tortillas with salsa verde of charred tomatillo, chilli and coriander.

mains.name: Tuna melts for B.B.
mains.scene: a kid's dinner at the villa
mains.method: Tinned tuna mixed with mayo, celery, spring onion and lemon, piled on sourdough, covered in cheddar, grilled until the cheese bubbles. Cut into fingers for little hands.

dessert.name: Pai Mei's almond cookies
dessert.scene: training with Pai Mei
dessert.method: Crumbly Chinese almond cookies with an almond pressed into each. Beat 150g butter with 120g sugar and 1 egg, add 1 tsp almond extract, then 220g flour, 50g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder.

drink.name: Tequila and lime
drink.method: 30ml blanco tequila in a chilled shot glass, a lime wedge and a pinch of salt on the side.

films.title: Lost in Translation
films.tagline: Jet lagged, wide awake, and hungry.
films.description: A fading actor and a young woman, both stuck awake in a Tokyo hotel, form an unlikely bond.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Bob and Charlotte sit down to cook their own shabu-shabu.

snacks.name: Hotel bar edamame and nuts
snacks.scene: the bar high above Tokyo where they meet
snacks.method: Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed with flaky salt and sesame oil, and rice crackers with wasabi peas in little lacquer bowls.

snacks.name: Karaoke night karaage
snacks.scene: the karaoke night in the private room
snacks.method: Chicken thigh pieces marinated in soy, sake, ginger and garlic for an hour, coated in potato starch, fried at 160C, rested, fried again at 190C. Japanese mayo and lemon.

snacks.name: Convenience store onigiri
snacks.scene: the 3am walks through the city
snacks.method: Warm short grain rice shaped into triangles around tuna mayo or salted salmon, wrapped in a strip of nori just before eating.

mains.name: Shabu-shabu
mains.scene: the restaurant where Bob complains you have to cook it yourself
mains.method: Kombu simmered in water for a broth at the table, paper-thin beef, tofu, wombok, enoki and spring onion swished through, dipped in ponzu and sesame sauce. Rice to finish.

mains.name: Kyoto udon
mains.scene: Charlotte's day trip to the temples
mains.method: Thick udon in a dashi of kombu and bonito with soy and mirin, topped with spring onion, a soft egg and tempura flakes.

dessert.name: Matcha soft serve
dessert.scene: the bright lights of Shibuya
dessert.method: Matcha whisked into sweetened condensed milk and cream, whipped to soft peaks, frozen 6 hours, scooped soft into cones.

drink.name: Japanese whisky highball
drink.scene: the drink Bob is in Tokyo to sell
drink.method: 45ml Japanese whisky in a tall glass packed with ice, topped with very cold soda water, stirred once, a twist of lemon.

films.title: Tombstone
films.tagline: I'm your huckleberry. Pass the beans.
films.description: Wyatt Earp and his brothers settle in Tombstone and clash with a gang of outlaws.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday sits down at the faro table.

snacks.name: Oriental Saloon pickled eggs
snacks.scene: the saloon where Wyatt runs the faro table
snacks.method: Eggs boiled 10 minutes, peeled, packed into a jar with hot vinegar, beetroot juice, sugar, mustard seed and peppercorns, pickled 3 days until pink.

snacks.name: Cowboy jerky and crackers
snacks.scene: the long rides out of town
snacks.method: Beef topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and smoked paprika, dried at 70C for 4 hours, with crackers and sharp cheddar.

snacks.name: Faro night cornbread
snacks.scene: a long night at the tables
snacks.method: Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.

mains.name: Saloon steak and beans
mains.scene: a frontier town supper
mains.method: Rump steak seared over hot coals, rested, with beans simmered 2 hours with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard. Crusty bread.

mains.name: Earp brothers' chilli
mains.scene: the Earps' first night in Tombstone
mains.method: Beef chuck diced, browned, braised 3 hours with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato, no beans, Texas style. Cornbread alongside.

dessert.name: Josephine's peach pie
dessert.scene: the actress who catches Wyatt's eye
dessert.method: Peaches sliced with sugar, lemon and cornflour, in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Cream.

drink.name: Doc's whiskey
drink.scene: Doc Holliday never without a glass
drink.method: 45ml rye whiskey neat in a small glass, a jug of water on the table.

films.title: Blazing Saddles
films.tagline: Beans. Lots of beans.
films.description: A Black sheriff is sent to a racist frontier town as part of a scheme to drive everyone out.
films.serve_cue: Serve the beans when the cowboys sit around the campfire.

snacks.name: Rock Ridge welcome pie
snacks.scene: the townsfolk's welcome for the new sheriff
snacks.method: Mini apple pies: Granny Smiths cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, spooned into shortcrust cases, lidded, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.

snacks.name: Candygram chocolates
snacks.scene: Bart's candygram for Mongo
snacks.method: Chocolate truffles: dark chocolate melted into hot cream, chilled, rolled and coated in cocoa, packed into a little box with a bow.

snacks.name: Waco Kid's whiskey nuts
snacks.scene: the fastest gun, recovering
snacks.method: Peanuts and pecans tossed in butter, brown sugar, smoked paprika and a splash of bourbon, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes.

mains.name: Campfire beans
mains.scene: the scene everyone remembers
mains.method: Dried beans soaked overnight, simmered 3 hours with smoked ham hock, onion, molasses, mustard, tomato and chilli until thick. Cornbread.

mains.name: Chuck wagon steaks
mains.scene: the railroad crew's supper on the trail
mains.method: Rib eyes seasoned heavily with salt and cracked pepper, seared over hot coals or in a cast iron pan, rested 8 minutes, with potatoes and onions fried slowly in butter in the same pan.

dessert.name: Frontier cobbler
dessert.scene: dessert on the trail out of Rock Ridge
dessert.method: Peaches and blackberries tossed with sugar and a little cornflour, covered with spoonfuls of buttery biscuit dough, sprinkled with raw sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes until bubbling. Cream.

drink.name: Sarsaparilla
drink.method: Sarsaparilla poured over ice, or 45ml bourbon on the rocks for the cowboys.

films.title: Smokey and the Bandit
films.tagline: Eastbound and down. Pass the ribs.
films.description: A bootlegger runs a truckload of beer across state lines with a sheriff chasing him the whole way.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the Bandit picks up Frog by the side of the road.

snacks.name: Truck stop pork rinds
snacks.scene: the truckers' stops on the CB radio
snacks.method: Pork rind scored, salted and dried in the fridge overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling, broken up and dusted with smoked paprika and cayenne.

snacks.name: Georgia boiled peanuts
snacks.scene: the run back into Georgia
snacks.method: Raw peanuts in the shell boiled 2 hours in heavily salted water with a little Cajun spice, left to soak an hour, served warm in paper cups.

snacks.name: Sheriff Justice's pickled okra
snacks.scene: a Texas sheriff a long way from home
snacks.method: Okra packed into jars with garlic, dill and chilli, covered in hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, served cold with sharp cheddar.

mains.name: Southern barbecue ribs
mains.scene: eastbound to Georgia
mains.method: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar, garlic and cayenne, smoked or baked wrapped at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tangy vinegar barbecue sauce under the grill. Coleslaw.

mains.name: Truck stop chicken fried steak
mains.scene: a quick stop while the Snowman keeps rolling
mains.method: Minute steaks pounded thin, dredged in seasoned flour, buttermilk and flour again, fried until crisp, smothered in cracked pepper cream gravy. Mash.

dessert.name: Georgia peach cobbler
dessert.scene: Atlanta, at last
dessert.method: Sliced peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and lemon, covered in buttery biscuit dough, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.

drink.name: Cold beer
drink.method: Light American lager ice cold from an esky, or a sweet iced tea for the drivers.

films.title: Three Amigos!
films.tagline: A plethora of tacos.
films.description: Three silent film stars mistake a real call for help from a Mexican village for a paid show.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains at El Guapo's birthday party.

snacks.name: Cantina nachos
snacks.scene: the cantina where they start a brawl
snacks.method: Corn chips layered with black beans and cheddar, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with pico de gallo, pickled jalapeño, guacamole and sour cream.

snacks.name: Santo Poco street corn
snacks.scene: the little village they ride in to save
snacks.method: Corn cobs grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander.

snacks.name: Singing bush salsa
snacks.scene: the singing bush in the desert
snacks.method: Green salsa: tomatillos and green chillies charred, blitzed with onion, garlic, coriander and lime, served with warm tortilla chips.

mains.name: El Guapo's birthday tacos
mains.scene: the bandit's birthday party
mains.method: Pork shoulder marinated in achiote, orange and garlic, roasted wrapped at 160C for 4 hours, shredded, in corn tortillas with pickled red onion and habanero salsa.

mains.name: Hollywood chicken enchiladas
mains.scene: back on the studio lot
mains.method: Poached chicken rolled in corn tortillas, covered in red chilli sauce and cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.

dessert.name: Birthday churros
dessert.scene: El Guapo's birthday cake, sort of
dessert.method: Choux dough piped into hot oil at 180C, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.

drink.name: Cantina margarita
drink.method: 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime shaken with ice, salt rim.

films.title: Rocky
films.tagline: Yo, Adrian. Dinner.
films.description: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a shot at the world heavyweight title.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Rocky runs up the museum steps.

snacks.name: Philly cheesesteak bites
snacks.scene: a Philadelphia classic
snacks.method: Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared on a hot plate with onions, provolone melted over, piled into mini rolls.

snacks.name: Italian Market antipasto
snacks.scene: the run through the Italian Market
snacks.method: Salami, prosciutto, provolone, marinated artichoke, olives and roasted capsicum on a board with crusty bread.

snacks.name: Soft pretzels
snacks.scene: a Philly street snack
snacks.method: Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Yellow mustard.

mains.name: Thanksgiving turkey
mains.scene: the turkey Paulie throws out the back door
mains.method: Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested, sliced, with stuffing, cranberry sauce and gravy. Keep it on the table.

mains.name: Meat locker steak
mains.scene: the sides of beef Rocky punches in Paulie's meat locker
mains.method: Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seasoned with cracked pepper, seared in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, pulled at 54C and rested. Roast potatoes.

dessert.name: Adrian's pet shop turtles
dessert.scene: Cuff and Link, the turtles from Adrian's pet shop
dessert.method: Little clusters of toasted pecans topped with a spoon of soft caramel and a cap of melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper so each one looks like a turtle.

drink.name: Training shake
drink.scene: the five raw eggs at 4am, but drinkable
drink.method: A ripe banana, cold milk, a big spoon of peanut butter, oats and a little honey blended thick. Rocky's raw egg version not recommended.

films.title: Rocky IV
films.tagline: If he dies, he dies. If you're hungry, eat.
films.description: Rocky travels to the Soviet Union to fight the giant boxer who killed his friend.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Rocky starts training in the Siberian snow.

snacks.name: Moscow blini
snacks.scene: the long winter in the Soviet Union
snacks.method: Buckwheat and plain flour batter with yeast and milk, rested an hour, cooked small in butter, topped with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill.

snacks.name: Log cabin pickles
snacks.scene: the farmhouse where Rocky trains
snacks.method: Cucumbers packed into jars with garlic, dill, peppercorns and a hot salted brine, left on the bench 4 days to ferment sour, served with rye bread and butter.

snacks.name: Paulie's birthday robot cake pops
snacks.scene: Paulie's birthday present, the talking robot
snacks.method: Chocolate cake crumbled into cream cheese frosting, rolled into balls, chilled, dipped in silver-tinted white chocolate on sticks.

mains.name: Siberian borscht
mains.scene: a hot bowl after chopping wood in the snow
mains.method: Beef shin simmered 2 hours, beetroot, carrot, onion, cabbage and potato added, tomato paste and vinegar, simmered until soft, finished with dill and sour cream.

mains.name: Pelmeni
mains.scene: Soviet dumplings for the training camp
mains.method: Beef and pork mince with grated onion and pepper wrapped in thin dough, boiled 5 minutes until they float, tossed in butter with dill and a spoon of sour cream.

dessert.name: Siberian snowball tea cakes
dessert.scene: training in the Siberian snow
dessert.method: Buttery walnut shortbread balls rolled twice in icing sugar like snowballs. Beat 225g butter with 60g icing sugar and vanilla, then mix in 280g plain flour and 100g finely chopped walnuts.

drink.name: Ice-cold vodka
drink.method: Vodka stored in the freezer, poured into small chilled glasses, with a pickle on the side.

films.id: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004)
films.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
films.tagline: Stay classy. Stay hungry.
films.description: A San Diego news anchor's world is turned upside down when a talented woman joins the newsroom.
films.serve_cue: Serve the cheese when Ron finds out Baxter ate a whole wheel of cheese.

snacks.name: Baxter's wheel of cheese
snacks.scene: the dog ate a whole wheel, Ron isn't even mad
snacks.method: A whole wheel of brie scored on top, baked at 180C for 15 minutes with honey, thyme and walnuts, served with crackers.

snacks.name: Carne asada fries
snacks.scene: the pride of San Diego, Ron's town
snacks.method: Thin steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, grilled and chopped over crisp fries with melted cheese, guacamole and sour cream.

snacks.name: Brick's lamp chips
snacks.scene: Brick loves lamp, and dip
snacks.method: Potato chips with a dip of slow-cooked onions folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives.

mains.name: San Diego fish tacos
mains.scene: Ron's town, a very big deal
mains.method: White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime crema and pico de gallo.

mains.name: Steakhouse dinner
mains.scene: Ron takes Veronica out on the town
mains.method: Sirloin seared and butter basted to 54C, rested, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream and chives, and creamed spinach.

dessert.name: Milk was a bad choice ice cream
dessert.scene: the hot day Ron drinks a full carton of milk
dessert.method: Vanilla milk ice cream: milk, cream, yolks and sugar cooked to 82C, chilled overnight and churned. Eaten in small bowls, not chugged.

drink.name: Scotchy scotch
drink.method: 45ml blended Scotch over one big ice cube in a heavy tumbler.

films.title: Step Brothers
films.tagline: Did we just become best friends. Yep.
films.description: Two middle-aged men who still live at home become stepbrothers when their parents marry.
films.serve_cue: Serve the wine when the Catalina Wine Mixer starts.

snacks.name: Catalina Wine Mixer canapés
snacks.scene: the yacht club party they somehow end up running
snacks.method: Prawns on cucumber rounds with lemon mayo, crostini with whipped ricotta and honey, and figs wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.

snacks.name: Bunk bed popcorn
snacks.scene: the bunk beds they build with way too much room
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed with melted butter, parmesan and garlic salt, served in big bowls for the top and bottom bunk.

snacks.name: Prestige Worldwide sliders
snacks.scene: the big pitch for their entertainment company
snacks.method: Beef mince rolled into small balls, smashed thin on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on, onions cooked slowly in butter and pickles on soft slider rolls.

mains.name: Robert's sailing dinner
mains.scene: the round-the-world sailing dream
mains.method: Snapper fillets roasted at 200C with lemon, garlic, capers and olive oil, served with herbed new potatoes and a green salad.

mains.name: Family dinner meatloaf
mains.scene: the awkward first dinner as a blended family
mains.method: Beef and pork mince mixed lightly with milk-soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion and egg, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and buttered green beans.

dessert.name: Ice cream sundae bar
dessert.scene: two grown men who never grew up
dessert.method: Vanilla and chocolate ice cream in a big tub on ice, with hot fudge made from dark chocolate melted into cream, sprinkles, whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.

drink.name: Catalina wine
drink.method: A chilled rosé and a crisp white wine on ice in a big tub, poured generously into plastic wine glasses.

films.id: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006)
films.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
films.tagline: If you ain't first, you're last. So eat fast.
films.description: A NASCAR star loses everything to a French rival and has to fight his way back.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Ricky says grace over the family dinner.

snacks.name: Pit stop corn dogs
snacks.scene: the speedway infield
snacks.method: Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Yellow mustard.

snacks.name: Jean Girard's crêpes
snacks.scene: the French driver who reads at the wheel
snacks.method: Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan, folded around ham and gruyère, or sugar and lemon.

snacks.name: Talladega boiled peanuts
snacks.scene: race day in Alabama
snacks.method: Raw peanuts in the shell boiled 2 hours in very salty water with Cajun spice, left to soak an hour, served warm in paper cups.

mains.name: The Bobby family dinner
mains.scene: the grace that turns into a speech
mains.method: A big family takeaway spread made at home: buttermilk fried chicken, a pizza and hard-shell tacos, all on the table at once. Grace optional.

mains.name: Southern barbecue plate
mains.scene: a Sunday race day spread
mains.method: Pulled pork shoulder rubbed and roasted at 150C for 5 hours, shredded with vinegar sauce, on soft buns with coleslaw and pickles.

dessert.name: Chequered flag brownies
dessert.scene: first place, or last
dessert.method: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into squares, half dusted with icing sugar in a chequered pattern.

drink.name: Jean Girard's macchiato
drink.method: A double espresso marked with a small spoon of foamed milk, served in a little glass.

films.title: Zoolander
films.tagline: Really, really, ridiculously good food.
films.description: A dim male model is brainwashed into becoming an assassin by a fashion mogul.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when the boys order orange mocha iced coffees.

snacks.name: Blue steel crudités
snacks.scene: the one look, very serious
snacks.method: Cucumber, celery, carrot and radish cut long and lean, stood up in a glass on ice, with a dip of blue cheese mashed into sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and black pepper.

snacks.name: Day spa cucumber bites
snacks.scene: the day spa where Derek gets the mudpack
snacks.method: Thick cucumber rounds topped with goat's cheese whipped with lemon zest, a curl of smoked salmon and a dill frond, kept very cold.

snacks.name: Coal miner's sandwiches
snacks.scene: Derek's family back home in the mines
snacks.method: Corned silverside simmered 3 hours, cooled and sliced thin, on buttered rye with hot English mustard and dill pickles, wrapped in paper like a miner's lunch.

mains.name: Mugatu's vodka pasta
mains.scene: the fashion mogul's dinner
mains.method: Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of garlic and chilli sautéed in butter, tomato paste fried until brick red, a splash of vodka and cream, parmesan and basil.

mains.name: Hansel's grill night
mains.scene: Hansel, so hot right now
mains.method: Lamb cutlets marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled hot for 2 minutes a side, with a feta, tomato and cucumber salad.

dessert.name: Centre for ants cake
dessert.scene: the scale model that is too small
dessert.method: Vanilla sponges baked at 175C, one in a normal tin and one in a teacup, both covered in white buttercream, so there's a cake for ants and a real one for you.

drink.name: Orange mocha iced coffee
drink.scene: the drink before the petrol station fight
drink.method: Double espresso shaken hard with chocolate syrup, orange zest, cold milk and ice, strained into a tall glass over more ice.

films.title: Meet the Parents
films.tagline: The circle of trust has snacks.
films.description: A male nurse meets his girlfriend's intimidating ex-CIA father for a weekend that goes wrong at every turn.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Greg is asked to say grace at dinner.

snacks.name: Pool volleyball nachos
snacks.scene: the pool volleyball game Greg takes too far
snacks.method: Corn chips layered with black beans and cheddar, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with pico de gallo, sliced jalapeño, guacamole and sour cream.

snacks.name: Mr Jinx's tuna bites
snacks.scene: the cat who uses the toilet
snacks.method: Tuna mixed with mayo, celery, spring onion and lemon, spooned onto crisp cucumber rounds, finished with dill and black pepper.

snacks.name: Garden party devilled eggs
snacks.scene: the Byrnes family's perfect backyard
snacks.method: Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a splash of pickle juice, piped back in, smoked paprika and chives on top.

mains.name: Byrnes family roast
mains.scene: the dinner where Greg says grace
mains.method: Beef sirloin seasoned overnight, roasted at 200C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved, with roast potatoes, buttered carrots and a red wine gravy.

mains.name: Wedding rehearsal salmon
mains.scene: the rehearsal dinner for Pam's sister
mains.method: Salmon fillets roasted at 200C for 10 minutes with a crust of dill, parsley, lemon zest and breadcrumbs, with herbed new potatoes and asparagus.

dessert.name: Gazebo lemon tart
dessert.scene: dessert, well away from the gazebo
dessert.method: Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with lemon juice, zest, eggs, sugar and cream whisked together, baked at 140C for 30 minutes until just set, chilled, icing sugar on top.

drink.name: Jack's milk
drink.scene: a glass at the Byrnes's kitchen bench
drink.method: Ice-cold full cream milk in tall glasses, or blended with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and malt powder into a malted shake.

films.title: Wedding Crashers
films.tagline: Ma, the meatloaf.
films.description: Two divorce mediators crash weddings for fun, until they fall for the daughters of a powerful politician.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the Cleary family sits down to dinner.

snacks.name: Wedding reception canapés
snacks.scene: the weddings they crash
snacks.method: Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, mini crab cakes with lemon aioli, and asparagus wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.

snacks.name: Crab cakes
snacks.scene: the Chesapeake Bay wedding season
snacks.method: Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.

snacks.name: Sailing trip prawn rolls
snacks.scene: the sailing trip that ends badly
snacks.method: Cooked prawns chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.

mains.name: Ma's meatloaf
mains.scene: the meatloaf Chazz yells for
mains.method: Beef and pork mince with milk-soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion, egg and Worcestershire, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash.

mains.name: Cleary family dinner
mains.scene: the very tense family dinner
mains.method: Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a white wine, mustard and tarragon cream sauce, potato gratin and green beans.

dessert.name: Wedding cake
dessert.scene: every wedding they crash has one
dessert.method: Vanilla butter cake baked at 165C, split and layered with raspberry jam and Swiss meringue buttercream (egg whites and sugar heated to 70C, whipped, butter beaten in), served in fingers.

drink.name: Champagne toast
drink.scene: the toast at every reception they crash
drink.method: Sparkling wine well chilled, poured into flutes, raised high while someone gives a speech.

films.title: Old School
films.tagline: We're going streaking. After dinner.
films.description: Three men in their thirties start a fraternity at the house next to a college campus.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Mitch's house party kicks off.

snacks.name: Frat party sliders
snacks.scene: the first big party at Mitch's house
snacks.method: Beef mince smashed thin on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper.

snacks.name: Frank the Tank's wings
snacks.scene: Frank in full party mode
snacks.method: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce with melted butter and honey, blue cheese dip and celery.

snacks.name: Pledge week jalapeño poppers
snacks.scene: the pledges' hazing week
snacks.method: Jalapeños halved and seeded, filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon crisps.

mains.name: Backyard brisket
mains.scene: the barbecue on the lawn
mains.method: Brisket rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, smoked or roasted wrapped at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles, rested an hour, sliced thick. Pickles, white bread and barbecue sauce.

mains.name: Wedding reception chicken
mains.scene: Frank's wedding at the start
mains.method: Chicken breasts pan-roasted in butter and thyme, a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, mashed potato and green beans.

dessert.name: Frat house sheet cake
dessert.scene: the party that never ends
dessert.method: Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares straight from the tray.

drink.name: Party keg
drink.method: American lager on tap or poured cold from bottles into red plastic cups, for the grown-ups only.

films.title: The Hangover
films.tagline: What happens in Vegas gets eaten in Vegas.
films.description: Three friends wake up in a trashed Las Vegas suite with no memory of the night and no sign of the groom.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when the Wolf Pack toasts on the roof.

snacks.name: Vegas buffet prawns
snacks.scene: the casino buffet
snacks.method: Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, piled high on crushed ice with cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon.

snacks.name: Morning after hash browns
snacks.scene: waking up with a tiger in the bathroom
snacks.method: Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into thin cakes, fried in butter and oil until deep golden, a fried egg on top.

snacks.name: Suite chicken nuggets
snacks.scene: the chicken wandering around the suite
snacks.method: Chicken breast in chunks, brined in buttermilk, coated in seasoned flour and crushed cornflakes, fried at 175C for 4 minutes. Honey mustard.

mains.name: Vegas steakhouse
mains.scene: a big night on the Strip
mains.method: Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with creamed spinach, a loaded baked potato and béarnaise.

mains.name: Hangover breakfast burrito
mains.scene: the morning after
mains.method: Flour tortillas filled with soft scrambled eggs, chorizo, potato, cheddar and salsa, rolled, toasted in a dry pan.

dessert.name: Wedding cake for Doug
dessert.scene: the wedding they barely make it back for
dessert.method: Lemon butter cake baked at 170C, split and filled with lemon curd and vanilla buttercream, covered smooth and chilled before slicing.

drink.name: Rooftop toast
drink.scene: the toast on the roof before it all goes wrong
drink.method: 30ml shots of chilled herbal liqueur, or a cold lager for anyone sensible.

films.title: Bridesmaids
films.tagline: Help me, I'm poor. Have a cupcake.
films.description: A maid of honour's life unravels as she competes with a rich new friend over the bride.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Annie bakes her one perfect cupcake.

snacks.name: Paris bridal shower macarons
snacks.scene: Helen's over-the-top Paris themed shower
snacks.method: Almond meal and icing sugar folded into Italian meringue, piped, rested, baked at 145C for 14 minutes, sandwiched with raspberry ganache.

snacks.name: Milwaukee cheese curds
snacks.scene: Annie's Wisconsin home town
snacks.method: Fried battered cheese curds, crunchy outside and squeaky inside, with ranch dressing. Cut 400g firm cheddar or haloumi into 2cm cubes.

snacks.name: Annie's bakery scrolls
snacks.scene: Annie's bakery that didn't make it
snacks.method: Cinnamon scrolls: yeasted dough with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon rolled, cut, proved, baked at 190C for 20 minutes, iced.

mains.name: Wedding chicken
mains.scene: the big wedding Helen plans to the last detail
mains.method: Chicken breasts brined an hour, roasted skin side down in butter then flipped into a 200C oven, finished with a white wine, lemon and thyme cream sauce, with a potato gratin and buttered greens.

mains.name: Plane trip pasta
mains.scene: the trip to Vegas that never makes it past the plane
mains.method: Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of tomato simmered 20 minutes with garlic and chilli, tossed with torn burrata and basil just before serving.

dessert.name: Annie's perfect cupcake
dessert.scene: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
dessert.method: Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with a tall swirl of pale pink Swiss meringue buttercream, finished with a little sugar flower made from fondant.

drink.name: Bridal party rosé spritz
drink.method: Rosé wine, soda and a splash of grapefruit over lots of ice with strawberries. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice and sliced strawberries.

films.title: Hot Fuzz
films.tagline: For the greater good. And the cheese board.
films.description: A top London cop is reassigned to a quiet country village where the accidents keep piling up.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Angel orders a cranberry juice at the pub.

snacks.name: Village pub ploughman's
snacks.scene: the pub where the whole force drinks
snacks.method: Thick slices of mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, a chunky brown pickle, apple and crusty bread with salted butter on a wooden board.

snacks.name: Village fete scotch eggs
snacks.scene: the fete with the coconut shy
snacks.method: Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. English mustard.

snacks.name: Neighbourhood watch sausage rolls
snacks.scene: the Neighbourhood Watch Alliance meeting
snacks.method: Sausage mince with grated apple, sage and onion rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until deep golden.

mains.name: Pub steak and ale pie
mains.scene: a pint and a pie after a long shift
mains.method: Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion, thyme and a little Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Chips and peas.

mains.name: Supermarket roast chicken
mains.scene: the village supermarket with its smiling manager
mains.method: Chicken roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes in the chicken fat, honey roast carrots and bread sauce.

dessert.name: Strawberry ice cream cones
dessert.scene: Danny's favourite ice cream cone
dessert.method: Waffle cones filled with strawberry ice cream rippled with fresh strawberry sauce, dipped in dark chocolate and chopped nuts, frozen until serving.

drink.name: Cranberry juice
drink.scene: Angel's order at the pub, no ice
drink.method: Cold cranberry juice in a pint glass, no ice, a pint of ale for everyone else.

films.title: Tropic Thunder
films.tagline: Never go full jungle. Go full snacks.
films.description: A group of pampered actors shooting a war film end up in a real jungle fight.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Portnoy starts begging for jelly beans.

snacks.name: Portnoy's jelly beans
snacks.scene: he wants them very, very badly
snacks.method: A big bowl of mixed jelly beans, with homemade fruit pastilles: fruit purée, sugar and pectin cooked to 107C, set, cut and rolled in sugar.

snacks.name: Alpa Chino's peanut bars
snacks.scene: the candy bar he's in the film to sell
snacks.method: Roasted peanuts bound with a chewy caramel of brown sugar, golden syrup and butter, pressed into a tray, coated in milk chocolate, cut into bars.

snacks.name: Jungle banh mi bites
snacks.scene: a nod to the Southeast Asian jungle
snacks.method: Small baguettes with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli.

mains.name: Beef pho
mains.scene: the base camp kitchen
mains.method: Beef bones roasted, simmered 6 hours with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon, strained, seasoned with fish sauce, over rice noodles with raw sliced beef, herbs and lime.

mains.name: Thai green curry
mains.scene: the film set in the jungle
mains.method: Green curry paste fried in coconut cream until it splits, chicken thigh, coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, Thai eggplant and basil. Jasmine rice.

dessert.name: Mango sticky rice
dessert.scene: dessert after the jungle
dessert.method: Glutinous rice soaked overnight, steamed 25 minutes, soaked in warm coconut milk with sugar and salt, with ripe mango and a salty coconut sauce.

drink.name: Energy drink mocktail
drink.scene: the energy drink Alpa Chino keeps plugging
drink.method: Passionfruit, lime and ginger syrup topped with soda over ice, a mint sprig.

films.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
films.tagline: If you can dodge a wrench, you can dodge a second helping.
films.description: A rundown gym's misfit members enter a dodgeball tournament to save it from a slick fitness chain.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the team heads to the tournament in Las Vegas.

snacks.name: Five Ds dip platter
snacks.scene: dodge, duck, dip, dive and dodge
snacks.method: Crunchy carrot, celery, cucumber and capsicum sticks with hummus, tzatziki and sweet chilli sour cream to dip into.

snacks.name: Dodgeball meatballs
snacks.scene: round, red and ready to throw
snacks.method: Beef and pork meatballs rolled with parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered in tomato sauce for 30 minutes, served on toothpicks.

snacks.name: Globo Gym protein balls
snacks.scene: White Goodman's very serious fitness empire
snacks.method: Dates, oats, peanut butter, cocoa and a little honey blitzed, rolled into balls and coated in desiccated coconut.

mains.name: Vegas steak and eggs
mains.scene: the final in Las Vegas
mains.method: Seared scotch fillet with a sunny side up egg, hash browns and grilled tomato, casino breakfast at any hour.

mains.name: Patches's training stew
mains.scene: old-school training from Patches O'Houlihan
mains.method: Beef chuck browned hard in batches, onion, carrot and celery softened in the same pot, stock, tomato paste and thyme added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes in for the last hour. Crusty bread.

dessert.name: Underdog cake
dessert.scene: the team nobody believed in
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 40 minutes, covered in fudge frosting, a red fondant ball sitting on top.

drink.name: Sideline sports drink
drink.method: Fresh orange juice and lemon with a pinch of salt and a spoon of honey, topped with soda water over ice.

films.title: School of Rock
films.tagline: Stick it to the man. Then eat.
films.description: A broke rock musician poses as a substitute teacher and turns his class into a band.
