films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the class gets their band parts.

snacks.name: Ned's labelled fridge snacks
snacks.scene: Dewey keeps eating Ned's labelled food
snacks.method: Mini sandwiches of ham, cheese and pickle and egg and lettuce, each wrapped in baking paper with a name written on it in marker.

snacks.name: Battle of the Bands corn dogs
snacks.scene: the big show at the end
snacks.method: Franks on sticks dipped in cornmeal and buttermilk batter, fried at 180C for 4 minutes, yellow mustard and tomato sauce.

snacks.name: Gold star cheese stars
snacks.scene: the prep school's gold stars
snacks.method: Cheddar, butter and flour pastry rolled thin, cut into stars, brushed with egg, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

mains.name: Rock and roll pizza
mains.scene: Dewey's pizza budget
mains.method: Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni and chilli honey, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

mains.name: Roadhouse beer and burgers
mains.scene: Dewey takes the principal out for a beer
mains.method: Thick chuck patties grilled to medium, cheddar, bacon and onion rings on toasted buns, a cold beer alongside.

dessert.name: Guitar-shaped cookies
dessert.scene: every kid gets an instrument
dessert.method: Butter sugar cookies cut into guitars, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red, black and white royal icing.

drink.name: School lunch fruit punch
drink.method: Pineapple and orange juice topped with lemonade, sliced orange and ice in a big jug.

films.title: Mean Girls
films.tagline: On Wednesdays we eat pink.
films.description: A teenager raised in Africa starts at a US high school and gets caught up with the popular girls.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Cady first sees the cafeteria map.

snacks.name: Pink cafeteria wraps
snacks.scene: on Wednesdays they wear pink
snacks.method: Flour tortillas spread with beetroot hummus, filled with roast chicken, rocket and feta, rolled and sliced into pink spirals.

snacks.name: Candy cane grams
snacks.scene: four for you, Glen Coco
snacks.method: Candy canes tied in bundles with ribbon, and peppermint bark of dark and white chocolate with crushed candy cane, broken into shards.

snacks.name: Mathletes pie
snacks.scene: the limit does not exist
snacks.method: Mini apple pies in a muffin tin, shortcrust filled with spiced apple, lattice tops, baked at 190C for 25 minutes. Pi day approved.

mains.name: Cafeteria tray lunch
mains.scene: the cafeteria and its tables
mains.method: Crumbed chicken tenders, buttery mash and a crisp salad on a cafeteria tray, ranch dip on the side.

mains.name: Halloween party tacos
mains.scene: the Halloween party where everyone dresses up
mains.method: Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and a little tomato paste, loosened with stock, spooned into warm hard shells with cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomato and sour cream.

dessert.name: Pink frosted cupcakes
dessert.scene: on Wednesdays, pink
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with buttercream tinted pale pink with a spoon of raspberry purée, finished with pink sprinkles.

drink.name: Pink lemonade
drink.scene: stop trying to make it happen
drink.method: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with a handful of raspberries, strained, topped with cold water and ice.

films.title: Superbad
films.tagline: McLovin is buying. Everyone is eating.
films.description: Two high school best friends spend one long night trying to get supplies for a party.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when they finally make it to Jules's party.

snacks.name: House party onion dip
snacks.scene: the bowls on the kitchen bench at Jules's party
snacks.method: Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Thick ridged potato chips.

snacks.name: Corner shop snack mix
snacks.scene: the shop where McLovin shows his fake ID
snacks.method: Pretzels, cheese crackers and peanuts tossed in melted butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder, baked at 150C for 30 minutes, stirred twice, cooled with chocolate buttons mixed through.

snacks.name: Squad car doughnuts
snacks.scene: the two cops who take McLovin along for the ride
snacks.method: Cake doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes, dipped in a glaze of icing sugar, milk and vanilla, half of them dusted in cinnamon sugar instead.

mains.name: Party pizza
mains.scene: a slice standing up at Jules's party
mains.method: Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with garlic and oregano, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes and left in the box on the bench.

mains.name: Night shift breakfast burritos
mains.scene: Officers Slater and Michaels taking McLovin for a ride
mains.method: Big tortillas filled with scrambled egg, crisp bacon, potato and cheddar, rolled and toasted in the pan.

dessert.name: Last night brownies
dessert.scene: the end of school, the last night together
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar until glossy, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy.

drink.name: McLovin's cherry cola
drink.scene: the most famous fake ID going
drink.method: Cola over ice with a good splash of cherry syrup and a cherry on top.

films.title: 21 Jump Street
films.tagline: Back to high school. Back to the cafeteria.
films.description: Two bumbling young cops go undercover as high school students.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Schmidt throws the house party.

snacks.name: Cafeteria pizza squares
snacks.scene: back in a high school cafeteria at 25
snacks.method: Pizza dough pressed into an oiled tray, crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni right to the edges, baked at 240C for 15 minutes, cut into school-lunch squares.

snacks.name: Undercover cheese quesadillas
snacks.scene: Schmidt and Jenko back in high school undercover
snacks.method: Crisp folded tortillas filled with melted cheddar, spring onion and jalapeño, cut into wedges with salsa.

snacks.name: Chemistry class jelly shots
snacks.scene: Jenko's surprise talent in chemistry, alcohol-free
snacks.method: Raspberry, lime and orange juices set with gelatine in little cups, in three colours, layered like a test tube rack.

mains.name: House party sliders
mains.scene: the party at Schmidt's parents' place
mains.method: Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on, onions cooked slowly, pickles and mustard mayo on soft slider buns.

mains.name: Prom night chicken
mains.scene: the prom with a stretch limo
mains.method: Chicken breasts pan-roasted with butter and thyme, a creamy mushroom sauce, potato gratin and green beans, like a fancy prom dinner.

dessert.name: Graduation cupcakes
dessert.scene: getting through high school, again
dessert.method: Chocolate cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with vanilla buttercream, topped with a little mortarboard of a chocolate square and a lolly button.

drink.name: Jenko's chocolate milk
drink.scene: back in high school, but popular this time
drink.method: Ice-cold chocolate milk shaken with a little malt powder, served in tall glasses. Shake 1L cold milk with 6 tbsp chocolate drinking powder and 2 tbsp malted milk powder in a jar until frothy.

films.title: Night at the Museum
films.tagline: Everything comes to life after dark. Including dinner.
films.description: A new night guard at a natural history museum finds the exhibits come alive after closing.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the T. rex skeleton wants to play fetch.

snacks.name: Roman legion olives and bread
snacks.scene: Octavius and his tiny Roman army
snacks.method: Marinated olives warmed with lemon peel and oregano, served with crusty bread torn for dipping in good olive oil and balsamic.

snacks.name: Dinosaur bone breadsticks
snacks.scene: the T. rex who plays fetch with a bone
snacks.method: Pizza dough rolled into ropes, knotted at both ends into bone shapes, brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Marinara dip.

snacks.name: Gum gum bites
snacks.scene: the Easter Island head who wants gum gum
snacks.method: Watermelon cubes skewered with mint and feta, finished with a squeeze of lime and a pinch of flaky salt, served very cold.

mains.name: Manhattan hot dog cart
mains.scene: the street cart outside the museum
mains.method: Franks simmered in water with onions, in steamed buns with spicy brown mustard, sauerkraut and onions in a tomato sauce.

mains.name: Wild West and Roman dinner
mains.scene: Jedediah and Octavius, the tiny cowboy and the Roman
mains.method: Two little boards: mini beef sliders with cheddar and pickles for the cowboys, and lamb kofta spiced with cumin and mint, grilled hot and served with tzatziki, for the Romans.

dessert.name: Dexter's banana bread
dessert.scene: the monkey who keeps stealing Larry's keys
dessert.method: Ripe bananas mashed with melted butter, brown sugar and eggs, flour and bicarb folded in, baked at 170C for an hour, sliced and toasted with butter.

drink.name: Night guard thermos coffee
drink.method: Drip coffee made strong, poured into a thermos with milk and sugar, sipped through the night.

films.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
films.tagline: Choose your character. Choose your snack.
films.description: Four teens in detention get sucked into a video game and become its avatars.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert, carefully, when Mouse Finch learns his weakness is cake.

snacks.name: Detention snacks
snacks.scene: the four kids stuck in detention clearing out the basement
snacks.method: Salted pretzels, ridged potato chips and chocolate-coated peanuts tossed together in a big bowl, with a small bowl of mixed lollies, like the stash you'd smuggle into detention.

snacks.name: Jungle market skewers
snacks.scene: the bazaar in the game
snacks.method: Chicken thigh skewers marinated in yoghurt, garlic, paprika and lemon, grilled hot, with a garlic yoghurt dip and flatbread.

snacks.name: Bravestone's mango salsa
snacks.scene: Dr Smolder Bravestone in the jungle
snacks.method: Fresh mango, red onion, chilli and coriander with lime, scooped up with corn chips. Dice 2 mangoes and mix with half a diced red onion, 1 chopped chilli, a handful of coriander and the juice of 2 limes.

mains.name: Bravestone's jungle steak
mains.scene: the hero with no weaknesses
mains.method: Rump steak marinated in garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals, sliced, with charred corn and a mango salsa.

mains.name: Jungle chicken curry
mains.scene: a dinner in the jungle level
mains.method: Red curry paste fried in thick coconut cream until fragrant, chicken thighs, coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar, simmered 20 minutes. Jasmine rice.

dessert.name: Mouse Finch's cake
dessert.scene: his one weakness is cake
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered and covered in glossy ganache. Eat with care.

drink.name: Jungle juice
drink.method: Pineapple juice, mango nectar and fresh passionfruit pulp with a squeeze of lime, topped with soda water over crushed ice.

films.title: Jumanji
films.tagline: Roll the dice. Bring snacks.
films.description: Two kids find a board game that unleashes the jungle on their town, and the man trapped inside it for decades.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the monkeys wreck the kitchen.

snacks.name: Kitchen raid banana fritters
snacks.scene: the monkeys tearing through the kitchen
snacks.method: Ripe bananas in thick slices dipped in a batter of flour, sparkling water and a pinch of sugar, fried at 180C until puffed and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar.

snacks.name: Stampede nachos
snacks.scene: everything comes charging through the house
snacks.method: Corn chips piled with spiced beans, melted cheese, salsa, sour cream and jalapeños. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, spoon over 400g refried beans warmed with 1 tsp cumin and cover with 200g grated cheese.

snacks.name: Giant pod dumplings
snacks.scene: the plants that take over the house
snacks.method: Pork and chive dumplings folded in wrappers, steamed 8 minutes in a bamboo basket lined with cabbage leaves, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip.

mains.name: New England pot roast
mains.scene: the old Parrish house in a small New England town
mains.method: Beef chuck seared, onion, carrot, celery and garlic, red wine and stock, braised at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes in for the last hour.

mains.name: Van Pelt's hunting lodge venison
mains.scene: the hunter who comes out of the game
mains.method: Venison backstrap rubbed with juniper, pepper and thyme, seared to rare, rested, with a red wine and redcurrant sauce and root vegetable mash.

dessert.name: New Hampshire maple fudge
dessert.scene: Brantford, New Hampshire in the fall
dessert.method: Soft creamy fudge made with real maple syrup, cut into little squares. Boil 250ml maple syrup, 200g brown sugar, 150ml cream and 40g butter to 115C, stirring gently.

drink.name: Hot apple cider
drink.scene: a New Hampshire autumn in Brantford
drink.method: Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, served warm in mugs.

films.title: Paddington
films.tagline: Please look after this bear. And feed him marmalade.
films.description: A polite young bear from Darkest Peru arrives in London looking for a home.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sandwiches when Paddington takes one out from under his hat.

snacks.name: Emergency marmalade sandwiches
snacks.scene: the one he keeps under his hat
snacks.method: Thick white bread buttered right to the edges, spread with a coarse-cut orange marmalade, crusts left on, cut into squares and wrapped in baking paper.

snacks.name: Mr Gruber's elevenses
snacks.scene: cake and cocoa at the antique shop
snacks.method: Small slices of Dundee cake: butter cake with currants, sultanas, orange zest and ground almonds, topped with almonds in circles, baked at 150C for 2 hours.

snacks.name: Darkest Peru empanadas
snacks.scene: Aunt Lucy's home in Peru
snacks.method: Beef mince cooked with onion, cumin, paprika, raisins and olives, wrapped in pastry rounds, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.

mains.name: The Browns' family dinner
mains.scene: the Browns take him in
mains.method: Shepherd's pie: lamb mince browned, onion, carrot, tomato paste and Worcestershire simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden. Buttered peas.

mains.name: Peruvian chicken
mains.scene: the jungle in Peru where he grew up
mains.method: Chicken marinated overnight in garlic, cumin, paprika, lime and a little soy, roasted at 200C, with green sauce of coriander, jalapeño and mayo, and roast potatoes.

dessert.name: Marmalade bread and butter pudding
dessert.scene: everything is better with marmalade
dessert.method: Buttered bread spread with marmalade, layered in a dish, covered in a custard of eggs, milk and cream, rested 20 minutes, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.

drink.name: Cocoa at Mr Gruber's
drink.method: Cocoa and sugar whisked into hot milk with a pinch of salt, served in china cups.

films.title: Paddington 2
films.tagline: If we're kind and polite, the world will be right. And there will be sandwiches.
films.description: Paddington is wrongly sent to prison and wins over the inmates with his marmalade.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sandwiches when Paddington teaches Knuckles to make marmalade.

snacks.name: Knuckles's marmalade sandwiches
snacks.scene: the prison cook learns marmalade
snacks.method: Bread buttered thick, spread with homemade marmalade (Seville oranges simmered whole an hour, shredded, boiled with sugar to 105C), cut into triangles.

snacks.name: Pop-up book biscuits
snacks.scene: the pop-up book of London he wants for Aunt Lucy
snacks.method: Butter biscuits cut into London landmarks, baked at 170C for 10 minutes, iced with white and red royal icing.

snacks.name: Barbershop scone fingers
snacks.scene: Paddington's disastrous day at the barber shop
snacks.method: Self-raising flour with cold butter rubbed in, milk mixed in lightly, patted out, cut into fingers, glazed with milk, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Jam and clotted cream.

mains.name: Prison canteen pie
mains.scene: the grim canteen he turns into something lovely
mains.method: Chicken thighs, leeks and mushrooms cooked in butter, a white wine and cream sauce thickened with flour, cooled, under a puff pastry lid, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.

mains.name: Funfair sausage sandwiches
mains.scene: the funfair Phoenix Buchanan opens
mains.method: Thick pork sausages grilled slowly until browned all over, onions cooked down in butter with a pinch of brown sugar, both stuffed into soft white rolls with English mustard.

dessert.name: Pink tea party Victoria sponge
dessert.scene: the prison uniforms that come out of the wash pink
dessert.method: Butter, sugar, eggs and flour weighed equal, beaten light, baked in two tins at 180C for 22 minutes, filled with raspberry jam and whipped cream, topped with pale pink icing.

drink.name: Prison tea service
drink.scene: tea for the whole cell block
drink.method: English breakfast tea brewed strong in a big brown pot for 4 minutes, poured with milk and two sugars, the way Knuckles likes it.

films.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory

films.serve_cue: Serve the three-course dinner when Violet grabs the experimental gum.

snacks.name: Bucket family cabbage soup
snacks.scene: the thin soup the Buckets eat every night
snacks.method: A proper version: savoy cabbage, onion, carrot and potato simmered in good chicken stock with bacon and thyme for 30 minutes, finished with butter and black pepper.

snacks.name: Golden ticket bars
snacks.scene: the bar with the golden ticket inside
snacks.method: Dark chocolate tempered and poured into bar moulds, one bar in the batch with a gold foil ticket hidden under the wrapper.

snacks.name: Nut room squirrels' snack
snacks.scene: the squirrels sorting nuts for Veruca's tantrum
snacks.method: Walnuts, pecans and almonds tossed in egg white, brown sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes, stirred twice.

mains.name: Three-course dinner, course one and two
mains.scene: the gum that tastes of tomato soup and roast beef
mains.method: Roast tomato soup with basil to start, then beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C with a baked potato split and loaded with butter and sour cream.

mains.name: Augustus Gloop's sausages
mains.scene: the German boy who falls in the chocolate river
mains.method: Bratwurst grilled slowly until browned, with sauerkraut braised in white wine and caraway, mustard and soft pretzels.

dessert.name: Blueberry pie and ice cream
dessert.scene: the third course of the gum, the one that turns Violet blue
dessert.method: Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours, with vanilla ice cream.

drink.name: Chocolate river hot chocolate
drink.scene: the chocolate river, mixed by waterfall
drink.method: Dark and milk chocolate melted into hot milk and cream, whisked hard until frothy, the way the waterfall churns it.

films.title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
films.tagline: Pure imagination. Pure sugar.
films.description: A poor boy finds a golden ticket and tours a mysterious chocolate factory.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Charlie and Grandpa Joe sneak a taste of the fizzy lifting drinks.

snacks.name: Edible teacups
snacks.scene: the candy cup Wonka bites into
snacks.method: White chocolate set inside small paper cups, peeled, filled with a vanilla mousse, a chocolate handle stuck on the side. Eat the whole thing.

snacks.name: Golden goose eggs
snacks.scene: Veruca wants a goose that lays golden eggs, now
snacks.method: Tempered dark chocolate brushed into small egg moulds in two coats, set, filled with salted caramel ganache, joined, then brushed with edible gold lustre until they shine.

snacks.name: Snozzberry crackers
snacks.scene: the snozzberries on the wallpaper
snacks.method: Seeded crackers spread with whipped ricotta and topped with a mix of raspberries, blackberries and blueberries crushed with a little sugar.

mains.name: Bucket house stew
mains.scene: the little house with four grandparents in one bed
mains.method: Beef shin browned, onion, carrot and potato softened, pearl barley and stock added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Bread to stretch it further.

mains.name: Chocolate room grazing garden
mains.scene: the room where everything, even the grass, is edible
mains.method: A big board planted like a garden: toasted marshmallow mushrooms on pretzel stalks, chocolate-dipped strawberries, toffee apple wedges, honeycomb rocks and a cloud of fairy floss in the middle.

dessert.name: Gobstopper truffles
dessert.scene: the sweet that never gets smaller
dessert.method: Layered truffles: a cherry centre wrapped in white chocolate ganache, chilled, then dark ganache, chilled, then rolled in cocoa and coloured sugar so every bite shows a new layer.

drink.name: Fizzy lifting drink
drink.scene: the drink that floats Charlie up to the fan
drink.method: Raspberry purée and lemon syrup in a tall glass, topped with very cold soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up to the rim.

films.id: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
films.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
films.tagline: Today's forecast: cheeseburgers.
films.description: A young inventor's machine makes food rain from the sky over his small island town.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the first cheeseburgers start falling.

snacks.name: Sardine toast
snacks.scene: the island town that ran on sardines
snacks.method: Tinned sardines mashed with butter, lemon and parsley, spread on sourdough toast, finished with sliced radish and black pepper.

snacks.name: Cheeseburger rain sliders
snacks.scene: it's raining cheeseburgers
snacks.method: Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, stacked high on a platter.

snacks.name: Jelly palace cubes
snacks.scene: the giant wobbly jelly palace
snacks.method: Fruit jellies made from orange, raspberry and lime juice set with gelatine in a slab, cut into cubes and stacked into a castle.

mains.name: Giant meatballs and spaghetti
mains.scene: the spaghetti tornado and the giant meatballs
mains.method: Big beef and pork meatballs with soaked bread, parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered 45 minutes in tomato sauce with basil, over a twisting pile of spaghetti.

mains.name: Steak storm
mains.scene: the day it rains steak
mains.method: Rump steaks seasoned and seared in a smoking pan, flipped every minute, rested, sliced, topped with garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries salted straight out of the oil.

dessert.name: Ice cream snow day
dessert.scene: the snow day made of ice cream
dessert.method: Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream scooped into a big snowy mountain, with sprinkles, wafer biscuits and hot fudge.

drink.name: Rainbow lemonade
drink.method: Layers of raspberry, orange and lime syrups in a glass, topped with lemonade so the colours run together.

films.title: Chef
films.tagline: Cook what you love. Load up the truck.
films.description: A top chef quits his restaurant after a viral meltdown and starts again with a food truck.
films.serve_cue: Serve the toasties when Carl makes his son a grilled cheese.

snacks.name: The grilled cheese for Percy
snacks.scene: the scene where Carl makes his son a toastie
snacks.method: Thick white bread buttered on the outside, filled with sharp cheddar, gruyère and a little parmesan, cooked slowly in a pan over low heat, lid on, until the cheese pours, cut on the diagonal.

snacks.name: Yuca fries
snacks.scene: the Miami food truck sides
snacks.method: Yuca peeled, boiled 20 minutes until tender, cut into batons, fried at 185C until crisp, salted, with a garlic and lime mojo.

snacks.name: New Orleans beignets
snacks.scene: the road trip stop in New Orleans
snacks.method: Yeasted dough of flour, evaporated milk, egg and butter rested overnight in the fridge, rolled thin, cut into squares, fried at 180C until puffed, buried in icing sugar.

mains.name: El Jefe Cubano
mains.scene: the truck's signature sandwich
mains.method: Pork shoulder marinated in mojo of orange, lime, garlic and oregano, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, sliced, layered in a soft roll with ham, Swiss, pickles and mustard, pressed and griddled in butter.

mains.name: Aglio e olio
mains.scene: the late-night pasta Carl cooks for Molly
mains.method: Spaghetti cooked al dente, tossed with olive oil, thinly sliced garlic cooked slowly until golden, chilli flakes, parsley, lemon and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

dessert.name: Chocolate lava cake
dessert.scene: the dessert the critic tears apart, done right
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked into eggs and sugar, a little flour folded in, baked in buttered ramekins at 220C for 9 minutes so the centre runs.

drink.name: Food truck mojito
drink.scene: a Miami summer on the truck
drink.method: Mint and lime muddled with sugar, 45ml white rum, crushed ice, topped with soda.

films.title: Julie & Julia
films.tagline: 524 recipes. 365 days. One very good stew.
films.description: A frustrated writer cooks her way through a classic French cookbook, interwoven with the story of the cook who wrote it.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Julie finally nails the boeuf bourguignon.

snacks.name: Julie's bruschetta
snacks.scene: the bruschetta Julie makes to unwind
snacks.method: Ciabatta toasted, rubbed with garlic, topped with ripe tomatoes diced and salted, basil and olive oil.

snacks.name: Sole meunière
snacks.scene: the first meal in France that changes everything
snacks.method: Sole fillets dusted in flour, cooked in foaming butter until golden, finished with lemon juice and parsley, the browned butter spooned over.

snacks.name: Gougères
snacks.scene: a French classic to warm up the kitchen
snacks.method: Choux pastry of water, butter and flour beaten with eggs one at a time, grated gruyère and a pinch of nutmeg folded in, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.

mains.name: Boeuf bourguignon
mains.scene: the dish that defines the project
mains.method: Beef chuck browned in batches, bacon lardons, onion, carrot, garlic, red Burgundy and stock, bouquet garni, braised at 160C for 3 hours, finished with butter-glazed pearl onions and mushrooms.

mains.name: Lobster thermidor
mains.scene: the live lobsters in Julie's kitchen
mains.method: Lobster tails poached 4 minutes, meat chopped and folded into a sauce of shallot, white wine, Dijon, cream and gruyère, piled back into the shells, topped with more cheese and grilled until golden.

dessert.name: Reine de Saba
dessert.scene: a classic French chocolate almond cake from the book
dessert.method: Dark chocolate melted with butter, yolks and sugar beaten in, almond meal and a little flour folded through, whites whipped and folded in, baked at 180C for 25 minutes so the middle stays soft, glazed with chocolate.

drink.name: Red Burgundy
drink.scene: the wine that goes in the bourguignon, and the glass
drink.method: A pinot noir from Burgundy, opened 30 minutes before dinner and served just below room temperature.

films.title: The Menu
films.tagline: Taste. Don't eat. Then order the cheeseburger.
films.description: A couple join a handful of rich guests at an exclusive island restaurant where the tasting menu turns sinister.
films.serve_cue: Serve the cheeseburgers when Margot asks the chef for one.

snacks.name: The breadless bread plate
snacks.scene: the bread course with no bread
snacks.method: A bowl of cultured butter, olive oil, whipped ricotta and a few flakes of salt. Then, because you're not on that island, a warm sourdough loaf to go with them.

snacks.name: The island scallop
snacks.scene: the first course, served on a rock
snacks.method: Scallops sliced thin and dressed with lime, finger lime, a few drops of good olive oil and sea salt, set on a cold stone or a chilled plate.

snacks.name: Etched tortillas
snacks.scene: the tortillas with the guests' secrets printed on them
snacks.method: Corn tortillas warmed on a hot dry pan, served with a salsa of charred tomato, chipotle and coriander and a smear of smashed avocado.

mains.name: The cheeseburger
mains.scene: the one thing on the menu worth eating
mains.method: Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, two patties, American cheese, white onion and pickles on a soft toasted bun, crinkle-cut fries. Pack one to go.

mains.name: Hawthorn lamb
mains.scene: a tasting menu main, without the theatre
mains.method: Lamb rack roasted at 200C to 56C, rested, carved, with a celeriac purée, charred leeks and a red wine jus.

dessert.name: Campfire s'mores tart
dessert.scene: the final course, with a bonfire
dessert.method: Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache set inside, topped with a toasted marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.

drink.name: Wine pairing
drink.method: A chilled white and a light red poured in small tasting glasses, swapped course by course.

films.title: Mystic Pizza
films.tagline: A slice of heaven.
films.description: Three young waitresses at a pizza parlour in a Connecticut fishing town fall in and out of love one summer.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pizza when the food critic takes his first bite.

snacks.name: Portuguese kale soup
snacks.scene: the Portuguese families of Mystic
snacks.method: Caldo verde: potato and onion simmered in stock until soft, mashed smooth, finely shredded kale and slices of smoked sausage added for 5 minutes, olive oil on top.

snacks.name: Lobster boat garlic prawns
snacks.scene: the lobster boats in the harbour
snacks.method: Prawns sautéed in butter, garlic and chilli, splashed with white wine and lemon, parsley, with bread to mop up.

snacks.name: Pizza parlour garlic knots
snacks.scene: the dough nobody can leave alone
snacks.method: Pizza dough rolled into ropes and tied in knots, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, tossed in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.

mains.name: Pizza with the secret sauce
mains.scene: the sauce nobody will tell you about
mains.method: Pizza dough stretched thin, a sauce of crushed tomatoes simmered with garlic, oregano, a little honey and a pinch of chilli, mozzarella, linguiça and peppers, baked on a hot steel.

mains.name: Wedding clambake
mains.scene: Jojo's wedding, after she faints
mains.method: Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and chorizo, tipped onto the table.

dessert.name: Portuguese custard tarts
dessert.scene: the Portuguese bakery in town
dessert.method: Puff pastry rolled into a log, sliced, pressed into a muffin tin, filled with a custard of yolks, cream, sugar and lemon, baked at 250C until blistered.

drink.name: Harbour lager
drink.scene: a Connecticut summer down by the docks
drink.method: Light lager straight from an esky of ice, a lemon wedge pushed into the neck of the bottle.

films.title: Waitress
films.tagline: Every pie has a feeling.
films.description: A diner waitress stuck in a bad marriage pours everything into the pies she invents.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pies when Jenna starts dreaming up a new one.

snacks.name: Bad day quiche bites
snacks.scene: a pie named for how Jenna feels that morning
snacks.method: Shortcrust blind baked in a mini muffin tin, filled with brie, smoked ham and a custard of eggs and cream, baked at 170C for 15 minutes until just set.

snacks.name: Diner biscuits and gravy
snacks.scene: the early shift at the pie diner
snacks.method: Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and covered in a peppery sausage gravy of browned sausage mince, flour and milk.

snacks.name: Old Joe's pie crust crisps
snacks.scene: the cranky old owner who loves her pies
snacks.method: Pastry trimmings rolled out, brushed with melted butter, sprinkled with cinnamon sugar, cut into strips and twisted, baked at 190C for 10 minutes until crisp and caramelised.

mains.name: Chicken pot pie
mains.scene: a pie for dinner, not just dessert
mains.method: Chicken thighs, carrot, celery, onion and peas in a thick creamy sauce with thyme, under a puff pastry lid, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.

mains.name: Diner meatloaf plate
mains.scene: the lunch rush at the diner
mains.method: Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, sliced thick with mash, gravy and green beans.

dessert.name: Bittersweet chocolate caramel pie
dessert.scene: the pie she makes when she's furious with her husband
dessert.method: Biscuit crust, a layer of salted caramel, then a bittersweet chocolate ganache set over it, drowned in more caramel and a little flaky salt.

drink.name: Diner coffee
drink.method: Drip coffee in thick mugs, refilled before you ask, a jug of cream on the side.

films.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
films.tagline: The secret's in the sauce.
films.description: An unhappy housewife befriends an elderly woman who tells her the story of two friends who ran a café in 1930s Alabama.
films.serve_cue: Serve the tomatoes when the story arrives at the Whistle Stop Café.

snacks.name: Fried green tomatoes
snacks.scene: the café's famous dish
snacks.method: Green tomatoes sliced thick, salted 10 minutes, dipped in buttermilk and seasoned cornmeal, fried in bacon fat until golden, with a remoulade.

snacks.name: Honeycomb and biscuits
snacks.scene: Idgie takes honey straight from the bee tree for Ruth
snacks.method: Buttermilk biscuits: flour and cold butter cut together, buttermilk folded in, patted, folded three times, cut and baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Warm, with butter and a chunk of honeycomb.

snacks.name: Whistle Stop pimento cheese
snacks.scene: a Southern café counter snack
snacks.method: Sharp cheddar grated and mixed with mayo, cream cheese, roasted red capsicum and a dash of hot sauce, spread on crackers.

mains.name: Whistle Stop barbecue
mains.scene: the café's barbecue and its famous sauce
mains.method: Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled, dressed in a tomato and vinegar sauce. Coleslaw and white bread.

mains.name: Sipsey's fried chicken
mains.scene: the café kitchen in Alabama
mains.method: Chicken brined in buttermilk overnight, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside, with collard greens and cornbread.

dessert.name: Pecan pie
dessert.scene: a Southern café dessert
dessert.method: Toasted pecans, brown sugar, golden syrup, butter and eggs in a blind-baked case, baked at 170C for 50 minutes.

drink.name: Sweet tea
drink.method: Black tea brewed strong, sweetened while hot, cooled and poured over ice with lemon and mint.

films.title: Soul Food
films.tagline: Sunday dinner. Every Sunday. No excuses.
films.description: A Chicago family is held together by their grandmother's weekly Sunday dinners.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the whole family sits down for Sunday dinner at Big Mama's.

snacks.name: Devilled eggs
snacks.scene: always on Big Mama's Sunday table
snacks.method: Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard, a spoon of sweet pickle relish and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, paprika on top.

snacks.name: Skillet cornbread
snacks.scene: the cornbread in the cast iron pan
snacks.method: Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, poured into a smoking hot buttered cast iron pan, baked at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.

snacks.name: Collard greens
snacks.scene: slow-cooked like Big Mama's
snacks.method: Collards or kale braised 90 minutes with a smoked ham hock, onion, garlic, chilli flakes and a splash of cider vinegar, served with the pot liquor.

mains.name: Sunday fried chicken
mains.scene: the heart of every Sunday dinner
mains.method: Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried in a cast iron pan at 165C until 74C at the bone.

mains.name: Baked macaroni and cheese
mains.scene: the dish everyone fights over
mains.method: Macaroni boiled 2 minutes short, mixed with sharp cheddar, a custard of eggs, evaporated milk and butter, more cheese on top, baked at 180C for 40 minutes until set and golden.

dessert.name: Peach cobbler
dessert.scene: the dessert at the end of every Sunday
dessert.method: Peaches sliced and cooked with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg, a buttery biscuit topping sprinkled with sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.

drink.name: Sweet tea
drink.scene: the big jug on the table
drink.method: Black tea brewed strong with a pinch of bicarb, sweetened while hot, cooled and poured over ice with lemon.

films.title: Chocolat
films.tagline: Lent is over. The chocolate shop is open.
films.description: A woman opens a chocolate shop in a strict French village during Lent and shakes everyone up.
films.serve_cue: Serve the hot chocolate when Vianne pours one for Armande.

snacks.name: Chilli hot chocolate shots
snacks.scene: Vianne's spiced hot chocolate, the old South American way
snacks.method: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a split chilli, cinnamon stick and a pinch of salt, steeped 5 minutes, strained, served in tiny cups.

snacks.name: Chocolaterie truffles
snacks.scene: the window of the chocolate shop
snacks.method: Dark chocolate ganache with cream and a little butter, chilled, scooped and rolled, coated in cocoa, chopped hazelnuts or chilli sugar.

snacks.name: Village market board
snacks.scene: the French village square on market day
snacks.method: Saucisson, a wedge of comté, a soft goat's cheese, cornichons and baguette on a wooden board.

mains.name: Armande's birthday feast
mains.scene: the birthday party Vianne cooks for Armande
mains.method: Duck legs salted overnight, cooked slowly in their fat at 140C for 2.5 hours, crisped skin side down, with potatoes roasted in duck fat and a green salad.

mains.name: River party fish
mains.scene: the boat people's party on the river
mains.method: Trout grilled whole with lemon, thyme and garlic, finished with brown butter and almonds, new potatoes alongside.

dessert.name: Chocolate mousse
dessert.scene: the shop's chocolate, all of it
dessert.method: Dark chocolate melted with butter, yolks whisked in, whites whipped with sugar folded through, chilled 4 hours in small cups, a little chilli salt on top.

drink.name: Red wine
drink.scene: a French village after Lent ends
drink.method: A light southern French red, opened half an hour early, poured into short tumblers the way the village would.

films.title: Big Fish
films.tagline: Some fish stories are true. This dinner is.
films.description: A son tries to separate fact from fiction in his dying father's tall tales.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Edward tells the story of the giant catfish.

snacks.name: Spectre picnic
snacks.scene: the perfect little town with shoes hanging over the road
snacks.method: Egg salad sandwiches of eggs boiled 10 minutes and mashed with mayo, chives and white pepper on soft white bread, with crisp apple slices tossed in lemon, laid out on a picnic blanket.

snacks.name: Circus popcorn
snacks.scene: the circus where Edward works for clues about Sandra
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of salt and bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirred every 15.

snacks.name: Alabama boiled peanuts
snacks.scene: the small town in Alabama
snacks.method: Raw peanuts boiled 2 hours in salted water with Cajun spice, soaked an hour, served warm in paper cones.

mains.name: The big fish
mains.scene: the catfish nobody can catch
mains.method: Whole snapper or barramundi scored, rubbed with Cajun spice and butter, roasted at 200C for 25 minutes, with lemon, hush puppies and coleslaw.

mains.name: Karl the giant's feast
mains.scene: the giant who eats a whole flock
mains.method: A whole leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested and carved, with roast potatoes and mint sauce.

dessert.name: Daffodil lemon cake
dessert.scene: the field of daffodils for Sandra
dessert.method: Lemon drizzle cake baked at 170C for 45 minutes, soaked with a hot lemon syrup, iced with yellow lemon icing.

drink.name: Calloway Circus cherry soda
drink.scene: Edward works three years for the circus
drink.method: Cherry syrup and soda water over ice with a squeeze of lime and a cherry on top.

films.title: John Wick
films.tagline: They killed his dog. Feed yours first.
films.description: A retired hitman comes back to settle the score with the Russian mob.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when John sits at the bar in the Continental.

snacks.name: Continental gold coins
snacks.scene: the coins that pay for everything in his world
snacks.method: Parmesan crisps: grated parmesan in small rounds on baking paper, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden, a crack of black pepper on each.

snacks.name: Continental hotel bar olives
snacks.scene: drinks at the bar where no business gets done
snacks.method: Green olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, rosemary and garlic, served with salted almonds.

snacks.name: Viggo's vodka bar zakuski
snacks.scene: the Russian boss getting very bad news about his son
snacks.method: Warm blini topped with sour cream and salmon roe, buttered rye with pickled herring and onion, and fridge-cold dill pickles, all laid out beside the frozen vodka.

mains.name: Dinner reservation for twelve
mains.scene: what he calls the cleaners
mains.method: Beef short ribs browned, braised at 150C for 4 hours in red wine, stock, garlic and thyme, glossy sauce reduced, over creamy polenta.

mains.name: John's kitchen steak
mains.scene: the quiet house before the trouble
mains.method: Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared in cast iron, butter, garlic and rosemary basted, pulled at 54C and rested, with a sharp green salad.

dessert.name: Daisy's puppy biscuits
dessert.scene: the puppy Helen leaves him
dessert.method: Peanut butter shortbread cut into little bone shapes, baked at 170C for 12 minutes, half dipped in dark chocolate. Human food only.

drink.name: Bourbon at the Continental
drink.scene: Addy behind the bar, the usual
drink.method: 60ml bourbon neat in a heavy glass, a single large ice cube if you must.

films.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
films.tagline: A marker is a promise. Dinner is a promise too.
films.description: John is forced to honour a blood oath and travels to Rome for a job he doesn't want.
films.serve_cue: Serve the wine when John visits the sommelier at the Rome Continental.

snacks.name: Sommelier's tasting plate
snacks.scene: the Rome sommelier and his very special tasting
snacks.method: Three small pours of Italian wine with matching bites: pecorino with honey, prosciutto with melon, and an olive and anchovy crostino.

snacks.name: Rome supplì
snacks.scene: Roman street food before the job
snacks.method: Leftover risotto with tomato rolled around a cube of mozzarella, crumbed, fried at 180C until golden, so the cheese pulls like a phone cord.

snacks.name: Bowery King's pigeon pie bites
snacks.scene: the homeless network with its carrier pigeons
snacks.method: Chicken and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce, spooned into puff pastry cases, baked at 200C for 15 minutes.

mains.name: Cacio e pepe
mains.scene: a simple bowl of pasta in Rome
mains.method: Black pepper toasted in a dry pan, spaghetti cooked in a small amount of salted water, tossed off the heat with finely grated pecorino, the pepper and ladles of starchy pasta water until it turns creamy, never stringy.

mains.name: Santino's party lamb
mains.scene: the D'Antonio family party in Rome
mains.method: Lamb leg butterflied, marinated in rosemary, garlic, anchovy and lemon, grilled to 56C, rested, sliced, with roast potatoes.

dessert.name: Tiramisu
dessert.scene: a Roman dessert before the job goes wrong
dessert.method: Savoiardi dipped quickly in espresso and coffee liqueur, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa sifted on top.

drink.name: Negroni
drink.method: 30ml each of gin, red bitter aperitivo and sweet vermouth, stirred over ice for 20 seconds, strained over a big cube, orange peel twisted over.

films.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 Parabellum
films.tagline: Excommunicado. Still hungry.
films.description: With a price on his head, John fights his way from New York to Casablanca and back.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sushi when John walks into Zero's sushi counter.

snacks.name: Zero's sushi counter
snacks.scene: the assassin who runs a sushi bar in Chinatown
snacks.method: Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri topped with sliced salmon and tuna, a touch of wasabi under each, pickled ginger and soy on the side.

snacks.name: Casablanca spiced olives
snacks.scene: Sofia's Continental in Casablanca
snacks.method: Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with preserved lemon, cumin, harissa and garlic for 10 minutes, cooled slightly, served with bread.

snacks.name: Library stack crackers
snacks.scene: the fight in the New York Public Library
snacks.method: Lavash cut into book-sized rectangles, brushed with oil and za'atar, baked crisp, stacked with labneh and cucumber between the layers.

mains.name: Moroccan lamb tagine
mains.scene: the desert crossing to find the Elder
mains.method: Lamb shoulder browned, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, cinnamon and saffron, stock, dates and preserved lemon, cooked covered at 160C for 3 hours. Couscous with almonds.

mains.name: Chinatown salt and pepper squid
mains.scene: the streets around Zero's sushi counter
mains.method: Squid scored and cut, dusted in rice flour, salt and ground Sichuan pepper, fried at 190C for 60 seconds, tossed in a hot wok with chilli, garlic and spring onion. Steamed rice.

dessert.name: Orange blossom semolina cake
dessert.scene: sweets at the Casablanca Continental
dessert.method: Semolina, almond meal, yoghurt and sugar baked at 180C for 35 minutes, soaked hot with orange blossom syrup, almonds on top.

drink.name: Moroccan mint tea
drink.method: Gunpowder green tea and a big handful of mint steeped 5 minutes with sugar, poured from a height into little glasses.

films.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
films.tagline: Osaka. Berlin. Paris. Dinner.
films.description: John takes on the High Table across the world for one last shot at freedom.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the fight reaches the steps of Paris at sunrise.

snacks.name: Osaka takoyaki
snacks.scene: the Osaka Continental
snacks.method: Takoyaki batter of flour, dashi and egg poured into a hot takoyaki pan over diced octopus, spring onion and pickled ginger, turned into balls, topped with mayo, sauce and bonito flakes.

snacks.name: Berlin currywurst
snacks.scene: the card game at the Berlin nightclub
snacks.method: Bratwurst grilled and sliced, covered in a sauce of tomato, curry powder, onion and a little sugar and vinegar, dusted with more curry powder. Fries.

snacks.name: Paris café gougères
snacks.scene: the long night in Paris
snacks.method: Choux pastry with gruyère piped in rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.

mains.name: Paris steak frites
mains.scene: sunrise at the top of the steps
mains.method: Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seared hard in cast iron, pulled at 54C and rested, with a peppercorn sauce of crushed pepper, cognac and cream reduced in the same pan, and thin fries cooked twice.

mains.name: Osaka okonomiyaki
mains.scene: a late night in the Osaka hotel kitchen
mains.method: Shredded cabbage and spring onion folded into a batter of flour, dashi and egg, cooked as thick pancakes topped with thin pork belly slices, flipped, finished with mayo, okonomiyaki sauce and bonito flakes.

dessert.name: Paris croissant pudding
dessert.scene: breakfast in Paris
dessert.method: Stale croissants torn into a dish, soaked in an egg and cream custard with dark chocolate, baked at 170C for 35 minutes.

drink.name: Sake or cognac
drink.scene: one for Osaka, one for Paris
drink.method: Junmai sake served cold in small cups for Osaka, or 30ml cognac warmed in the hand in a snifter for Paris.

films.title: Taken
films.tagline: A very particular set of skills. One of them is cooking.
films.description: A retired agent tracks down the men who kidnapped his daughter in Paris.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Bryan sits down to dinner with Jean-Claude's family.

snacks.name: Paris café croque monsieur
snacks.scene: the Paris trip that goes wrong
snacks.method: Ham and gruyère between slices of white bread spread with béchamel and Dijon, more béchamel and cheese on top, baked at 200C until bubbling, cut into fingers.

snacks.name: Kim's birthday party cupcakes
snacks.scene: her birthday party at the mansion
snacks.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with pale pink buttercream and topped with a single candle each.

snacks.name: Albanian byrek
snacks.scene: the Albanian gang he hunts down
snacks.method: Filo layered with butter and a filling of feta, ricotta, spinach and egg, rolled into a coil, baked at 190C for 35 minutes until crisp, cut into wedges.

mains.name: Jean-Claude's dinner table
mains.scene: the tense family dinner with his old colleague
mains.method: Chicken roasted with tarragon butter at 220C then 180C, rested, with a white wine pan sauce, gratin dauphinois and green beans.

mains.name: Paris steak frites
mains.scene: a night in Paris, skills required
mains.method: Entrecôte seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with shallot and red wine butter and thin double-cooked fries.

dessert.name: Crème caramel
dessert.scene: a Paris bistro dessert
dessert.method: Caramel poured into ramekins, filled with a custard of eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla, baked in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes, chilled overnight and turned out.

drink.name: French red
drink.scene: a glass in Paris before the hunt
drink.method: A Bordeaux red opened an hour before dinner, poured into big glasses.

films.title: Heat
films.tagline: Coffee with the enemy.
films.description: A detective and a master thief circle each other across Los Angeles.
films.serve_cue: Serve the coffee and pie when Hanna and McCauley sit down at the diner.

snacks.name: Diner coffee and pie
snacks.scene: the two of them face to face over coffee
snacks.method: Apple pie of Granny Smiths, sugar and cinnamon in a double crust, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, served in wedges with strong drip coffee.

snacks.name: LA taco truck tacos
snacks.scene: late nights across LA
snacks.method: Pork shoulder marinated in chilli, orange and pineapple, roasted, sliced, crisped in a pan, in corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and coriander.

snacks.name: Ocean view oysters
snacks.scene: Neil's empty house by the ocean
snacks.method: Freshly shucked oysters on ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.

mains.name: Hanna's late dinner
mains.scene: dinner he never gets home for
mains.method: Spaghetti with a ragù of beef and pork mince, tomato and red wine simmered 3 hours, parmesan grated over.

mains.name: Steakhouse rib eye
mains.scene: a crew dinner with their partners
mains.method: Rib eye seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato, sour cream and chives, and creamed spinach.

dessert.name: Downtown cheesecake
dessert.scene: the downtown heist
dessert.method: New York cheesecake: cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream on a biscuit base, baked in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cooled in the oven.

drink.name: Black coffee
drink.scene: the diner meeting between cop and robber
drink.method: Strong drip coffee poured black into heavy diner mugs, refilled without asking.

films.title: Collateral
films.tagline: One night. Five stops. Plenty of snacks.
films.description: A cab driver is forced to drive a hitman around Los Angeles for one very long night.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when they pull up at the jazz club.

snacks.name: Cab driver's front seat mix
snacks.scene: Max's long night shifts behind the wheel
snacks.method: Pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews tossed in melted butter, smoked paprika and a little brown sugar, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, cooled and tipped into paper bags with strips of beef jerky.

snacks.name: Koreatown nightclub fried chicken
snacks.scene: the packed Korean nightclub near the end
snacks.method: Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C until shattering, tossed in a glaze of gochujang, soy, honey and garlic, sesame on top.

snacks.name: Jazz club small plates
snacks.scene: the jazz club where the owner tells his old story
snacks.method: Devilled eggs with smoked paprika, parmesan cheese straws twisted and baked at 200C for 12 minutes, and warm marinated olives with orange peel and fennel.

mains.name: Late night carne asada tacos
mains.scene: a stop for food between jobs
mains.method: Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin for 2 hours, seared over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and salsa roja.

mains.name: Hospital visit chicken soup
mains.scene: Max visits his mum in hospital in the middle of it all
mains.method: Chicken thighs simmered an hour with onion, carrot and celery, shredded back into the strained broth with egg noodles, dill and a squeeze of lemon.

dessert.name: Island dream coconut tart
dessert.scene: the island postcard Max keeps on his sun visor
dessert.method: Blind-baked sweet pastry filled with desiccated coconut, eggs, sugar, butter and coconut milk whisked together, baked at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.

drink.name: Coffee to go
drink.method: Strong drip coffee poured into paper cups with milk and sugar, lids on, ready for the cab's cup holder.

films.title: Reservoir Dogs
films.tagline: Breakfast first. Then the job.
films.description: A jewellery heist goes wrong and the surviving crooks suspect one of them is a cop.
films.serve_cue: Serve the breakfast when the crew argues about tipping at the diner.

snacks.name: Diner silver dollar pancakes
snacks.scene: the breakfast table talk before the heist
snacks.method: Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in small rounds in butter until bubbles set, stacked in threes with butter and maple syrup.

snacks.name: Bacon and egg breakfast sliders
snacks.scene: the crew in black suits at the diner
snacks.method: Soft scrambled eggs and crisp streaky bacon in toasted brioche slider buns with a slice of American cheese and hot sauce.

snacks.name: Warehouse hash browns
snacks.scene: waiting in the warehouse
snacks.method: Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into flat cakes, fried in butter and oil until crisp and deep golden on both sides.

mains.name: Joe Cabot's diner plate
mains.scene: Joe's big breakfast before he hands out the names
mains.method: Two eggs your way, thick-cut bacon, griddled sausages, buttered toast and a grilled tomato on a big oval plate.

mains.name: Nice Guy Eddie's steak sandwich
mains.scene: Eddie on the car phone
mains.method: Rump steak seared and sliced, piled into a toasted roll with onions cooked slowly in butter, provolone and a horseradish mayo.

dessert.name: Diner lemon meringue pie
dessert.scene: Uncle Bob's after the tip argument
dessert.method: Short pastry case with tangy lemon filling under a tall, toasted meringue, cut in big diner wedges.

drink.name: Bottomless diner coffee
drink.scene: the waitress keeps topping it up
drink.method: Strong drip coffee in thick mugs, refilled until someone says stop, milk and sugar on the table.

films.title: True Romance
films.tagline: You're so cool. So is this pie.
films.description: A comic shop clerk marries a call girl and the two go on the run to Hollywood with a suitcase they shouldn't have.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pie when Clarence and Alabama head to the diner after the kung fu triple feature.

snacks.name: Triple feature popcorn
snacks.scene: the kung fu triple bill where Alabama spills her popcorn on Clarence
snacks.method: Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed in melted butter and fine salt, a second batch tossed in butter, soy and a little sugar for the kung fu films. Served in big paper buckets.

snacks.name: Detroit Coney sliders
snacks.scene: Clarence's Detroit, before the road trip
snacks.method: Fine beef mince simmered with onion, chilli, cumin and paprika into a loose sauce, spooned over griddled cocktail franks in mini rolls, mustard and diced raw onion.

snacks.name: Comic shop cheese puffs
snacks.scene: the comic book shop where Clarence works
snacks.method: Choux pastry with sharp cheddar and cayenne, piped into small rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.

mains.name: Purple Cadillac road trip burgers
mains.scene: the purple convertible from Detroit to LA
mains.method: Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce in soft buns, wrapped in paper and eaten with the top down. Crinkle-cut fries.

mains.name: Hollywood hotel room service
mains.scene: the fancy LA hotel suite with the producer
mains.method: Club sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo on three slices of toast, cut into triangles, with a silver bowl of shoestring fries.

dessert.name: Diner cherry pie
dessert.scene: pie after the movie, the night they meet
dessert.method: Sour cherries tossed with sugar, lemon, a splash of almond extract and cornflour, in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled before slicing. Vanilla ice cream.

drink.name: Cancún beach margarita
drink.scene: the beach at the very end
drink.method: 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime shaken hard with ice, strained into a salt-rimmed glass.

films.title: Jackie Brown
films.tagline: Cash, a mall, and a very good plan.
films.description: A flight attendant caught smuggling money plays the cops and a gun runner against each other.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the money swap happens at the shopping mall.

snacks.name: Food court chicken skewers
snacks.scene: the switch at the Del Amo mall
snacks.method: Chicken thighs in a sweet soy and ginger glaze, threaded on skewers, grilled and brushed until sticky, with steamed rice.

snacks.name: Hermosa Beach fish tacos
snacks.scene: Ordell's beach apartment
snacks.method: White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, chipotle crema and lime.

snacks.name: Cabo flight peanuts
snacks.scene: Jackie's flights back from Mexico
snacks.method: Peanuts tossed in lime zest, chilli powder and salt, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, served in little foil packets like on the plane.

mains.name: Max Cherry's steak dinner
mains.scene: the bail bondsman who falls for Jackie
mains.method: Sirloin seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream and chives and a wedge salad with blue cheese.

mains.name: Soul food fried chicken
mains.scene: Ordell's South Bay
mains.method: Chicken brined in buttermilk and hot sauce overnight, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C, with collard greens and mac and cheese.

dessert.name: Max Cherry's banana bread
dessert.scene: the bail bondsman's quiet office
dessert.method: Moist banana bread with walnuts, toasted and buttered in thick slices. Mash 3 ripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs and vanilla.

drink.name: Screwdriver
drink.method: 45ml vodka topped with fresh orange juice over ice.

films.title: Snatch
films.tagline: London. Diamonds. Dogs. Dinner.
films.description: A stolen diamond, a crooked boxing promoter and a dog all collide in London's underworld.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the dog swallows the squeaky toy.

snacks.name: East End pie and mash
snacks.scene: the London backstreets
snacks.method: Small minced beef pies in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mash and a parsley liquor of stock, butter, flour and lots of parsley.

snacks.name: Diamond cut cheese
snacks.scene: the 86-carat stone everyone wants
snacks.method: Aged cheddar, red Leicester and a crumbly Wensleydale cut into sharp little diamond shapes, with crackers and pickled onions.

snacks.name: Caravan site sausages
snacks.scene: the caravans where the bare-knuckle fighters live
snacks.method: Thin pork sausages grilled until sticky, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard, served on toothpicks.

mains.name: Turkish's fry-up
mains.scene: the promoter's office and its kettle
mains.method: Bacon, sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, black pudding, mushrooms and grilled tomato with buttered toast.

mains.name: Avi's New York steak
mains.scene: the New York diamond dealer who hates London
mains.method: Sirloin seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato and creamed spinach, the way Avi would order back home.

dessert.name: Bullet Tooth Tony's banoffee pie
dessert.scene: a London caff classic
dessert.method: Biscuit base, thick caramel and sliced bananas under a mountain of cream and grated chocolate.

drink.name: Pint of bitter
drink.scene: the London pub where the deals happen
drink.method: English ale poured at cellar temperature into a pint glass, a bowl of salted peanuts on the bar.

films.id: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)
films.title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
films.tagline: It's been emotional. Pass the brown sauce.
films.description: Four friends lose a rigged card game and scramble to raise half a million pounds in a week.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the lads plan the robbery over breakfast.

snacks.name: Smoked mackerel pâté
snacks.scene: an East End seafood stall, without the jellied eels
snacks.method: Smoked mackerel flaked and blitzed with cream cheese, horseradish, lemon and black pepper, spread on toasted rye with sliced cucumber.

snacks.name: Card game peanuts
snacks.scene: the rigged card game with Hatchet Harry
snacks.method: Peanuts tossed in egg white, smoked paprika and salt, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, served in bowls at the table.

snacks.name: Hatchet Harry's pork scratchings
snacks.scene: East End pub snacks
snacks.method: Crackling pork rind strips, salted and roasted until they puff and crunch. Score 500g pork rind into strips, rub well with salt and dry in the fridge overnight.

mains.name: Full English
mains.scene: the lads' greasy spoon
mains.method: Bacon, sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, mushrooms, grilled tomato and fried bread, brown sauce on the table.

mains.name: Big Chris's pie and chips
mains.scene: the debt collector who brings his son along
mains.method: Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion and thyme for 2.5 hours, thickened, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Thick chips and mushy peas with mint.

dessert.name: Spotted dick and custard
dessert.scene: an East End pudding
dessert.method: Self-raising flour, butter, sugar and currants mixed with milk, wrapped in a pudding basin under baking paper and foil, steamed 90 minutes, turned out with hot custard.

drink.name: Pints
drink.scene: the local pub where the plan gets made
drink.method: Lager or English ale poured into chilled pint glasses, a packet of salted crisps on the side.

films.title: Ocean's Eleven
films.tagline: Eleven guys. Three casinos. One very long buffet.
films.description: Danny Ocean gathers a crew to rob three Las Vegas casinos in one night.
films.serve_cue: Serve the prawn cocktail whenever Rusty is eating, which is most scenes.

snacks.name: Rusty's prawn cocktail
snacks.scene: Rusty eats in nearly every scene
snacks.method: Prawns poached in salted water for 2 minutes, iced, served in martini glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and Worcestershire.

snacks.name: High roller chips
snacks.scene: the chips on the high-stakes table
snacks.method: Potatoes sliced paper thin on a mandoline, rinsed, dried, fried at 170C until golden, tossed straight away with truffle salt and finely grated parmesan.

mains.name: Casino steakhouse
mains.scene: dinner in Terry Benedict's casino
mains.method: Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared in a smoking pan, pulled at 54C and rested, with a béarnaise of tarragon, shallot and vinegar whisked into yolks and butter, and creamed spinach.

mains.name: Saul's chicken soup
mains.scene: Saul, the old con man coaxed out of retirement
mains.method: Chicken thighs simmered with onion, carrot and celery for an hour, the broth strained, matzo balls of matzo meal, egg and schmaltz simmered 30 minutes in it, dill on top.

dessert.name: Fountain show sundae
dessert.scene: the crew watching the fountains at the end
dessert.method: Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, hot fudge made from dark chocolate and cream, whipped cream piped high and a few gold sprinkles to catch the light.

drink.name: Casino martini
drink.method: 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth stirred with ice for 30 seconds, strained into a chilled glass, a green olive on a pick.

films.title: Ocean's Twelve
films.tagline: Amsterdam. Rome. Lake Como. Lunch.
films.description: Danny's crew head to Europe to pay back the casino owner they robbed, and run into a rival thief.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the crew lands in Amsterdam.

snacks.name: Amsterdam bitterballen
snacks.scene: the crew's first stop in Amsterdam
snacks.method: Beef braised with onion and thyme until it falls apart, shredded into a thick roux-based ragout, chilled overnight, rolled into balls, crumbed and fried at 180C. Grainy mustard.

snacks.name: Stroopwafel stack
snacks.scene: Dutch canal-side café
snacks.method: Store-bought caramel waffle biscuits warmed over a cup of hot coffee until soft, stacked, with a dish of extra caramel sauce.

snacks.name: Lake Como antipasto
snacks.scene: the Night Fox's villa on Lake Como
snacks.method: Bresaola, burrata, figs, grissini and olives on a board, finished with a drizzle of good olive oil and lemon.

mains.name: Risotto alla milanese
mains.scene: northern Italy, by the lake
mains.method: Carnaroli toasted in butter with onion, white wine, hot stock added ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, saffron steeped in, finished with butter and parmesan.

mains.name: Roman saltimbocca
mains.scene: the Rome leg of the job
mains.method: Veal or pork escalopes pounded thin, topped with prosciutto and sage, seared in butter, finished with white wine and a knob of butter.

dessert.name: Lake Como tiramisu
dessert.scene: the villa at Lake Como
dessert.method: Coffee-soaked sponge fingers layered with mascarpone cream and finished with cocoa. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream.

drink.name: Orange spritz
drink.method: 60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda over ice with an orange slice.

films.title: The Italian Job
films.tagline: You were only supposed to blow the doors off. Not the oven.
films.description: A crew of British crooks plan to steal a fortune in gold from the streets of Turin.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the three little cars start the getaway through Turin.

snacks.name: Turin bagna cauda
snacks.scene: the city of the job
snacks.method: Anchovies, lots of garlic and butter melted slowly into olive oil, kept warm over a flame, with raw fennel, capsicum, radish and bread for dipping.

snacks.name: Gold bar cheese toasts
snacks.scene: the gold bullion they're after
snacks.method: Bread cut into neat bars, topped with grated aged cheddar and parmesan mixed with mustard and egg, grilled until golden.

snacks.name: Mr Bridger's prison tea sandwiches
snacks.scene: the crime boss running everything from prison
snacks.method: Cucumber and cream cheese, and egg and cress, crusts off, cut into neat fingers like a proper English tea.

mains.name: Vitello tonnato
mains.scene: a Turin classic
mains.method: Veal or pork loin poached gently, chilled, sliced thin, covered in a sauce of tuna, anchovy, capers, mayo and lemon.

mains.name: Agnolotti del plin
mains.scene: handmade pasta from Piedmont
mains.method: Fresh egg pasta rolled thin, small spoons of a filling of braised beef and parmesan dotted along it, folded and pinched into little pockets, boiled 3 minutes, tossed in brown butter and sage.

dessert.name: Bonet
dessert.scene: a Piedmont pudding from around Turin
dessert.method: Sugar cooked to a dark caramel and poured into a loaf tin, a custard of eggs, milk, cocoa, crushed amaretti and a splash of rum poured over, baked in a water bath at 160C for 45 minutes, chilled and turned out.

drink.name: Espresso
drink.scene: a Turin café before the job
drink.method: A short espresso pulled from finely ground coffee, drunk standing at the bench with a spoon of sugar.

films.title: Goldfinger
films.tagline: Shaken, not stirred. Gold, not silver.
films.description: James Bond takes on a gold-obsessed villain with a plan for Fort Knox.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Goldfinger offers Bond a mint julep at his Kentucky stud farm.

snacks.name: Fort Knox cornbread bars
snacks.scene: Kentucky gold, cut into bullion bars
snacks.method: Golden buttermilk cornbread baked in a tray and cut into gold bar shapes, with honey butter.

snacks.name: Golf club canapés
snacks.scene: the round of golf Goldfinger tries to cheat
snacks.method: Smoked salmon on buttered rye with dill, and cooked prawns on crisp toasts with lemon mayo and chives, laid out like a 1960s clubhouse spread.

snacks.name: Fontainebleau crab salad cups
snacks.scene: the Miami Beach hotel pool where it starts
snacks.method: Chilled crab, celery and lemon mayonnaise spooned into little lettuce cups. Mix 300g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a finely diced celery stick, chopped chives, lemon zest and juice and a pinch of paprika.

mains.name: Kentucky stud farm steak
mains.scene: lunch at Goldfinger's horse farm
mains.method: Sirloin seared hard and rested, the pan deglazed with bourbon, cracked pepper and stock, cream added and reduced, served with crisp potatoes roasted in beef dripping.

mains.name: Fort Knox fried chicken
mains.scene: the gold vault in Kentucky
mains.method: Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk, dredged in flour seasoned with paprika and white pepper, fried at 165C until 74C inside, with buttered corn on the cob.

dessert.name: Gold-dusted truffles
dessert.scene: the woman painted gold
dessert.method: Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, chilled 3 hours, rolled into balls, dusted in cocoa, then rolled in edible gold lustre until they shine.

drink.name: Mint julep
drink.scene: Goldfinger offers Bond one at the farm
drink.method: Mint gently pressed with sugar syrup in a metal cup, 60ml bourbon, packed with crushed ice, stirred until frosted, a big mint sprig on top.

films.title: GoldenEye
films.tagline: For England, James. And for dinner.
films.description: Bond races to stop a former friend from using a stolen Soviet satellite weapon.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Bond orders his vodka martini at the casino in Monte Carlo.

snacks.name: Zukovsky's caviar blini
snacks.scene: the Russian gangster with the caviar business
snacks.method: Buckwheat blini cooked small in butter, topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, served on ice beside a bottle of frozen vodka.

snacks.name: Monte Carlo baccarat canapés
snacks.scene: the baccarat table in Monte Carlo
snacks.method: Socca chickpea pancakes cut into wedges with tapenade, and anchovy and olive pissaladière squares on puff pastry.

snacks.name: St Petersburg pirozhki
snacks.scene: the tank chase through St Petersburg
snacks.method: Soft yeasted buns filled with beef mince, onion and dill, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter.

mains.name: Beef stroganoff
mains.scene: a Russian supper after the snow
mains.method: Beef fillet strips seared fast, mushrooms and onion cooked in butter, paprika, a splash of brandy, stock and sour cream, over buttered egg noodles.

mains.name: Cuban pork and black beans
mains.scene: the satellite dish hidden in Cuba
mains.method: Pork shoulder marinated in sour orange, garlic and cumin, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, with black beans and rice and fried plantain.

dessert.name: St Petersburg syrniki
dessert.scene: Bond's St Petersburg mission
dessert.method: Little golden Russian cottage cheese pancakes with sour cream and berry jam. Mix 500g cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 80g flour.

drink.name: Vodka martini
drink.method: 60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth shaken hard with ice, strained into a chilled glass, lemon peel.

films.title: Casino Royale
films.tagline: The stakes are high. So is the buffet.
films.description: In his first mission as 007, Bond takes on a banker to terrorists at a high-stakes poker game.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Bond invents the Vesper at the poker table.

snacks.name: Montenegro poker table bites
snacks.scene: the high-stakes game at the casino
snacks.method: Ripe figs halved and wrapped in prosciutto, warm olives marinated with orange peel and fennel seed, and shards of aged cheddar, all on toothpicks so nobody touches the cards with greasy fingers.

snacks.name: Vesper's train dinner salad
snacks.scene: the dinner on the train where they size each other up
snacks.method: Butter lettuce leaves, fennel shaved paper thin, orange segments cut free of pith and hazelnuts toasted at 170C for 8 minutes, dressed at the last second with Dijon, white wine vinegar and olive oil.

snacks.name: Bahamas conch fritters
snacks.scene: the beach house in the Bahamas
snacks.method: Prawns or crab chopped into a batter with capsicum, onion, celery and chilli, spooned into 180C oil and fried golden. Lime aioli.

mains.name: Balkan grilled lamb
mains.scene: Montenegro, before the game
mains.method: Lamb shoulder chops marinated overnight in garlic, rosemary, lemon and olive oil, grilled hot until charred and pink inside, with roasted capsicum and a garlic yoghurt sauce.

mains.name: Venetian seafood risotto
mains.scene: the ending in Venice
mains.method: Carnaroli toasted in olive oil with shallot and garlic, white wine, then hot fish stock ladle by ladle for 16 minutes, prawns, mussels and squid added for the last 3 minutes, finished with parsley and lemon.

dessert.name: Chocolate fondant
dessert.scene: a rich dessert for a rich game
dessert.method: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked into eggs and sugar beaten pale, a little flour folded in, baked in buttered and cocoa-dusted moulds at 220C for 9 minutes, turned out so the centre runs.

drink.name: The Vesper
drink.scene: Bond invents it at the poker table
drink.method: 60ml gin, 20ml vodka and 10ml aromatised white wine shaken very cold, strained into a deep coupe, a long strip of lemon peel.

films.title: Skyfall
films.tagline: Some men are coming to kill us. Dinner first.
films.description: Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt MI6.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Bond and M reach the old family lodge in the Scottish highlands.

snacks.name: Macau casino dumplings
snacks.scene: the floating casino in Macau
snacks.method: Pork and prawn siu mai: mince, chopped prawn, ginger, shiitake and soy wrapped in open wonton skins, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of roe on top.

snacks.name: Shanghai skyline bao
snacks.scene: the glass tower fight in Shanghai
snacks.method: Steamed bao filled with sticky pork belly braised in soy, Shaoxing wine and sugar for 2 hours, pickled cucumber, crushed peanuts and coriander.

snacks.name: Highland oatcakes and smoked salmon
snacks.scene: the drive north to Skyfall
snacks.method: Oatcakes of oats, butter and salt baked at 180C for 20 minutes, topped with crème fraîche, Scottish smoked salmon and dill.

mains.name: Skyfall lodge venison
mains.scene: the old lodge in the Scottish highlands
mains.method: Venison backstrap rubbed with juniper, thyme and pepper, seared to rare, rested, with a whisky and redcurrant sauce, mashed neeps and roast potatoes.

mains.name: Cullen skink
mains.scene: a Scottish soup for a cold night in the lodge
mains.method: Smoked haddock poached in milk, flaked, potato and leek cooked in butter, the milk added, partly mashed and finished with cream and chives.

dessert.name: Cranachan
dessert.scene: a Scottish dessert for the highlands
dessert.method: Oats toasted in a dry pan until nutty, folded through cream whipped with honey and a splash of whisky, layered in glasses with raspberries crushed lightly, more oats on top.

drink.name: Old single malt
drink.scene: the very old whisky Silva pours on his island
drink.method: 30ml good single malt Scotch whisky neat in a tumbler, a few drops of water to open it up.

films.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
films.tagline: Manners maketh dinner.
films.description: A street kid is recruited into a secret spy organisation run out of a London tailor's shop.
films.serve_cue: Serve the burgers when Valentine serves Harry fast food on fine china.

snacks.name: Black Prince pub board
snacks.scene: the pub where Harry teaches some manners
snacks.method: Pork crackling roasted at 240C until blistered, Scotch eggs boiled 6 minutes and wrapped in sausage meat, crumbed and fried at 170C, and sharp pickled onions on a wooden board.

snacks.name: Savile Row tea sandwiches
snacks.scene: the tailor's shop that hides the agency
snacks.method: Crustless sandwiches of cucumber with cream cheese and mint, and smoked salmon with dill butter, cut into perfectly straight fingers as sharp as a suit.

snacks.name: Mr Pickle's cheese biscuits
snacks.scene: Harry's little dog, Mr Pickle
snacks.method: Vintage cheddar, butter, flour and a pinch of cayenne rubbed together, rolled, cut into little dog shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

mains.name: Burgers on fine china
mains.scene: Valentine serves Harry fast food on silver
mains.method: Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and a mustard-ketchup sauce on soft buns, plated on the best china with silver cutlery and linen napkins.

mains.name: Round table roast beef
mains.scene: dinner with Arthur and the knights of the agency
mains.method: Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested, carved, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and a red wine gravy.

dessert.name: Eton mess
dessert.scene: a very English pudding for a very English spy
dessert.method: Crushed meringue, softly whipped cream and quartered strawberries folded together in glasses, with a drizzle of strawberry purée sweetened with a little sugar.

drink.name: Gin martini
drink.scene: stirred while glancing at the vermouth bottle
drink.method: 70ml gin stirred over ice for 10 seconds, strained into a frozen glass, the dry vermouth bottle looked at but never opened. Lemon peel.

films.title: Mission: Impossible
films.tagline: This menu will self-destruct in five seconds.
films.description: An agent framed for his team's deaths goes rogue to find the real mole.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Ethan meets Kittridge at the restaurant with the giant fish tanks.

snacks.name: Prague café chlebíčky
snacks.scene: Ethan's Prague, before it all goes wrong
