snacks.method: Little Czech open sandwiches with ham, egg, potato salad and pickles on baguette slices. Slice a baguette into 16 pieces and spread with butter.

snacks.name: Exploding gum bubble crackers
snacks.scene: the exploding chewing gum
snacks.method: Prawn crackers fried at 190C for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically, served with a sweet chilli and lime dip.

snacks.name: Langley vault cheese stacks
snacks.scene: the white room vault he drops into on a wire
snacks.method: White cheeses only, brie, goat's cheese and a fresh ricotta, stacked on white crackers with pear, perfectly silent.

mains.name: Prague goulash
mains.scene: the night in Prague
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, plenty of onion cooked down slowly, sweet paprika, caraway and tomato, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Bread dumplings or crusty bread.

mains.name: Aquarium restaurant fish
mains.scene: the restaurant with the fish tanks, before they burst
mains.method: Snapper fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, finished with brown butter, capers and lemon, with crushed potatoes and dill.

dessert.name: Trdelník
dessert.scene: Prague's street pastry
dessert.method: Sweet yeasted dough wrapped around foil-covered rolling pins, rolled in cinnamon sugar and walnuts, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until golden, slid off and filled with whipped cream.

drink.name: Czech pilsner
drink.method: A cold Czech pilsner poured with a thick, creamy head into a heavy glass.

films.title: Top Gun
films.tagline: I feel the need. The need for feed.
films.description: A hotshot naval aviator competes at the elite fighter weapons school in San Diego.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when Goose sits down at the piano in the bar.

snacks.name: Officers' club wings
snacks.scene: the bar where they sing to Charlie
snacks.method: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and a little honey, blue cheese dip and celery sticks.

snacks.name: Beach volleyball fish tacos
snacks.scene: the sunny volleyball game
snacks.method: Flathead strips in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime crema and pico de gallo.

snacks.name: Goose's piano bar sliders
snacks.scene: Goose hammering out a rock and roll classic on the piano
snacks.method: Beef sliders smashed thin on a griddle, cheddar melted on, onions cooked slowly, pickles and mustard on soft rolls.

mains.name: Charlie's dinner invitation
mains.scene: Maverick turns up at Charlie's for dinner
mains.method: Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with a Greek salad and warm pita.

mains.name: San Diego carne asada
mains.scene: the base in San Diego
mains.method: Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin for 2 hours, seared over very high heat, rested, sliced thin against the grain, with charred spring onions, rice and beans.

dessert.name: Aviator sunglasses brownies
dessert.scene: the aviators everyone wears
dessert.method: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into rectangles, drizzled with a glossy dark chocolate glaze so they shine.

drink.name: Ice-cold beer
drink.scene: after the flight, back at the bar
drink.method: American lager straight from the fridge, poured into frosted glasses kept in the freezer.

films.title: Top Gun: Maverick
films.tagline: Don't think. Just eat.
films.description: Maverick returns to train a group of young pilots for a near-impossible mission.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when everyone heads to the Hard Deck bar.

snacks.name: Hard Deck bar nachos
snacks.scene: the bar where your phone on the bar means you buy a round
snacks.method: Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, finished with pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream.

snacks.name: Dogfight football hot dogs
snacks.scene: the beach football game
snacks.method: Franks grilled over coals until blistered, in toasted buns with mustard, onions cooked in butter and a spoon of chilli.

snacks.name: Hard Deck loaded fries
snacks.scene: Penny's bar, push-ups if you're wrong
snacks.method: Crisp fries loaded with bacon, melted cheese, sour cream and chives. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C until crisp.

mains.name: Penny's sailboat lunch
mains.scene: the afternoon sailing with Penny
mains.method: Green prawns butterflied and grilled with garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley butter, a crisp salad of cos and cucumber, and crusty bread to mop up the butter, eaten out on deck.

mains.name: Hangar barbecue ribs
mains.scene: the crew's barbecue before the mission
mains.method: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed under the grill with barbecue sauce.

dessert.name: Beach football s'mores
dessert.scene: the Dagger squad's beach game
dessert.method: Toasted marshmallows and chocolate squashed between crisp biscuits by the fire. Toast 16 marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden.

drink.name: Hard Deck lager
drink.scene: phone on the bar means you buy a round
drink.method: American lager in bottles straight from an ice-filled tub, lined up along the bar for the whole squadron.

films.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
films.tagline: Witness me. Then pass the water.
films.description: Max and Furiosa flee across the desert with a tyrant's escaped wives in a war rig.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Immortan Joe opens the water for the crowd below.

snacks.name: Green Place seed crackers
snacks.scene: the bag of seeds the Vuvalini carry
snacks.method: Sunflower, pumpkin, sesame, linseed and chia seeds mixed with oats, water and salt, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour until crisp, broken into shards.

snacks.name: Chrome spray popcorn
snacks.scene: the War Boys' silver chrome before they ride
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in melted butter, sea salt and a light dusting of edible silver lustre so it shines.

snacks.name: Wasteland lizard skewers
snacks.scene: Max catches a lizard to eat in the opening, these are chicken
snacks.method: Chicken thigh strips threaded on skewers, rubbed with smoked paprika, cumin and chilli, grilled hot and blackened at the edges, with a garlic yoghurt dip.

mains.name: Citadel desert flatbread feast
mains.scene: the Citadel up on the rocks
mains.method: Lamb shoulder rubbed with harissa, garlic and cumin, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, with blistered flatbreads, hummus and charred capsicum.

mains.name: Gas Town war rig stew
mains.scene: the long drive in the war rig
mains.method: Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic, smoked paprika, tomato and black beans, braised 3 hours at 160C until thick and dark. Damper alongside.

dessert.name: Desert date bars
dessert.scene: the long ride through the desert
dessert.method: Medjool dates, oats, almonds and honey blitzed, pressed into a tray, topped with melted dark chocolate and sea salt, set and cut into bars.

drink.name: Aqua cola
drink.scene: the water Immortan Joe pours from above, don't get used to it
drink.method: Big jugs of iced water with lime, cucumber and mint, poured freely, the way the Citadel never does.

films.title: Gladiator
films.tagline: Are you not entertained. Are you not fed.
films.description: A betrayed Roman general fights his way through the arena to take revenge on the emperor.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Maximus walks into the Colosseum.

snacks.name: Roman bread and olives
snacks.scene: a soldier's ration on the frontier
snacks.method: Rustic loaf torn up, with olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, fennel seeds and garlic, and a bowl of good olive oil with salt.

snacks.name: Figs with honey and walnuts
snacks.scene: Commodus in the imperial box
snacks.method: Ripe figs halved, topped with a little goat's cheese, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, drizzled with honey and toasted walnuts.

snacks.name: Wheat field crackers
snacks.scene: Maximus running his hand through the wheat at home
snacks.method: Wholemeal crackers rolled thin with oil, salt and rosemary, baked at 180C until crisp, with a bowl of whipped ricotta.

mains.name: Colosseum lamb
mains.scene: the arena in Rome
mains.method: Lamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, carved, with chickpeas braised with tomato and greens.

mains.name: Proximo's gladiator stew
mains.scene: the gladiator school's food
mains.method: Barley, lentils, onion, carrot and pork sausage simmered with stock and herbs for an hour, thick enough for a fighter.

dessert.name: Roman honey cakes
dessert.scene: a sweet for the emperor's table
dessert.method: Ricotta, flour and egg cakes baked on bay leaves at 200C for 30 minutes, soaked in warm honey, poppy seeds on top.

drink.name: Spiced wine
drink.method: Red wine warmed gently with honey, black pepper, bay and orange peel, strained into cups.

films.title: Braveheart
films.tagline: They may take our lives. They'll never take our shortbread.
films.description: A Scottish commoner leads a rebellion against the English king.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Wallace rallies the army before Stirling.

snacks.name: Haggis bites
snacks.scene: a Scottish supper
snacks.method: Haggis (or lamb mince with oats, onion, allspice and pepper) rolled into balls, crumbed, fried at 175C until crisp, with a whisky and mustard cream dip.

snacks.name: Oatcakes and cheddar
snacks.scene: food for a march across the Highlands
snacks.method: Oatcakes of oats, butter, salt and hot water rolled thin, baked at 180C for 20 minutes, with sharp Scottish cheddar and apple chutney.

snacks.name: Thistle-topped smoked salmon
snacks.scene: the thistle Murron gives him
snacks.method: Scottish smoked salmon on brown bread with lemon butter, dill and capers, cut into neat squares.

mains.name: Scotch broth and lamb
mains.scene: a pot over the fire in the Highlands
mains.method: Lamb neck simmered 2 hours with pearl barley, split peas, leek, carrot and swede, the meat pulled back in, parsley on top. Crusty bread.

mains.name: Highland venison with neeps and tatties
mains.scene: the army's feast after Stirling
mains.method: Venison backstrap seared to rare and rested, with mashed swede, buttery mashed potato and a whisky pepper sauce.

dessert.name: Scottish shortbread
dessert.scene: a tin of shortbread for the long march
dessert.method: Butter and sugar creamed, plain flour and a little rice flour worked in, pressed into a tin, pricked, baked at 150C for 40 minutes, cut while warm, caster sugar on top.

drink.name: Whisky toast
drink.method: 30ml Scotch whisky in a small glass, a jug of cold water on the side to add a few drops.

films.title: Titanic
films.tagline: First class dinner. Third class party.
films.description: A poor artist and an upper-class woman fall in love aboard the doomed ocean liner.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Jack joins Rose's family for dinner in first class.

snacks.name: First class oysters
snacks.scene: the first course in the first class dining saloon
snacks.method: Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.

snacks.name: Third class party sandwiches
snacks.scene: the Irish dancing party below deck
snacks.method: Thick slices of leg ham with hot English mustard on buttered crusty bread, with small potatoes boiled in their skins and tossed in butter and salt.

snacks.name: Poached salmon with mousseline
snacks.scene: a dish from the real first class menu that night
snacks.method: Salmon poached gently in court bouillon, chilled, flaked onto toasts with a light mousseline of hollandaise folded with whipped cream.

mains.name: Filet mignon
mains.scene: dinner in first class with Rose's family
mains.method: Eye fillet steaks tied, seared hard in butter, roasted at 200C to 54C and rested, with a red wine and shallot sauce reduced with stock, pommes Anna and buttered green beans.

mains.name: Lamb with mint sauce
mains.scene: a dish straight off the real first class menu that night
mains.method: Lamb racks seasoned and seared fat side down, roasted at 200C to 56C, rested 10 minutes and carved into cutlets, with fresh mint sauce of chopped mint, sugar and vinegar, and minted peas.

dessert.name: Waldorf pudding
dessert.scene: the dessert on the last first class menu
dessert.method: Apples peeled, diced and cooked in butter with sultanas, spooned into a dish, covered in a vanilla custard of eggs, milk and sugar with nutmeg, baked in a water bath at 160C for 40 minutes.

drink.name: Steerage stout
drink.scene: the Irish dancing party in third class
drink.method: Stout poured slowly into pint glasses and left to settle, or cold lager for anyone dancing.

films.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
films.tagline: Bad dates. Good food.
films.description: An archaeologist races the Nazis across the world to find the lost Ark of the Covenant.
films.serve_cue: Serve the dates when Indy nearly eats the poisoned one in Cairo.

snacks.name: Good dates
snacks.scene: the bad dates in Cairo, but safe
snacks.method: Medjool dates split and stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, wrapped in prosciutto, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, drizzled with honey.

snacks.name: Cairo market falafel
snacks.scene: the busy streets of Cairo
snacks.method: Dried chickpeas soaked overnight, blitzed raw with onion, garlic, parsley, coriander and cumin, shaped and fried at 175C until deep brown, with tahini sauce and pickles.

snacks.name: Golden idol cheese puffs
snacks.scene: the golden idol swapped for a bag of sand
snacks.method: Choux pastry with gruyère and a pinch of cayenne, piped into rounds, brushed with egg, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.

mains.name: Sallah's koshari
mains.scene: the excavation site outside Cairo
mains.method: Rice and brown lentils cooked separately, layered with macaroni, topped with a spiced tomato sauce, chickpeas and crisp fried onions.

mains.name: Marion's Nepal bar momo
mains.scene: the bar in Nepal where Marion wins a drinking contest
mains.method: Pork mince with ginger, garlic, spring onion and coriander wrapped in thin dough, steamed 10 minutes, with a tomato and chilli achar.

dessert.name: Basbousa
dessert.scene: something sweet in Cairo
dessert.method: Semolina, coconut and yoghurt cake baked at 180C for 30 minutes, soaked in lemon and rose syrup, an almond on each square.

drink.name: Marion's shot
drink.scene: the drinking contest in her bar
drink.method: A small shot of chilled vodka, or a hot sweet spiced chai for the rest of us.

films.id: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984)
films.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
films.tagline: Snake surprise not included.
films.description: Indy, a singer and a kid end up in India trying to recover sacred stones stolen from a village.
films.serve_cue: Serve the banquet when the Pankot Palace dinner is brought out.

snacks.name: Shanghai nightclub dumplings
snacks.scene: the nightclub in Shanghai at the start
snacks.method: Prawn har gow in thin wheat starch wrappers, pleated and steamed 6 minutes, with a soy and chilli oil dip.

snacks.name: Pankot Palace snake surprise
snacks.scene: the banquet's snake dish, made with sausages
snacks.method: Long thin sausages coiled on a platter and glazed with mango chutney and chilli, a jug of spiced yoghurt alongside. Surprise.

snacks.name: Short Round's samosas
snacks.scene: the kid who keeps Indy alive
snacks.method: Potato and pea filling with cumin, chilli and garam masala, folded into pastry cones, fried at 175C until blistered. Tamarind chutney.

mains.name: Village thali
mains.scene: the village whose sacred stone was taken
mains.method: Chickpeas simmered in a tomato and onion masala, yellow dal tempered with mustard seed and cumin, cauliflower roasted with turmeric, all on one plate with basmati and warm flatbreads.

mains.name: Maharaja's lamb curry
mains.scene: the very strange palace banquet
mains.method: Lamb shoulder marinated overnight in yoghurt, ginger, garlic and garam masala, onions cooked down slowly until deep brown, tomato added, the lamb braised covered at 160C for 2.5 hours until tender. Basmati rice.

dessert.name: Chilled mango brains
dessert.scene: the chilled monkey brains, made with mango
dessert.method: Mango purée sweetened, gelatine bloomed and stirred through, whipped cream folded in, set in small dome moulds for 4 hours and turned out onto plates with a little passionfruit.

drink.name: Mango lassi
drink.method: Ripe mango blended with natural yoghurt, cold milk, a little sugar and a pinch of cardamom until smooth and frothy.

films.id: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)
films.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
films.tagline: Choose wisely. Choose dessert.
films.description: Indy and his father race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drinks when Indy has to choose the right cup.

snacks.name: Venice library cicchetti
snacks.scene: the library in Venice with the X on the floor
snacks.method: Toasts topped with whipped salt cod and parsley, prosciutto and fig, and marinated sardines with onion and raisins, Venetian bar style.

snacks.name: Circus train popcorn
snacks.scene: young Indy on the circus train
snacks.method: Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb and salt, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirred every 15.

snacks.name: Austrian castle pretzels
snacks.scene: the castle where Indy finds his dad
snacks.method: Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with obatzda of camembert, butter and paprika.

mains.name: Hatay lamb kebabs
mains.scene: the desert road to the canyon
mains.method: Lamb mince with onion, garlic, sumac, chilli and parsley pressed onto skewers, grilled hot, with flatbread, grilled tomatoes and garlic yoghurt.

mains.name: Zeppelin dining room schnitzel
mains.scene: the zeppelin escape
mains.method: Veal or pork schnitzel pounded thin, crumbed, fried in butter until golden and puffy, with lemon, warm potato salad and cucumber salad.

dessert.name: Petra rose and pistachio cake
dessert.scene: the canyon city carved into rock
dessert.method: Almond and pistachio cake baked at 170C for 40 minutes, soaked with rosewater and lemon syrup, crushed pistachios and rose petals on top.

drink.name: Grail cups
drink.scene: he chose wisely: the simple one
drink.method: Red wine or red grape juice poured into plain wooden or clay cups, and one fancy gold goblet that nobody should drink from.

films.title: The Exorcist
films.tagline: The power of soup compels you.
films.description: A mother seeks help from two priests when her daughter is possessed.
films.serve_cue: Serve the soup when the priests climb the stairs to Regan's room.

snacks.name: Georgetown crab cakes
snacks.scene: the townhouse in Georgetown
snacks.method: Crab meat bound with a little mayo, egg, mustard and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.

snacks.name: Iraq dig flatbread and dips
snacks.scene: Father Merrin at the dig in northern Iraq
snacks.method: Eggplant charred whole over a flame until collapsed, scooped and mashed with tahini, garlic and lemon, served with hummus, pickled turnips and warm flatbread, sumac dusted over the top.

snacks.name: Chris's party canapés
snacks.scene: the actress's dinner party at the house
snacks.method: Devilled eggs with paprika, smoked salmon on buttered rye with dill, and celery boats filled with blue cheese whipped into cream cheese, a proper 1970s spread.

mains.name: Pea and ham soup
mains.scene: the famous green, served in a bowl only
mains.method: Split peas simmered 2 hours with a smoked ham hock, onion, carrot and celery, the ham picked back in, served with crusty bread. Eat it, don't throw it.

mains.name: Georgetown roast chicken
mains.scene: a quiet dinner at home before it all starts
mains.method: Chicken dry-brined overnight, stuffed with lemon, garlic and thyme, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C until the thigh hits 75C, rested, with roast potatoes and a pan gravy.

dessert.name: Devil's food cake
dessert.scene: the devil in the house
dessert.method: Cocoa whisked into hot coffee, beaten into butter, sugar and eggs with buttermilk and flour, baked at 175C for 30 minutes in two tins, sandwiched and covered in a dark chocolate fudge frosting.

drink.name: Holy water
drink.method: Sparkling water with lemon and a few mint leaves, poured from a small glass bottle, sprinkled for luck.

films.title: The Sixth Sense
films.tagline: I see dinner.
films.description: A child psychologist tries to help a frightened boy who says he can see ghosts.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Malcolm sits down at the anniversary dinner.

snacks.name: Roast pork and provolone sliders
snacks.scene: a Philadelphia winter
snacks.method: Slow-roasted pork shoulder sliced thin with garlicky broccoli rabe and sharp provolone on small soft rolls.

snacks.name: Red tent strawberries
snacks.scene: the little red tent in Cole's room
snacks.method: Strawberries dipped in tempered dark chocolate, then half rolled in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red.

snacks.name: Birthday party fairy bread
snacks.scene: the birthday party that goes wrong for Cole
snacks.method: White bread buttered to the edges, pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles, stacked high.

mains.name: Anniversary dinner
mains.scene: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner
mains.method: Salmon fillet roasted skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes, with a beurre blanc of shallot, white wine and cold butter whisked in, crushed potatoes and asparagus.

mains.name: Lynn's kitchen breakfast
mains.scene: the kitchen where every cupboard opens on its own
mains.method: Buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter until bubbles set, crisp streaky bacon and soft scrambled eggs stirred slowly in butter, all served with maple syrup and orange juice.

dessert.name: Ghostly white chocolate mousse
dessert.scene: the room goes cold when they're close
dessert.method: White chocolate melted into warm cream, cooled to room temperature, folded through whipped cream and a whisked egg white, set in glasses for 4 hours, a few raspberries on top.

drink.name: Hot tea with lemon
drink.scene: Cole's mum keeping the house warm
drink.method: Black tea with a slice of lemon and a spoon of honey, served hot in mugs.

films.title: Signs
films.tagline: Swing away. Then eat.
films.description: A farmer and his family find crop circles in their cornfield and brace for what's coming.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the family sits down to their last supper of favourites.

snacks.name: Crop circle corn
snacks.scene: the cornfield with the circles cut into it
snacks.method: Corn cobs grilled over high heat until charred in rings, cut into thick wheels, brushed with butter melted with lime zest and chilli, finished with flaky salt and coriander.

snacks.name: Foil hat popcorn
snacks.scene: Morgan and Bo in their tin foil hats
snacks.method: Popcorn popped in a covered pot, tossed in browned butter, parmesan and a little garlic salt, served in bowls lined with crumpled foil.

snacks.name: Merrill's batting cage hot dogs
snacks.scene: Merrill and his minor league bat on the wall
snacks.method: Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, in toasted buns with yellow mustard, sweet relish and onions cooked slowly in butter.

mains.name: Last supper favourites
mains.scene: everyone picks their favourite for what might be the last meal
mains.method: Roast chicken dry-brined and roasted at 220C then 180C, a baked macaroni and cheese with a crunchy top, and garlic bread, all on the table at once.

mains.name: Pennsylvania farmhouse pot roast
mains.scene: Sunday dinner on the Hess farm
mains.method: Beef chuck seared hard, onion, carrot and celery, stock and thyme, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes added for the last hour, gravy from the pan.

dessert.name: Swing away strawberry shortcake
dessert.scene: Merrill's swing, Bucks County farm
dessert.method: Split buttermilk biscuits piled with sugared strawberries and soft whipped cream. Rub 100g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 200ml buttermilk and pat 2cm thick.

drink.name: Bo's glasses of water
drink.scene: Bo leaves half-drunk glasses of water all over the house
drink.method: Glasses of chilled water with lemon slices and ice set out all over the table, each one left half full.

films.title: The Ring
films.tagline: Seven days. Seven snacks.

mains.method: Dough pressed into an oiled rectangular tin, cubed brick cheese or mozzarella and cheddar right to the edges, pepperoni, baked at 250C for 15 minutes, tomato sauce striped on top after.

mains.name: AJ's LA dinner
mains.scene: the actor back in LA before everything catches up with him
mains.method: Green prawns grilled hot with garlic and chilli oil, piled on a salad of avocado, cos, lime juice, coriander and toasted pepitas, with warm tortillas on the side.

dessert.name: Sticky date pudding
dessert.scene: something comforting after the basement
dessert.method: Dates soaked with bicarb, beaten into a butter sponge, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, drowned in hot toffee sauce.

drink.name: Red wine
drink.scene: a glass to settle the nerves on that first awkward night
drink.method: A medium-bodied red opened on the kitchen bench and poured into two mismatched glasses from the rental's cupboard.

films.title: Annabelle
films.tagline: Mind the popcorn. Mind the doll.
films.description: A young couple's new house fills with dread after a vintage doll is given to them as a gift.
films.serve_cue: Serve the popcorn when Mia puts a pan of it on the stove.

snacks.name: Stovetop popcorn, watched closely
snacks.scene: the pan of popcorn left on the stove too long
snacks.method: Kernels popped in coconut oil in a heavy covered pot over medium heat, shaken constantly, pulled the second the popping slows, tossed in butter and salt. Never walk away from it.

snacks.name: 1969 cocktail party bites
snacks.scene: Santa Monica in the late 60s
snacks.method: Devilled eggs with paprika, cocktail franks in a sticky barbecue and grape jelly glaze, and celery boats filled with cream cheese and olives.

snacks.name: Sewing basket cheese straws
snacks.scene: Mia at her sewing machine
snacks.method: Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in parmesan and paprika, cut into strips and twisted like thread, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.

mains.name: Pasadena apartment pot roast
mains.scene: the new apartment in Pasadena
mains.method: Beef chuck seared, onion, carrot and celery, red wine and stock, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes for the last hour.

mains.name: Young doctor's casserole
mains.scene: John's long hours at the hospital
mains.method: Chicken, mushroom and rice baked together in a creamy sauce with thyme at 180C for 50 minutes, a 1960s weeknight dinner done properly.

dessert.name: Porcelain doll vanilla cupcakes
dessert.scene: the doll in her white dress
dessert.method: Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with white Swiss meringue buttercream, a tiny pink sugar rose on each.

drink.name: 1969 grasshopper shakes
drink.method: Mint chocolate ice cream blended with milk into pale green shakes, a crème de menthe nip for adults.

films.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
films.tagline: New rules. Same rules. Not after midnight.
films.description: The gremlins break loose inside a high-tech Manhattan skyscraper.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks before midnight, still.

snacks.name: Skyscraper food court dumplings
snacks.scene: the tower full of shops and restaurants
snacks.method: Pork and cabbage potstickers folded, fried until the bottoms brown, steamed under a lid, with a soy and black vinegar dip.

snacks.name: Cooking show microwave nachos
snacks.scene: the cooking show broadcast from inside the building
snacks.method: Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes (the oven, not the microwave), salsa and sour cream.

snacks.name: Clamp Centre deli sandwiches
snacks.scene: the lobby deli in the smart building
snacks.method: Pastrami, Swiss and coleslaw on rye, cut into quarters and piled high on a deli platter.

mains.name: Manhattan deli pastrami
mains.scene: lunch in midtown New York
mains.method: Pastrami steamed 10 minutes until soft and piled high on rye spread with spicy mustard, a whole dill pickle and a creamy potato salad with celery and dill on the side.

mains.name: Executive dining room steak
mains.scene: the boss's very fancy top floor
mains.method: Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seared hard in cast iron, pulled at 54C and rested, the pan deglazed with brandy, crushed peppercorns and stock, cream reduced in, with shoestring fries.

dessert.name: Clamp tower rainbow cookies
dessert.scene: the Clamp Centre in Manhattan
dessert.method: New York Italian bakery layers of almond sponge in three colours with jam and a chocolate top.

drink.name: Water, still carefully
drink.scene: no water near the mogwai, again
drink.method: Sparkling water with lemon and lime over ice, served well away from anything furry.

films.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
films.tagline: Who you gonna call. The diner.
films.description: A single mum and her kids move into her late father's Oklahoma farmhouse and find what he left behind.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the tiny marshmallow men get loose in the supermarket.

snacks.name: Mini marshmallow men
snacks.scene: the tiny marshmallow men who run riot in the store
snacks.method: Big marshmallows stacked in twos on skewers, eyes and smile piped in melted dark chocolate, half of them toasted with a blowtorch.

snacks.name: Summerville fried okra
snacks.scene: small-town Oklahoma diner
snacks.method: Okra cut into rounds, tossed in cornmeal and fried crisp, with hot sauce. Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper.

snacks.name: Farmhouse cornbread
snacks.scene: the dusty old farmhouse full of secrets
snacks.method: Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.

mains.name: Roller diner burgers
mains.scene: the carhop diner with the skating waiters
mains.method: Chuck patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft buns, crinkle-cut fries, delivered on a tray.

mains.name: Oklahoma chicken fried steak
mains.scene: dinner in the small Oklahoma town
mains.method: Minute steaks pounded thin, dredged in seasoned flour, buttermilk and flour again, fried until crisp, covered in black pepper cream gravy. Mash and green beans.

dessert.name: Toasted marshmallow pie
dessert.scene: a giant marshmallow man, in pie form
dessert.method: Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache filling, topped with a tall marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.

drink.name: Diner milkshakes
drink.scene: the drinks at the roller diner
drink.method: Vanilla ice cream blended thick with cold milk and a little vanilla, whipped cream and a cherry, served in tall glasses.

films.title: Toy Story 3
films.tagline: So long, partner. Pass the snacks.
films.description: Andy's toys end up at a daycare centre run by a bear who smells of strawberries.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when the toys meet the strawberry-scented bear.

snacks.name: Tortilla head quesadillas
snacks.scene: when the potato toy has to borrow a tortilla for a body
snacks.method: Flour tortillas filled with cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan until golden and melted, cut into wedges. Salsa.

snacks.name: Daycare snack time
snacks.scene: the Caterpillar Room at Sunnyside
snacks.method: Crisp apple slices tossed in lemon, cubes of mild cheddar, butter crackers and little cups of sultanas, set out in a muffin tin so everyone grabs their own.

snacks.name: Bonnie's tea party sandwiches
snacks.scene: the tea party in Bonnie's room
snacks.method: Fairy bread cut into triangles and crustless strawberry jam sandwiches cut into hearts with a cutter, laid out on a toy-sized tea set.

mains.name: Andy's going-away dinner
mains.scene: his last dinner before college
mains.method: Spaghetti and meatballs: beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.

mains.name: College road trip chicken wraps
mains.scene: packing the car for college
mains.method: Chicken thighs rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and salt, grilled until charred, sliced and wrapped in warm tortillas with cos, tomato, cheddar and a buttermilk ranch dressing.

dessert.name: Strawberry bear shortcakes
dessert.scene: the bear who smells of strawberries
dessert.method: Buttery shortcake rounds baked at 200C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar.

drink.name: Strawberry milk
drink.method: Ripe strawberries blended with cold milk, a spoon of honey and a few ice cubes until pink and frothy.

films.title: Up
films.tagline: Adventure is out there. So is dessert.
films.description: A grumpy widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with a young stowaway.
films.serve_cue: Serve dessert when Carl and Russell sit on the kerb with their ice creams.

snacks.name: Grape soda badge jellies
snacks.scene: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
snacks.method: Grape juice set with gelatine in little round moulds, turned out and topped with a dot of whipped cream so they look like bottle caps.

snacks.name: Wilderness Explorer trail mix
snacks.scene: Russell's badge sash and backpack
snacks.method: Peanuts, raisins, choc chips, pretzels and banana chips tossed together and scooped into paper bags with a hand-drawn badge on each.

snacks.name: Balloon cheese bites
snacks.scene: the house floating on thousands of balloons
snacks.method: Bocconcini rolled in different coloured coatings (paprika, herbs, black pepper, sesame), skewered on long picks like a bunch of balloons.

mains.name: Muntz's airship dinner
mains.scene: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
mains.method: Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with a red wine sauce, roast potatoes and buttered greens, a very proper dinner in the clouds.

mains.name: Paradise Falls picnic
mains.scene: the South American cliffs Ellie always wanted to see
mains.method: Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic, cumin and orange, grilled until charred, with black beans, rice and a mango salsa.

dessert.name: Kevin's chocolate
dessert.scene: the giant bird who loves chocolate
dessert.method: Dark chocolate bark scattered with toasted hazelnuts, dried cherries and flaky salt, set and broken into shards. Save some for the bird.

drink.name: Grape soda
drink.method: Grape juice topped with soda water over ice, a squeeze of lime.

films.title: Inside Out
films.tagline: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Disgust. And dinner.
films.description: An 11-year-old's emotions struggle to steer her through a move from Minnesota to San Francisco.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pizza when Riley tries the broccoli pizza in San Francisco.

snacks.name: Broccoli pizza squares
snacks.scene: Disgust's worst nightmare in San Francisco
snacks.method: Pizza dough stretched in a tray, olive oil, garlic, mozzarella and broccolini roasted until crisp at the edges, chilli flakes and parmesan. Actually good.

snacks.name: Bing Bong fairy floss
snacks.scene: the imaginary friend who cries lollies
snacks.method: Pink fairy floss piled high in paper cones, a few soft jelly lollies tucked into each one, served straight away before it wilts.

snacks.name: Core memory cheese balls
snacks.scene: the glowing core memories
snacks.method: Cream cheese and cheddar rolled into balls, each coated a different colour: paprika, herbs, sesame, crushed pistachio and black sesame.

mains.name: Minnesota hotdish
mains.scene: home in Minnesota before the move
mains.method: Beef mince and onion in a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with tater tots and cheddar, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.

mains.name: The family dinner table
mains.scene: the dinner where Anger takes the controls
mains.method: Chicken thighs rubbed with lemon zest, garlic and rosemary, roasted at 220C for 35 minutes on a tray of halved potatoes until the skin crackles, with buttered green beans. A calm family dinner, for once.

dessert.name: Five feelings cupcakes
dessert.scene: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust at the controls
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, buttercream split into five bowls tinted yellow, blue, red, purple and green, one colour per cupcake.

drink.name: Bing Bong's fairy floss milkshake
drink.scene: Riley's imaginary friend is made of it
drink.method: Thick vanilla milkshake blended with strawberry and topped with a puff of pink fairy floss.

films.title: Coco
films.tagline: Remember dinner.
films.description: A boy who dreams of music ends up in the Land of the Dead on the Day of the Dead.
films.serve_cue: Serve the tamales when Abuelita insists Miguel eat more.

snacks.name: Abuelita's tamales
snacks.scene: she keeps piling them on his plate
snacks.method: Masa beaten with lard, stock and baking powder until fluffy, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with chicken in a red chilli sauce, folded and steamed 75 minutes.

snacks.name: Marigold bridge corn
snacks.scene: the bridge of orange petals to the Land of the Dead
snacks.method: Corn cobs grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander, a few marigold-coloured nasturtium petals on top.

snacks.name: Plaza guacamole
snacks.scene: the mariachi plaza in Santa Cecilia
snacks.method: Avocados smashed with lime, white onion, jalapeño, coriander and salt, served with warm corn chips.

mains.name: Ofrenda pozole
mains.scene: the family's Day of the Dead table
mains.method: Pork shoulder simmered 3 hours with garlic and onion, hominy and a sauce of toasted dried chillies added, served with shredded cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.

mains.name: Rivera family enchiladas
mains.scene: the shoemaking family's kitchen
mains.method: Corn tortillas dipped in red chilli sauce, rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, covered in more sauce and cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes. Crema and onion.

dessert.name: Pan de muerto
dessert.scene: the bread on every ofrenda
dessert.method: Enriched yeasted dough with orange zest and orange blossom, shaped into rounds with dough "bones" on top, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, brushed with butter and rolled in sugar.

drink.name: Champurrado
drink.scene: the thick chocolate drink of the season
drink.method: Masa harina whisked into hot milk with Mexican-style chocolate, cinnamon and brown sugar, simmered until thick and silky.

films.title: Moana
films.tagline: How far she'll go for a good feed.
films.description: A chief's daughter sails across the ocean to find a demigod and restore the heart of an island.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the coconut pirates attack the boat.

snacks.name: Coconut pirate bites
snacks.scene: the little coconut-armoured pirates
snacks.method: Coconut prawns: prawns dipped in flour, egg and a mix of panko and shredded coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, with a sweet chilli and lime dip.

snacks.name: Ocean poke cups
snacks.scene: the ocean that chooses her
snacks.method: Raw tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli, spooned onto rice in little cups with cucumber and seaweed.

snacks.name: Village taro chips
snacks.scene: the gardens and groves on Motunui
snacks.method: Taro peeled with gloves, sliced paper thin, rinsed and dried, fried at 170C until crisp, salted, with a dip of coconut cream whisked with lime juice, zest and a pinch of chilli.

mains.name: Te Fiti fish in coconut
mains.scene: the island coming back to life
mains.method: Snapper fillets cooked gently in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chilli, finished with lime and coriander, served with rice.

mains.name: Maui's island chicken
mains.scene: a feast fit for a demigod
mains.method: Chicken thighs marinated overnight in soy, pineapple juice, ginger and garlic, grilled until charred, with thick rings of grilled pineapple and rice cooked in coconut milk.

dessert.name: Coconut haupia
dessert.scene: a Pacific coconut pudding for the voyage
dessert.method: Coconut milk, sugar and cornflour whisked together and cooked over medium heat until very thick, poured into a tray, chilled 3 hours, cut into squares, topped with toasted coconut and fresh mango.

drink.name: Fresh coconut water
drink.scene: the song about everything a coconut is good for
drink.method: Chilled coconut water poured over ice with a squeeze of lime and a few torn mint leaves, served in a halved coconut if you can crack one.

films.title: Frozen
films.tagline: The cold never bothered us. Dessert might.
films.description: A princess sets out across a frozen kingdom to find her sister, whose powers have locked it in winter.
films.serve_cue: Serve the chocolate when Anna arrives at the coronation party.

snacks.name: Coronation party chocolates
snacks.scene: Anna's very excited about the chocolate
snacks.method: Dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa, and white chocolate ones rolled in icing sugar like snow, piled on a silver plate.

snacks.name: Kristoff's carrot sticks
snacks.scene: the carrot he shares with Sven, and Olaf's nose
snacks.method: Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey, thyme and butter until caramelised, with a whipped feta dip.

snacks.name: Finish each other's sandwiches
snacks.scene: the song Anna and Hans sing
snacks.method: Open sandwiches on rye: smoked salmon with dill and egg, and ham with mustard and pickled cucumber, cut so they line up in pairs.

mains.name: Arendelle meatballs
mains.scene: a Nordic dinner in the castle
mains.method: Beef and pork meatballs with breadcrumbs, grated onion and allspice, browned in butter, simmered in a cream gravy, with mash and lingonberry jam.

mains.name: Ice harvesters' fish stew
mains.scene: the men cutting ice on the frozen lake
mains.method: Cod, potato, leek and carrot simmered in fish stock with cream and dill, a squeeze of lemon.

dessert.name: Norwegian school bread
dessert.scene: a nod to the Norway pavilion bakery at the parks
dessert.method: Soft cardamom buns, the centres filled with vanilla custard, tops spread with icing and dipped in desiccated coconut.

drink.name: Oaken's hot cocoa
drink.scene: the trading post and sauna on the mountain
drink.method: Cocoa whisked into hot milk with sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream.

films.title: Encanto
films.tagline: We don't talk about dessert. We eat it.
films.description: A Colombian family with magical gifts lives in an enchanted house, all except one granddaughter.
films.serve_cue: Serve the arepas when Julieta hands them out to heal everyone.

snacks.name: Julieta's healing arepas
snacks.scene: the arepas that heal any hurt
snacks.method: Pre-cooked corn flour mixed with warm water, salt and butter, shaped into discs, filled with grated mozzarella, cooked on a griddle until golden and crisp.

snacks.name: Pandebono
snacks.scene: the bakery bread of Colombia
snacks.method: Tapioca starch, corn flour, feta and egg mixed into a dough, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

snacks.name: Isabela's flower crudités
snacks.scene: the flowers that bloom wherever she goes
snacks.method: Radishes, cucumber and baby capsicums cut into flower shapes, scattered with edible flowers, with a dip of sour cream blitzed with lime, coriander and green chilli.

mains.name: Ajiaco
mains.scene: a Colombian chicken and potato soup
mains.method: Chicken thighs simmered with three kinds of potato, corn on the cob and guascas (or oregano) until the potatoes break down, served with cream, capers and avocado.

mains.name: Madrigal family feast
mains.scene: the whole family around the table at Casita
mains.method: Beef chuck braised in tomato, onion and cumin until shredded, with rice, black beans, fried plantain and a fried egg.

dessert.name: Buñuelos
dessert.scene: a Colombian Christmas treat for the whole house
dessert.method: Crumbled feta and fresh cheese mixed with cornflour, tapioca starch, egg and a little sugar into a soft dough, rolled into balls, fried at 160C for 6 minutes until golden and round.

drink.name: Colombian hot chocolate
drink.scene: hot chocolate the Colombian way, with cheese
drink.method: Dark chocolate whisked into hot milk with a little cinnamon until frothy, a cube of mozzarella dropped into each mug to go soft and stringy.

films.title: Lilo & Stitch
films.tagline: Ohana means nobody gets left out of dinner.
films.description: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts a strange blue dog who turns out to be an alien experiment.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sandwiches when Lilo takes Pudge the fish his peanut butter sandwich.

snacks.name: Pudge's peanut butter sandwiches
snacks.scene: the fish who controls the weather, fed every Thursday
snacks.method: Soft white bread with smooth peanut butter and a little honey, crusts off, cut into fish shapes with a cutter.

snacks.name: Kauai poke
snacks.scene: the island of Kauai
snacks.method: Sashimi tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion, chilli and a little seaweed, served on rice crackers.

snacks.name: Surf day shrimp
snacks.scene: the surfing day with Nani and David
snacks.method: Prawns cooked in lots of butter and garlic, a splash of lemon, served shell-on over rice with a scoop of macaroni salad.

mains.name: Loco moco
mains.scene: Hawaiian comfort food
mains.method: Beef patties seasoned and seared in a hot pan, set on steamed rice, smothered in a brown onion gravy made in the same pan with stock and butter, topped with a runny fried egg.

mains.name: Ohana luau pork
mains.scene: the whole family at the luau
mains.method: Pork shoulder rubbed with salt and smoked paprika, wrapped in banana leaves and foil, roasted at 150C for 6 hours, shredded, with rice and pineapple.

dessert.name: Pineapple soft serve
dessert.scene: a nod to the Hawaiian pineapple soft serve at the parks
dessert.method: Frozen pineapple blitzed with a little coconut cream and lime until thick, piped into cups and served straight away.

drink.name: Blue Hawaiian mocktail
drink.method: Pineapple juice, coconut cream and blue raspberry cordial blended with plenty of ice until slushy, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge.

films.title: Mulan
films.tagline: Bring honour to us all. Bring dumplings.
films.description: A young woman disguises herself as a man to take her father's place in the army.
films.serve_cue: Serve breakfast when Mushu cooks Mulan her first morning meal at camp.

snacks.name: Matchmaker's tea and dumplings
snacks.scene: the matchmaker's visit that goes badly
snacks.method: Pork and chive dumplings folded and steamed 8 minutes, with a soy and black vinegar dip. Tea poured carefully.

snacks.name: Lucky cricket spring rolls
snacks.scene: Cri-Kee, the lucky cricket
snacks.method: Vegetable spring rolls of cabbage, carrot, mushroom and glass noodles, rolled tight and fried at 180C until golden. Sweet chilli.

snacks.name: Training camp edamame
snacks.scene: the army training camp before sunrise
snacks.method: Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed in a hot wok with garlic, chilli flakes, a splash of soy and plenty of flaky salt.

mains.name: Mushu's breakfast congee
mains.scene: the porridge with a smiling face Mushu makes for Mulan
mains.method: Jasmine rice simmered 90 minutes in chicken stock with ginger until silky, topped with a fried egg and bacon in a smiling face, spring onion and soy.

mains.name: Imperial city feast
mains.scene: the celebration in the Imperial City
mains.method: Pork belly strips marinated in honey, hoisin, soy and five-spice overnight, roasted at 200C for 40 minutes, basted twice, with steamed rice and gai lan stir-fried with garlic and oyster sauce.

dessert.name: Mooncakes
dessert.scene: a sweet for the autumn festival
dessert.method: Golden syrup, oil and alkaline water mixed into flour and rested 2 hours, wrapped thinly around balls of lotus seed paste, pressed into moulds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, egg washed and baked 10 more.

drink.name: Jasmine tea
drink.scene: a cup offered to the family ancestors
drink.method: Jasmine green tea steeped in water just off the boil for 3 minutes, poured into small cups, refilled through the meal.

films.title: Tarzan
films.tagline: Raised in the jungle. Fed like a king.
films.description: A man raised by gorillas meets an English explorer's daughter and has to choose between two worlds.
films.serve_cue: Serve the tea when Jane sets out her tea service in the jungle.

snacks.name: Jane's jungle tea sandwiches
snacks.scene: the proper English tea Jane brings to the jungle
snacks.method: Crustless cucumber and butter, and egg and cress sandwiches cut into triangles, served on a tray beside a pot of tea.

snacks.name: Gorilla family fruit platter
snacks.scene: Kala and the family foraging in the trees
snacks.method: Bananas, mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit cut into big chunks, piled on banana leaves with lime and a pinch of chilli salt.

snacks.name: Terk's camp raid crackers
snacks.scene: the camp the gorillas trash
snacks.method: Spiced roasted chickpeas and cashews with curry powder and honey, roasted at 180C for 25 minutes until crunchy, tipped out messily on a board.

mains.name: Professor Porter's expedition curry
mains.scene: the English expedition's camp kitchen
mains.method: Chicken thighs cooked with onion, ginger, garlic and curry spices, tomato and coconut milk, simmered 40 minutes, with rice and mango chutney.

mains.name: Treehouse peanut stew
mains.scene: the jungle of West Africa
mains.method: Chicken, sweet potato and tomato simmered with peanut butter, ginger and chilli until thick, served with rice and greens.

dessert.name: Banana fritters
dessert.scene: Tarzan's favourite fruit
dessert.method: Ripe bananas in thick slices dipped in a light batter of flour and sparkling water, fried at 180C until puffed, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with honey.

drink.name: English breakfast tea
drink.method: Tea brewed 4 minutes in a warmed pot, milk and sugar on the tray, poured into proper cups.

films.title: Hercules
films.tagline: From zero to hero to second helpings.
films.description: The son of Zeus, raised on Earth, trains to become a true hero and win back his place on Olympus.
films.serve_cue: Serve the feast when Hercules returns to Mount Olympus.

snacks.name: Thebes market spanakopita
snacks.scene: the city of Thebes
snacks.method: Spinach and feta with dill, spring onion and egg, wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked at 190C for 25 minutes until golden.

snacks.name: Phil's training snacks
snacks.scene: the satyr who trains heroes
snacks.method: Marinated olives, feta cubes with oregano and oil, cherry tomatoes and warm pita, a light snack between training sessions.

snacks.name: Hydra heads haloumi
snacks.scene: the monster that grows more heads
snacks.method: Haloumi sliced and griddled until golden, drizzled with honey and chilli, more slices added as fast as they're eaten.

mains.name: Olympus souvlaki
mains.scene: a feast fit for the gods on Mount Olympus
mains.method: Lamb leg cubes marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, skewered and grilled hot, with pita, tzatziki, tomato and red onion.

mains.name: Hades's fiery prawns
mains.scene: the god of the underworld with the flaming hair
mains.method: Prawns baked at 200C in a spicy tomato sauce with chilli, garlic and ouzo, covered in crumbled feta, served with crusty bread.

dessert.name: Ambrosia loukoumades
dessert.scene: food of the gods
dessert.method: Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil at 175C, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey and cinnamon, sprinkled with walnuts.

drink.name: Olympus nectar
drink.method: Peach nectar topped with sparkling water and a squeeze of lemon over ice, a sprig of mint.

films.title: The Emperor's New Groove
films.tagline: Pull the lever. Serve the spinach puffs.
films.description: A selfish young emperor is turned into a llama and has to rely on a kind villager to get home.
films.serve_cue: Serve the spinach puffs when Kronk brings them out at dinner.

snacks.name: Kronk's spinach puffs
snacks.scene: Kronk is very proud of his spinach puffs
snacks.method: Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with feta, ricotta, garlic and nutmeg, spooned onto puff pastry squares, folded, egg washed, baked at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed.

snacks.name: Andean potato bites
snacks.scene: a nod to the mountain villages
snacks.method: Small potatoes boiled until tender, crushed, fried in butter until crisp, topped with a creamy spicy cheese sauce of feta, milk and yellow chilli.

snacks.name: Pacha's village quinoa salad
snacks.scene: Pacha's hilltop village
snacks.method: Quinoa rinsed and cooked, tossed with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion, coriander and a lime and cumin dressing.

mains.name: Mudka's Meat Hut special
mains.scene: the roadside diner where Kuzco orders the special
mains.method: Beef chuck patties grilled hot, cheddar and onion on toasted buns, with chips, the kind of special a jungle diner would sling.

mains.name: Peruvian roast chicken

dessert.name: Birthday cake for Pacha's kids
dessert.scene: the kids' birthday surprise in the village

drink.name: Chicha morada
drink.scene: a purple corn drink from Peru
drink.method: Purple corn simmered with pineapple peel, cinnamon and cloves, strained, sweetened, chilled with lime and diced apple.

films.title: Madagascar
films.tagline: Move it, move it. To the buffet.

snacks.name: Penguins' sushi rolls
snacks.scene: the penguins heading for Antarctica
snacks.method: Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, spread on nori, filled with salmon and avocado, rolled tight with a mat, sliced with a wet knife, soy and pickled ginger alongside.

snacks.name: Marty's birthday zebra brownies
snacks.scene: Marty's tenth birthday
snacks.method: Brownie batter and cheesecake batter swirled into black and white stripes, baked at 170C for 30 minutes.

mains.scene: the steak Alex dreams about in the zoo
mains.method: Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, pulled at 54C and rested 8 minutes, topped with garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries.

mains.name: Island fish curry
mains.scene: the fish Alex finally learns to eat on the island
mains.method: Onion, ginger and garlic softened, curry spices and tomato cooked down, coconut milk added, snapper pieces simmered gently 6 minutes, finished with lime and coriander. Steamed rice.

dessert.name: Jungle party pineapple
dessert.scene: King Julien's all-night jungle party
dessert.method: Thick pineapple wedges grilled until charred, drizzled with a caramel of brown sugar, butter and a splash of dark rum cooked until glossy, with coconut ice cream.

drink.name: Tropical punch
drink.scene: the welcome party on the island
drink.method: Mango nectar and fresh passionfruit pulp topped with lemonade over plenty of ice, a lime wedge on each glass.

films.title: Ice Age
films.tagline: One acorn. One very long chase.
films.description: A mammoth, a sloth and a sabre-tooth tiger team up to return a human baby to his father.
films.serve_cue: Serve the snacks when the dodos fight over the last melon.

snacks.name: Dodos' last melon
snacks.scene: the dodos defending their last melon
snacks.method: Watermelon cut into thick wedges, topped with crumbled feta, torn mint, lime and a pinch of flaky salt, served very cold.

snacks.name: Scrat's acorns
snacks.scene: the squirrel and his one acorn
snacks.method: Hazelnut and chocolate truffles rolled in chopped toasted hazelnuts, a pretzel stick pushed in as the stalk so they look like acorns.

mains.name: Mammoth slow-cooked beef ribs
mains.scene: big food for a woolly mammoth
mains.method: Beef short ribs rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, wrapped and baked at 150C for 4 hours, glazed under the grill with barbecue sauce. Coleslaw.

mains.name: Sid's veggie stew

mains.method: Root vegetables, chickpeas and tomato simmered with cumin and smoked paprika until thick, served with crusty bread.

dessert.name: Ice age snowballs
dessert.scene: the frozen world
dessert.method: Vanilla cupcakes covered in marshmallow frosting and rolled in desiccated coconut so they look like snowballs.

drink.name: Scrat's nutty caramel milkshake
drink.scene: the one acorn Scrat never lets go of
drink.method: Vanilla ice cream blended with milk, caramel and peanut butter into a thick nutty shake.

films.title: Shrek 2
films.tagline: Are we there yet. Yes. Dinner's ready.

snacks.name: Muffin Man's muffins
snacks.scene: do you know the Muffin Man
snacks.method: Blueberry muffins: flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, blueberries folded in, crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.

snacks.name: Poison Apple tavern apples

snacks.method: Apple wedges dipped in red toffee (sugar, water and red colouring boiled to 150C), set on oiled paper, a little shiny and suspicious.

snacks.name: Puss's Spanish tapas

snacks.method: Patatas bravas with a smoky tomato sauce and garlic aioli, and chorizo cooked in red wine, on small plates.

mains.name: Royal family dinner

dessert.name: Giant gingerbread man

drink.name: Fairy Godmother's potion
drink.scene: the happily ever after potion from her factory
drink.method: Lemonade with a splash of blue raspberry cordial and a spoon of edible glitter swirled in, poured into little glass bottles.

snacks.name: Training bowl dumplings

dessert.name: Almond cookies

drink.name: Jasmine tea

snacks.name: Minion banana bites

films.title: The Dark Knight

snacks.method: Seared beef fillet on crostini with horseradish cream, smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche and chives, served on black trays.

mains.name: Gotham diner meatloaf

dessert.name: Penthouse fundraiser lemon tart

dessert.method: Crisp pastry with a smooth, sharp lemon cream, finished with icing sugar. Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes.

films.title: Batman Begins

snacks.name: Narrows street dumplings

mains.name: Wayne Manor Sunday roast

dessert.name: Bruce's birthday cake

drink.name: Wayne Manor elderflower cordial
drink.method: Elderflower cordial with sparkling water, lemon and cucumber over ice. Fill 4 glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons.

films.title: Black Panther

snacks.name: Suya skewers

snacks.method: Beef rump in thin strips coated in a spice of ground peanuts, smoked paprika, ginger, garlic and chilli, skewered and grilled hot, with sliced red onion and tomato.

snacks.name: Busan casino bites

snacks.method: Korean fried chicken: wings in potato starch fried twice, tossed in gochujang, honey, soy and garlic glaze, sesame on top.

snacks.name: Heart-shaped herb dip

dessert.name: Fried plantain with honey

snacks.method: Sausage rolls with tomato sauce for the party. Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion, roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, slice and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

snacks.name: Parents' night in cheese board
snacks.scene: Mac and Kelly at home with the baby
snacks.method: Cheese, crackers and grapes, a quiet night in for new parents. Arrange 150g brie, 150g cheddar, 200g crackers and a bunch of grapes on a board.

mains.name: Backyard barbecue
mains.scene: the backyard next to the frat
mains.method: Grilled sausages and steaks with salad, a peace offering barbecue. Grill 8 sausages and 4 steaks.

dessert.name: Party sheet cake
dessert.scene: the frat party
dessert.method: Vanilla sheet cake with sprinkles. Bake a vanilla sheet cake from 300g self-raising flour, 250g sugar, 3 eggs, 200ml milk and 150g butter at 175C for 35 minutes.

drink.name: Party punch
drink.method: Fruit punch with lemonade and orange slices. Mix 1L tropical juice with 1L lemonade and orange slices over ice.

films.title: This Is the End
films.tagline: The end of the world. The last of the snacks.
films.description: A group of actors are trapped in a Hollywood house party when the apocalypse hits.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sweets when they fight over the last chocolate bar.

snacks.name: Franco's party canapés
snacks.scene: James Franco's housewarming
snacks.method: Bruschetta with tomato and basil, the fancy party food before it all goes wrong. Toast slices of baguette, rub with garlic and top with 4 diced tomatoes, basil and olive oil.

snacks.name: Rationed pantry snacks
snacks.scene: rationing the supplies
snacks.method: Tinned and packet snacks shared out carefully: crackers, cheese and pretzels. Portion 200g crackers, 150g cheddar and 150g pretzels into equal piles for everyone.

mains.name: End of days pasta
mains.scene: cooking whatever is left
mains.method: Spaghetti with tinned tomatoes, garlic and chilli, apocalypse pantry cooking. Fry 3 garlic cloves and chilli in oil, add 800g tinned tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.

dessert.name: The last chocolate caramel bar
dessert.scene: the fight over the last chocolate bar
dessert.method: Homemade chocolate nougat and caramel bars, enough so nobody has to fight. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter, press into a tin, top with 380g tinned caramel and chill.

drink.name: Rationed water
drink.method: Cold water in a jug with lemon, every drop shared.

films.title: Idiocracy
films.tagline: It's got electrolytes.
films.description: An average army librarian wakes up 500 years in the future to find he is now the smartest man alive.
films.serve_cue: Serve the drink when the electrolytes come up.

snacks.name: Giant warehouse snack pack
snacks.scene: the giant warehouse store
snacks.method: Mixed corn chips, pretzels and cheese puffs in a huge bowl. Tip 200g corn chips, 150g pretzels and 150g cheese puffs into a huge bowl.

snacks.name: Future fries
snacks.scene: fast food in the future
snacks.method: Seasoned fries with chicken salt. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with chicken salt.

mains.name: Plants-crave-water salad bowl
mains.scene: Joe teaching them to water the crops
mains.method: A big fresh salad bowl with grilled chicken, because plants actually need water. Grill 600g chicken breast and slice.

dessert.name: Future cupcakes
dessert.scene: 500 years in the future
dessert.method: Blue-iced vanilla cupcakes. Bake 12 vanilla cupcakes and ice with buttercream tinted blue. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

drink.name: Electrolyte cooler
drink.method: A homemade electrolyte drink: orange, lemon, a pinch of salt and honey, served very cold.

films.title: Mr. Deeds
films.tagline: Mandrake Falls' finest pizza.
films.description: A small-town pizzeria owner inherits a fortune and moves to New York, where he stays exactly himself.
films.serve_cue: Serve the pizza when Deeds is back at his shop in Mandrake Falls.

snacks.name: Mandrake Falls garlic knots
snacks.scene: Deeds's pizza shop
snacks.method: Garlic knots brushed with butter and parmesan. Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, tie into knots and bake at 220C for 12 minutes.

snacks.name: Greeting card poem bites
snacks.scene: Deeds writes greeting card poems
snacks.method: Little cheese and tomato pinwheels, sweet and simple like Deeds's poems. Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with tomato paste and cheese, roll, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes.

mains.name: Deeds's pizzeria pizza
mains.scene: his small-town pizzeria
mains.method: A classic pepperoni and mushroom pizza, made by the man himself. Stretch 500g pizza dough, spread with sauce and top with 200g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 100g mushrooms.

dessert.name: New York cheesecake
dessert.scene: his time in New York
dessert.method: Baked New York cheesecake with a biscuit base. Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a tin.

drink.name: Small-town cola
drink.method: Cold cola with ice. Pour cold cola over ice in 4 glasses.

films.title: Uncle Buck
films.tagline: Pancakes the size of a hubcap.
films.description: A lovable slob uncle looks after his brother's three kids for the week.
films.serve_cue: Serve the sweets when Buck flips the giant pancake.

snacks.name: Buck's birthday party popcorn
snacks.scene: Miles's birthday party
snacks.method: Buttery popcorn for the birthday party. Pop 120g popcorn kernels and toss with 50g butter and salt.

snacks.name: Bowling alley fries
snacks.scene: Buck's night out
snacks.method: Crisp fries with gravy. Bake 1kg frozen chips and serve with 300ml gravy made from powder.

mains.name: Buck's breakfast for dinner
mains.scene: Buck cooking for the kids
mains.method: Bacon, eggs and sausages on toast, Buck's kind of cooking. Fry 8 rashers bacon and 8 sausages, then 4 eggs.

dessert.name: Uncle Buck's giant pancake
dessert.scene: the hubcap-sized pancake
dessert.method: One enormous pancake cooked in the biggest pan you own, with butter and syrup. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 400ml milk.

drink.name: Big glass of milk
drink.method: Cold milk to wash down the pancake. Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 glasses.

films.title: The Great Outdoors
films.tagline: The 96 ounce challenge.
films.description: A family's quiet lake holiday is wrecked when the rich, loud brother-in-law and his family turn up.
films.serve_cue: Serve the main when Roman takes on the Old 96er.

snacks.name: Lakeside fish bites
snacks.scene: fishing on the lake
snacks.method: Crumbed fish bites with lemon, from a day on the lake. Cut 500g white fish into bites, crumb and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.

snacks.name: Cabin campfire s'mores
snacks.scene: the lake cabin campfire
snacks.method: Toasted marshmallows and chocolate squashed between biscuits around the fire, a lake cabin must. Toast 16 marshmallows on skewers until golden.

mains.name: The Old 96er
mains.scene: the 96 ounce steak challenge
mains.method: A huge rump steak with all the trimmings: potatoes, salad and bread. Share it, don't attempt it alone.

dessert.name: Lake cabin blueberry pie
dessert.scene: the lake holiday
dessert.method: Blueberry pie with ice cream. Toss 800g blueberries with 120g sugar and cornflour, fill a pastry case, top and bake at 190C for 45 minutes.

drink.name: Lake cabin beer
drink.method: Cold beer on the dock. Lemonade for the kids.

films.title: Stripes
films.tagline: That's the fact, dinner.
films.description: A cab driver who has lost everything joins the army with his best mate.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the platoon finally comes together.

snacks.name: Basic training mess crackers
snacks.scene: the start of basic training
snacks.method: Army crackers with cheese spread. Serve 200g crackers with 200g cheese spread. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

snacks.name: Barracks hot dog bites
snacks.scene: downtime in the barracks
snacks.method: Cocktail franks with mustard and sauce on toothpicks, barracks snack food done properly. Simmer 24 cocktail franks in water for 5 minutes and drain.

mains.name: Army mess hall meatloaf
mains.scene: the mess hall
mains.method: Meatloaf with mash and gravy, mess hall style. Mix 800g beef mince, onion, egg and breadcrumbs, bake at 180C for 1 hour and serve with mash and gravy.

dessert.name: Graduation chocolate cake
dessert.scene: graduation from basic training
dessert.method: Chocolate cake with chocolate icing. Bake a chocolate cake from 300g self-raising flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and 125g butter at 175C for 40 minutes.

drink.name: Army canteen coffee
drink.method: Strong black coffee. Brew 60g ground coffee in 1L water and serve black.

films.title: Fletch
films.tagline: Put it on the Underhills' tab.
films.description: An undercover reporter investigating drug dealing gets a very strange offer from a millionaire.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Fletch orders at the club on the Underhills' tab.

snacks.name: Club bloody mary prawns
snacks.scene: the country club order
snacks.method: Prawns with a spicy bloody mary cocktail sauce. Mix 150ml tomato juice reduced to thick with horseradish, Worcestershire, celery salt and lemon.

snacks.name: Beach front fish bites
snacks.scene: the LA beach Fletch goes undercover on
snacks.method: Crumbed fish bites with lemon and tartare, beach kiosk food from Fletch's undercover days. Cut 500g white fish into bites, roll in flour, egg and 100g panko and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.

mains.name: Steak sandwich and a steak sandwich
mains.scene: the order on the Underhills' tab
mains.method: Two steak sandwiches each, with fried onions and mustard, ordered on someone else's tab. Pan-fry 4 thin rump steaks for 2 minutes a side.

dessert.name: Country club sundaes
dessert.scene: the country club
dessert.method: Vanilla sundaes with hot fudge. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream and pour over hot fudge sauce.

drink.name: Bloody Mary
drink.scene: the drink on the Underhills' tab
drink.method: Vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire and celery salt with a celery stick.

films.title: Meet the Fockers
films.tagline: Welcome to the family. Dinner's on.
films.description: The Byrnes family travel to Florida to meet the Focker parents before the wedding.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when the two families sit down together.

snacks.name: Miami Cuban croquetas
snacks.scene: the Fockers' Florida home
snacks.method: Crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre. Make a thick béchamel with 60g butter, 80g flour and 500ml milk, stir in 200g ham and chill.

snacks.name: Bernie's fondue
snacks.scene: Bernie's big welcome
snacks.method: Cheese fondue with bread, the Focker welcome. Heat 300ml white wine, stir in 400g gruyère tossed in cornflour until smooth.

mains.name: Focker family dinner
mains.scene: the two families at the table
mains.method: Mojo roast pork with black beans and rice, a Florida family feast. Marinate 1.5kg pork shoulder in orange, lime, garlic and cumin and roast at 160C for 3 hours.

dessert.name: Key lime pie
dessert.scene: the Fockers' Florida home
dessert.method: Tangy key lime pie with a biscuit base and cream. Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a dish.

drink.name: Mojito
drink.method: White rum, lime, mint and soda. Virgin for the kids.

films.title: Strange Brew
films.tagline: Take off, eh. Then dinner.
films.description: Two hosers try to get free beer and stumble onto a plot at the Elsinore brewery.
films.serve_cue: Serve the beer when Bob and Doug try to get their free case.

snacks.name: Back bacon on a bun
snacks.scene: Canadian back bacon
snacks.method: Thick-cut back bacon on soft buns with mustard. Fry 8 thick slices of back bacon until golden and serve in 8 soft buns with mustard.

snacks.name: Doughnut shop honey crullers
snacks.scene: the doughnut shop Bob and Doug love
snacks.method: Light twisted crullers glazed with honey, a Canadian doughnut shop favourite. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, cool and beat in 3 eggs.

mains.name: Hoser poutine
mains.scene: Bob and Doug's Canada
mains.method: Fries with cheese curds and hot gravy. Bake 1kg frozen chips, top with 250g cubed haloumi or curds and pour over 400ml hot gravy.

dessert.name: Maple butter tarts
dessert.scene: Bob and Doug's Canada
dessert.method: Gooey maple and brown sugar tarts. Mix 100g brown sugar, 80ml maple syrup, 60g butter and 1 egg.

drink.name: Elsinore beer
drink.method: Cold Canadian lager by the stubby. Chill 8 stubbies of lager and serve.

films.title: Dirty Work
films.tagline: Revenge served hot.
films.description: Two lifelong mates start a revenge-for-hire business to raise money for a heart operation.
films.serve_cue: Serve the mains when Mitch and Sam open Dirty Work for business.

snacks.name: Revenge-for-hire wings
snacks.scene: the first paying revenge job
snacks.method: Hot chicken wings tossed in a buttery hot sauce with blue cheese dip, payback with a kick. Bake the wings until crisp first.

snacks.name: Mitch's job-a-week snack box
snacks.scene: Mitch losing one job after another
snacks.method: A mixed box of pretzels, peanuts and cheese crackers, the kind of snacks you grab on the way out of yet another job.

mains.name: Pops's diner patty melt
mains.scene: Pops, Sam's dad, who needs the operation
mains.method: A patty melt on rye with Swiss cheese and fried onions, old-school diner food Pops would order.

dessert.name: Hole in one sundaes
dessert.scene: a good day for a change
dessert.method: Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge, peanuts and a cherry, the kind of treat you have when the plan finally works.

drink.name: Cold one with Pops
drink.method: Ice-cold lager in the bottle, the kind Pops would crack open. Lemonade for the kids.
